These findings provide an experimentally grounded basis for second-shell design in artificial catalysts, offering a rational strategy to bridge the activity gap between synthetic single-atom systems and natural metalloenzymes.
papers.abstract_zh: 单原子催化主要通过金属中心及其第一配位层的电子结构来解释，而第二壳层的独立贡献在实验上仍难以分离。在此，我们报道了一种蛋白质支撑的单原子催化平台，能够实现第一壳层与第二壳层效应的正交解耦。结构不变的Pt(Glu)₂单元被共价锚定在蛋白质支架上，而蛋白质构象转变选择性地调节周围空间微环境，而不扰动金属活性位点。仅通过构象循环即可实现约65%活性范围的可逆催化调节，且金属配位环境无任何可检测变化。动力学分析表明，活性变化主要由底物亲和力（Km）的变异主导，而非内在转化率，这通过Arrhenius分析中折叠与去折叠状态间几乎相同的活化能得以证实。荧光追踪和分子动力学模拟进一步支持蛋白质折叠增强底物可及性和催化中心周围的空间预组织。这些发现为人工催化剂中的第二壳层设计提供了实验基础，为弥合合成单原子系统与天然金属酶之间的活性差距提供了合理策略。

papers.title: GeoEPred: A multimodal structure-aware geometric deep learning framework for Gram-negative bacterial secreted effector prediction with sequence semantics.
papers.authors: Song, Shouzhen; Shi, Hua; Wu, Hongfeng; Liu, Dachen; Lin, Yihang; Mat Isa, Nor Ashidi; Zou, Quan; Wei, Leyi
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出GeoEPred，融合蛋白语言模型序列嵌入与ESMFold预测结构，通过几何深度学习预测细菌效应蛋白，虽对象非典型蛋白结构计算问题，但结构感知建模方法可迁移至蛋白质结构相关任务。
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of effector proteins secreted by Gram-negative bacteria is important for elucidating bacterial pathogenic mechanisms and developing precise anti-infective strategies. Although existing methods have benefited from the strong sequence feature extraction capacity of pretrained protein language models, reliance on linear sequence information alone often fails to fully capture the three-dimensional conformational signals required for virulence functions. Meanwhile, conventional structure-based methods are limited by the scarcity of experimentally resolved protein structures. To address these challenges, we propose GeoEPred, a multimodal deep learning framework designed for the synergistic modeling of protein sequence and structure to identify Gram-negative bacterial effector proteins. Specifically, the model integrates sequence-contextual embeddings from a pretrained protein language model with three-dimensional structural representations predicted by ESMFold. A feature projection network refines fine-grained sequence signals associated with effector functions, while geometric vector perceptrons characterize inter-residue orientations, distances, and local spatial topology to capture potential structural conformational motifs. To further enable effective cross-modal fusion, we design a cross-modal alignment and feature-tokenized self-attention module. This module enhances consistency between the sequence-semantic and structural-geometric spaces through contrastive learning and models associations between linear functional motifs and spatial conformational patterns at a fine-grained token level. Extensive evaluations on multiple benchmark datasets show that GeoEPred achieves better predictive performance than existing leading models in T3SE, T4SE, and T6SE prediction tasks, while maintaining stable performance in remote homolog recognition scenarios. Moreover, the modular and extensible architecture of GeoEPred demonstrates strong generalization ability and substantial application potential for genome-scale effector protein discovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确预测革兰氏阴性细菌分泌的效应蛋白，对于阐明细菌致病机制和开发精准抗感染策略具有重要意义。尽管现有方法受益于预训练蛋白质语言模型强大的序列特征提取能力，但仅依赖线性序列信息往往无法充分捕捉毒力功能所需的三维构象信号。同时，传统基于结构的方法受限于实验解析蛋白质结构的稀缺性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了GeoEPred，一种多模态深度学习框架，旨在协同建模蛋白质序列和结构以识别革兰氏阴性细菌效应蛋白。具体而言，该模型整合了来自预训练蛋白质语言模型的序列上下文嵌入与ESMFold预测的三维结构表示。特征投影网络细化与效应功能相关的细粒度序列信号，而几何向量感知器则表征残基间方向、距离和局部空间拓扑，以捕捉潜在的结构构象基序。为进一步实现有效的跨模态融合，我们设计了一个跨模态对齐和特征令牌化自注意力模块。该模块通过对比学习增强序列语义空间与结构几何空间之间的一致性，并在细粒度令牌级别建模线性功能基序与空间构象模式之间的关联。在多个基准数据集上的广泛评估表明，GeoEPred在T3SE、T4SE和T6SE预测任务中取得了优于现有领先模型的预测性能，同时在远程同源识别场景中保持稳定表现。此外，GeoEPred的模块化和可扩展架构展示了强大的泛化能力，并在基因组规模效应蛋白发现方面具有显著的应用潜力。

papers.title: What deep learning can and cannot (yet) do for enzyme design.
papers.authors: Ahr, Judith A; de Waal, Moor M; Cotet, Tudor-Stefan; Howell, Daniel C; Bunzel, H Adrian
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文综述了深度学习在基于结构的酶设计中的进展与局限，聚焦扩散模型生成支架和序列设计，虽为综述且方法创新有限，但紧密围绕蛋白质结构计算设计问题，对课题有参考价值。
papers.abstract: Deep learning has substantially advanced structure-based enzyme design, yet reliably creating highly efficient enzymes remains out of reach. One emerging enzyme design strategy combines diffusion-based scaffold generation around active-site models with sequence design. Such structure-based approaches have expanded the accessible reaction space and enabled the emergence of enzymes with diverse catalytic functions and complex catalytic motifs. Despite notable catalytic efficiencies (k(cat)/K(M)), turnover rates (k(cat)) often remain limited, suggesting that current approaches typically yield tight substrate binders rather than enzymes that selectively stabilize the chemical transition state. Computational design of electrostatic catalysis, multistate behavior, and conformational dynamics could potentially enhance transition-state stabilization and improve catalytic activity. More reliable activity oracles, integration of evolutionary information, protein language models, and lab-in-the-loop optimization could further enhance design performance. Ultimately, advancing structure-based enzyme design will require directly targeting the physicochemical drivers of catalysis to move beyond substrate binding toward the reliable design of efficient catalysts.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度学习已大幅推进了基于结构的酶设计，但可靠地创造高效酶仍难以实现。一种新兴的酶设计策略将基于扩散的支架生成与活性位点模型及序列设计相结合。此类基于结构的方法扩展了可及的反应空间，并促成了具有多样催化功能和复杂催化基序的酶的出现。尽管催化效率（k(cat)/K(M)）显著，但周转率（k(cat)）往往仍受限，这表明当前方法通常产生紧密底物结合体，而非选择性稳定化学过渡态的酶。静电催化、多态行为和构象动力学的计算设计可能增强过渡态稳定化并提升催化活性。更可靠的活性预测器、进化信息的整合、蛋白质语言模型及实验室闭环优化可进一步提升设计性能。最终，推进基于结构的酶设计需直接针对催化的物理化学驱动因素，以超越底物结合，迈向高效催化剂的可靠设计。

papers.title: The novel viper FETUA-3 protein evolved a unique mode of inhibiting snake venom metalloproteinases
papers.authors: Dowell NL; Vázquez Torres S; Ukken FP; Andjelkovic M; Hajra M; Cahill E; Höcker B; Fernández-Leiro R; Carroll SB
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文结合结构预测与分子动力学，解析蛇毒金属蛋白酶抑制剂FETUA-3的进化机制与抑制模式，虽以蛋白-蛋白相互作用为核心，但结构计算为辅助手段，方法创新性有限。
papers.abstract: Molecular innovation and coevolution play major roles in the evolution of biological diversity, yet we have few instances in which we understand the biological and molecular bases of coevolution. Rattlesnakes and other vipers have evolved resistance to their own novel venom metalloproteinase (MP) toxins through the invention and coevolution of serum-borne inhibitors (FETUAs) derived from the ancestral, non-inhibitory, serum glycoprotein Fetuin-A. However, how FETUAs acquired their function and mechanism of action are unknown. Here, we use a combination of structure prediction, site-directed mutagenesis, functional analyses, and molecular dynamics to elucidate how the rattlesnake FETUA-3 protein evolved to inhibit three classes of venom MP toxins. We show that FETUA-3 uses a combination of structural motifs to bind multiple MPs with high-affinity and acts as a potent noncompetitive inhibitor by inserting its N-terminus into MP active sites and directly disrupting substrate cleavage. We also find strong selective constraints on key N-terminal residues that maintain FETUA-3 specificity for multiple MP targets. These results reveal that FETUA-3 evolved a unique mechanism of action distinct from other vertebrate metalloproteinase inhibitors and how a small number of FETUA proteins controls the activities of a large family of venom toxins.
papers.abstract_zh: 分子创新与协同进化在生物多样性的演化中扮演重要角色，然而我们对于协同进化的生物学和分子基础知之甚少的实例寥寥无几。响尾蛇和其他蝰蛇通过发明和协同进化源自祖先非抑制性血清糖蛋白Fetuin-A的血清源性抑制剂（FETUAs），从而进化出对自身新型毒液金属蛋白酶（MP）毒素的抗性。然而，FETUAs如何获得其功能及作用机制尚不清楚。在此，我们结合结构预测、定点突变、功能分析和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics)，阐明响尾蛇FETUA-3蛋白如何进化以抑制三类毒液MP毒素。我们表明，FETUA-3利用结构基序的组合以高亲和力结合多种MPs，并通过将其N端插入MP活性位点直接破坏底物裂解，从而作为强效非竞争性抑制剂发挥作用。我们还发现，关键N端残基受到强烈选择约束，这些残基维持FETUA-3对多种MP靶标的特异性。这些结果揭示，FETUA-3进化出一种不同于其他脊椎动物金属蛋白酶抑制剂的独特作用机制，并阐明少数FETUA蛋白如何控制一大类毒液毒素的活性。

papers.title: Probing the sequence variability tolerance in a de novo α-helical barrel biocatalyst
papers.authors: Elaily W; Braun M; Stoll D; Chakatok M; Aleotti M; Grill B; Bijelic A; Hall M; Oberdorfer G
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文结合AlphaFold2引导的RosettaRemodel和ProteinMPNN对de novo α-螺旋桶生物催化剂进行结构截短与序列重设计，并验证了结构、稳定性和催化活性，属于蛋白质结构设计与序列设计的核心计算研究。
papers.abstract: De novo-designed enzymes have recently achieved high catalytic activity and stereoselectivity while demonstrating exceptional thermostability in entirely novel protein scaffolds. Among these, α-helical barrel protein scaffolds are attractive structures for biocatalysis due to their structural simplicity, high thermostability, and rationalizable sequence patterning. However, enabling major structural reengineering of these scaffolds while maintaining the structure, stability and catalytic activity while also improving soluble protein production remain major challenges and pose the fundamental question how engineerable a de novo backbone-sequence pair is. Here, we combine deep learning based and classic computational protein design to modify and optimize de novo α-helical barrel biocatalysts. Using the previously reported six-helical barrel 6H5L as a model scaffold, AlphaFold2-guided RosettaRemodel enabled the design of a truncated variant, whose crystal structure closely matches the design model. Additional sequence-redesign using ProteinMPNN generated a variant with a tenfold increase of soluble protein yield in Escherichia coli. Biochemical, biophysical, and structural analyses showed that both variants retained the overall barrel architecture, high thermal stability, and catalytic activity for both purified protein and whole-cell systems. Detailed kinetic analysis on the variants showed both variation in k cat and K m , reflecting changes in catalytic turnover and substrate binding. Together, these approaches provide new insights and possibilities for the further engineering of functional de novo α-helical barrels, their ability to withstand dramatically large sequence changes and their broader application in biocatalysis and biotechnology.
papers.abstract_zh: 从头设计（de novo-designed）的酶近年来已在全新的蛋白质支架中实现了高催化活性和立体选择性，同时展现出卓越的热稳定性。其中，α-螺旋桶状蛋白质支架因其结构简单、高热稳定性以及可合理化的序列模式，成为生物催化中具有吸引力的结构。然而，在保持结构、稳定性和催化活性的同时，实现这些支架的重大结构重构，并提高可溶性蛋白产量，仍是主要挑战，并提出了从头设计的骨架-序列对可工程化程度的基本问题。在此，我们结合基于深度学习的方法和经典计算蛋白质设计，来修改和优化从头设计的α-螺旋桶状生物催化剂。以先前报道的六螺旋桶状结构6H5L作为模型支架，AlphaFold2引导的RosettaRemodel成功设计了一个截短变体，其晶体结构与设计模型高度吻合。进一步使用ProteinMPNN进行序列重设计，生成了一个在大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）中可溶性蛋白产量提高十倍以上的变体。生化、生物物理和结构分析表明，两个变体均保留了整体桶状架构、高热稳定性以及纯化蛋白和全细胞系统中的催化活性。对变体的详细动力学分析显示，k_cat和K_m均有所变化，反映了催化周转和底物结合的改变。综合来看，这些方法为功能性从头设计α-螺旋桶状结构的进一步工程化、其承受大幅序列变化的能力以及在生物催化和生物技术中的更广泛应用提供了新见解和可能性。

papers.title: iORbase 2.0: Comprehensive analysis platform for insect odorant receptors from genome to structure and function.
papers.authors: Zhang, Yifeng; Gao, Chenxi; Xue, Jiameng; Guo, Yi; Duan, Suyang; Zhang, Tianmin; Xue, Wei; Yao, Xiang; Yin, Yangming; Sun, Qingbin; Li, Gang; Xu, Chang; Lu, Huimeng
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文介绍昆虫嗅觉受体综合数据库平台，涵盖结构预测、对接和MD分析，虽非蛋白质结构核心方法创新，但涉及结构计算且可迁移至蛋白体系。
papers.abstract: iORbase 2.0 is an analysis platform for insect odorant receptors that covers sequence, structure, and function analyses. It provides functionalities such as gene annotation, structure prediction, molecular docking, and analysis of molecular dynamics simulation results, along with large-scale sequence, structure, and functional data, thereby assisting research on insect odorant receptors.
papers.abstract_zh: iORbase 2.0是一个昆虫嗅觉受体分析平台，涵盖序列、结构和功能分析。它提供基因注释、结构预测、分子对接及分子动力学模拟结果分析等功能，并包含大规模序列、结构和功能数据，从而辅助昆虫嗅觉受体的研究。

papers.title: Antigenic remodeling of the SARS-CoV-2 Spike N-terminal domain links sequence variability to structural reorganization of a neutralizing antibody supersite.
papers.authors: Ardisson, Juliana Santa; Athaydes, Brena Ramos; Monfardini Sagrillo, Mariane Vedovatti; de Almeida, Raphaella Luisa Fernandes; Paneto, Greiciane Gaburro; de Paula, Hebert; Nunes, Gabriela Ferreira; Spano, Liliana Cruz; von Zeidler, Sandra Ventorin; Bastos-Filho, Teodiano Freire
papers.journal: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文结合基因组监测、结构建模与分子动力学，分析SARS-CoV-2 Spike NTD序列变异对抗体超位点界面结构重组的影响，属于蛋白质结构计算与序列变异关联研究，但对象为病毒蛋白且方法偏应用，创新性中等。
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The N-terminal domain (NTD) of the Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) Spike harbors a neutralizing antibody supersite and is a recurrent site of antigenic change. However, how sequence variability across pre- and post-vaccination immune landscapes reshapes antibody recognition remains incompletely characterized. METHODS: Clinical-genomic surveillance was combined with structural modeling and molecular dynamics to identify antigenically relevant NTD changes and probe their structural impact on the neutralizing antibody interface. SARS-CoV-2 profiles were compared across two periods reflecting contrasting immune contexts: a pre-vaccination period dominated by B.1.1.33 and a post-vaccination period dominated by the Omicron sublineage BQ.1.1. A local cohort (n=126) supported descriptive characterization. An expanded cohort integrating local and GISAID genomes with harmonized clinical metadata (n=534; 401 pre-vaccination, 133 post-vaccination) was used to prioritize candidate loci by their association with clinical severity. RESULTS: In adjusted models, age remained independently associated with severity in both periods, whereas sex did not. In the pre-vaccination cohort, Spike S in the NTD was associated with greater severity, without phylogenetic segregation by outcome. This association is exploratory and was used to prioritize an antigenically located NTD change for structural analysis. Q23K was regionally concentrated in Espirito Santo (57.4%) relative to other Brazilian states (2.7%) and international genomes (1.4%). In the post-vaccination cohort, an overlapping deletion event (ORF9b -29/N -33) was associated with non-severe disease, but should be interpreted cautiously given metadata heterogeneity, cohort structure, and the nature of the locus. However, in this period clinical outcome and sequencing source were partially confounded. A source-stratified sensitivity analysis restricted to GISAID-only samples showed the association persisted, but could not rule out a source- or pipeline-dependent indel-calling artifact, so the finding is reported as exploratory. Although Q23K itself did not persist, adjacent NTD changes (T19I/A27S/D24 -26) became recurrent post-vaccination, indicating remodeling of the same antigenic neighborhood rather than persistence of a single mutation. Structural modeling and molecular dynamics of the NTD-antibody 1 -87 complex supported reorganization of the modeled antibody-antigen interface, with redistribution of supersite contacts rather than loss of structural compatibility. DISCUSSION: These findings link NTD variability across immune contexts to structural reorganization of the modeled antibody-antigen interface and support integrating genomic surveillance with structural analysis to prioritize antigenically relevant changes for functional testing.
papers.abstract_zh: 引言：严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2型（SARS-CoV-2）刺突蛋白的N端结构域（NTD）含有一个中和抗体超位点，并且是抗原性变化的频繁发生位点。然而，在疫苗接种前和疫苗接种后的免疫背景下，序列变异如何重塑抗体识别仍未被完全表征。方法：将临床基因组监测与结构建模和分子动力学相结合，以识别抗原相关的NTD变化，并探究其对中和抗体界面的结构影响。比较了两个反映不同免疫背景时期的SARS-CoV-2谱系：一个以B.1.1.33为主的疫苗接种前时期，以及一个以Omicron亚谱系BQ.1.1为主的疫苗接种后时期。一个本地队列（n=126）支持描述性表征。一个整合了本地和GISAID基因组及统一临床元数据的扩展队列（n=534；401例疫苗接种前，133例疫苗接种后）用于根据与临床严重程度的关联来优先排序候选位点。结果：在调整模型中，年龄在两个时期均与严重程度独立相关，而性别则无此关联。在疫苗接种前队列中，NTD中的刺突蛋白S与更严重的疾病相关，但未观察到按结局的系统发育分离。该关联为探索性发现，用于优先选择位于抗原区域的NTD变化进行结构分析。Q23K在圣埃斯皮里图州（57.4%）相对于巴西其他州（2.7%）和国际基因组（1.4%）呈区域性集中。在疫苗接种后队列中，一个重叠缺失事件（ORF9b -29/N -33）与非严重疾病相关，但鉴于元数据异质性、队列结构及该位点的性质，应谨慎解读。然而，在该时期，临床结局和测序来源部分混杂。一项仅限于GISAID样本的来源分层敏感性分析显示该关联持续存在，但无法排除来源或流程依赖的插入缺失调用伪影，因此该发现被报告为探索性结果。尽管Q23K本身未持续存在，但邻近的NTD变化（T19I/A27S/D24 -26）在疫苗接种后变得频繁出现，表明同一抗原邻域发生重塑而非单一突变的持续存在。NTD-抗体1 -87复合物的结构建模和分子动力学支持所建模的抗体-抗原界面发生重组，超位点接触重新分布而非结构兼容性丧失。讨论：这些发现将不同免疫背景下的NTD变异与所建模的抗体-抗原界面的结构重组联系起来，并支持将基因组监测与结构分析相结合，以优先选择抗原相关变化进行功能测试。

papers.title: AI-assisted crop improvement: new design tools within established regulatory frameworks.
papers.authors: Keiper, Felicity; Sanches da Rocha, Mitscheli; Beeckman, Delphine Sylvie Anne; Atanassova, Ana
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文探讨AI辅助作物改良的监管框架，涉及深度学习用于蛋白质序列/结构预测和蛋白设计，但核心是政策视角而非蛋白质结构计算方法创新，对象为作物非蛋白体系，算法可迁移性有限。
papers.abstract: The integration of Artificial intelligence (AI) into crop improvement offers the potential to enhance the precision, efficiency, and speed of development of new varieties. Accelerated genetic gain is promised by an increasing repertoire of AI tools for analyzing large and complex genetic and phenotypic datasets to discover and elucidate traits and predict functional variants that can be realized with the use of, inter alia, genome editing tools. This power, in combination with parallel AI tool development for optimization of genome editing processes, has generated optimism for a new era of smart breeding. This Perspective examines the regulatory implications of AI-assisted crop improvement, using illustrative examples where deep learning models have been integrated for protein sequence and structure prediction, and the optimization or design of proteins for improved or novel functionalities. The examples represent either end of a spectrum of current and emerging genome editing applications: (i) editing of endogenous genes to enhance beneficial alleles and optimize functionality; and (ii) the design and engineering of new ("de novo") protein domains for customized or new functionality. This range of outcomes can also be achieved without guidance from AI tools, albeit less efficiently, and their regulatory status is generally established. We consider relevant risks associated with these applications and contend that the regulatory status of the potential outcomes should not change, nor should they challenge the foundational applicability of existing regulatory frameworks and approaches for biotech crops. We also briefly discuss some current limitations of AI tools, and broader regulatory and governance considerations.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）融入作物改良，有望提升新品种开发的精准度、效率和速度。日益增多的AI工具用于分析庞大而复杂的遗传和表型数据集，以发现和阐明性状、预测功能性变异，并可通过基因组编辑等工具实现，从而承诺加速遗传增益。这种能力，结合并行开发的用于优化基因组编辑过程的AI工具，为智能育种的新时代带来了乐观情绪。本视角文章探讨了AI辅助作物改良的监管影响，并以深度学习模型已整合用于蛋白质序列和结构预测，以及优化或设计蛋白质以增强或新功能的实例进行说明。这些实例代表了当前和新兴基因组编辑应用谱系的两端：（i）编辑内源基因以增强有利等位基因并优化功能；（ii）设计并工程化新的（“从头”）蛋白质结构域以实现定制或新功能。这些结果范围也可在没有AI工具指导的情况下实现，尽管效率较低，且其监管状态通常已确立。我们认为，与这些应用相关的风险应予以考虑，并主张潜在结果的监管状态不应改变，也不应挑战现有生物技术作物监管框架和方法的根本适用性。我们还简要讨论了AI工具当前的一些局限性，以及更广泛的监管和治理考量。

papers.title: ProNA3D: Distance-Based Analysis of Nucleic Acid-Containing Interfaces.
papers.authors: Genz, Luca R; Topf, Maya
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文开发了ProNA3D工具，用于分析蛋白-核酸复合物界面，虽非纯蛋白质结构计算，但涉及结构预测结果评估和界面分析，方法可迁移至蛋白质体系。
papers.abstract: Biomolecular interactions are central to many essential cellular processes, but RNA-containing complexes remain challenging to resolve structurally, even as experimental methods and AI-based prediction have expanded structural coverage. Tools for the integrated analysis of interfaces within such complexes remain limited. We present ProNA3D, a tool that provides a unified platform for analyzing protein-nucleic acid and nucleic acid-only complexes, bridging the gap between structure prediction and functional interpretation. ProNA3D supports both experimental and computationally predicted structures, incorporating scoring metrics for AlphaFold 3 predictions. It also offers interactive 2-dimensional interface visualization and secondary-structure topology plots for RNA and DNA. An interface-based density zoning feature facilitates structure analysis of cryo-electron microscopy maps, allowing the evaluation of dynamic complexes in the context of heterogeneous density. We demonstrate ProNA3D on diverse complexes solved by x-ray crystallography or cryo-electron microscopy, as well as on computational models. In one example, ProNA3D identified a high-connectivity nucleotide with potential functional relevance in a trimeric complex of HIV-1 RNA and a human antibody. Applying ProNA3D to the entire Protein Data Bank revealed distinct interface connectivity trends and interaction modes characteristic of specific classes of nucleic acid-containing complexes (e.g., methyltransferase-DNA and CRISPR-associated). The method is available as both a UCSF ChimeraX plug-in for visualization and a command-line tool at https://gitlab.com/topf-lab/ProNA3D. In addition, the repository contains the results of the large-scale analyses.
papers.abstract_zh: 生物分子相互作用是许多基本细胞过程的核心，但含有RNA的复合物在结构解析上仍具挑战性，即便实验方法和基于AI的预测已扩展了结构覆盖范围。用于此类复合物内界面整合分析的工具仍然有限。我们提出ProNA3D，一个提供统一平台用于分析蛋白质-核酸和仅核酸复合物的工具，弥合了结构预测与功能解释之间的差距。ProNA3D支持实验结构和计算预测结构，并整合了AlphaFold 3预测的评分指标。它还提供RNA和DNA的交互式二维界面可视化和二级结构拓扑图。基于界面的密度分区功能有助于冷冻电子显微镜图谱的结构分析，允许在异质密度背景下评估动态复合物。我们展示了ProNA3D在通过X射线晶体学或冷冻电子显微镜解析的多种复合物以及计算模型上的应用。在一个例子中，ProNA3D在HIV-1 RNA和人抗体的三聚体复合物中识别出一个具有潜在功能相关性的高连接性核苷酸。将ProNA3D应用于整个蛋白质数据银行，揭示了特定类别含核酸复合物（如甲基转移酶-DNA和CRISPR相关）特有的不同界面连接趋势和相互作用模式。该方法可作为UCSF ChimeraX插件用于可视化，也可作为命令行工具在https://gitlab.com/topf-lab/ProNA3D获取。此外，该存储库包含大规模分析的结果。

papers.title: Computational Insights Into the Conformational Dynamics of the Dengue Virus Capsid Protein.
papers.authors: Chaudhuri, Dwaipayan; Giri, Kalyan
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用分子动力学模拟和增强采样方法研究登革病毒衣壳蛋白疏水口袋的开闭构象转变机制，属于蛋白质构象动态的计算模拟研究，与本课题高度相关。
papers.abstract: The Dengue virus (DENV) capsid protein plays an important role in the viral lifecycle, including encapsidation of the genome, recruitment of lipid droplets, and assembly of particles. Capsid protein includes a hydrophobic pocket, which plays a central role in these functions and switches between closed and open conformations. This work studies the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein, specifically how the molecular mechanisms controlling the opening and closing of the hydrophobic pocket are controlled. By using a combination of different types of molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, we share insights on the structural rearrangements that play a crucial role in governing these transitions. Our results show that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues. In the open conformation, the pocket is involved in the interaction with lipids, stabilization of capsid dimers, and the promotion of immature virus assembly. Conversely, the closed conformation protects the hydrophobic pocket from the surrounding aqueous media as also preventing premature interactions in the solution phase that might disrupt protein stability. Such insights allow a deep understanding of capsid protein's conformational dynamics and represent a promising set of potent targets for antiviral strategies aiming to interfere with its functional transitions.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒（DENV）衣壳蛋白在病毒生命周期中扮演重要角色，包括基因组的包装、脂滴的募集以及颗粒的组装。衣壳蛋白包含一个疏水口袋，该口袋在这些功能中起核心作用，并在闭合与开放构象之间切换。本研究探讨衣壳蛋白的构象变化路径，特别是控制疏水口袋开放与闭合的分子机制。通过结合不同类型的分子动力学模拟和增强采样方法，我们揭示了在调控这些转变中起关键作用的结构重排。我们的结果表明，脂质结合通过环境线索调节疏水口袋的可及性。在开放构象中，口袋参与与脂质的相互作用、稳定衣壳二聚体，并促进未成熟病毒的组装。相反，闭合构象保护疏水口袋免受周围水介质的影响，同时防止溶液相中可能破坏蛋白质稳定性的过早相互作用。这些见解有助于深入理解衣壳蛋白的构象动力学，并为旨在干扰其功能转变的抗病毒策略提供了一系列有前景的靶点。

papers.title: alpha-Chaconine as a Potential Inhibitor of Mutant Phosphatidylinositol 3-Kinase Alpha in Breast Cancer Stem Cells: Insights from Structure Prediction and Molecular Dynamics.
papers.authors: Saputra, Bakti Wahyu; Ujiantari, Navista Sri Octa; Rattyananda, Badra Sanditya; Alwi, Ratna Surya; Setiawati, Agustina; Hermawan, Adam
papers.journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过同源建模、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，评估alpha-Chaconine对突变PI3Kα的抑制潜力，属于蛋白质结构预测与MD模拟的工程化应用，方法常规但对象和问题明确。
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Breast cancer stem cells (BCSCs) promote chemoresistance and metastasis by activating aberrant signaling pathways such as phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B (PI3K/Akt). alpha-Chaconine (CHA) is a steroidal glycoalkaloid that has demonstrated cytotoxic and antiproliferative activity in various cancer models, possibly through modulation of the PI3K/Akt pathway. However, its direct interaction with PI3Kalpha and related alterations has not yet been elucidated. This study aimed to assess CHA as a potential BCSC-targeting agent, particularly as a PI3K inhibitor targeting both wild-type and mutant PI3Kalpha, using an in silico approach. METHODS: Mutation data were retrieved from cBioPortal and analyzed using MutPred2. SWISS-MODEL was used to generate homology models of the wild-type and mutant PI3Kalpha structures. Structural validation was performed using PROCHECK and ERRAT. Molecular docking was employed to evaluate the binding affinity of the PI3Kalpha-CHA complex. Molecular dynamics simulations were conducted to assess the stability of the interaction between CHA and PI3Kalpha. RESULTS: Three PIK3CA mutations were identified as pathogenic: E542K, E545K, and H1047R. Molecular docking revealed a strong binding affinity of alpelisib to both wild-type and mutant (E542K, E545K, and H1047R) forms of p110 alpha. CHA exhibited the lowest binding energy with the H1047R mutant, with a docking score of -9.93 kcal/mol. Molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated stable interactions of alpelisib with wild-type, E542K, and E545K mutants, whereas CHA showed stable interaction only with the H1047R mutant. MM-PBSA calculations confirmed the lowest binding free energies for alpelisib-wild-type p110alpha and CHA-H1047R complexes, with values of -29.21 kcal/mol and -25.88 kcal/mol, respectively. CONCLUSION: These findings provide a basis for further in vitro and in vivo studies to evaluate CHA as a selective PI3K inhibitor targeting the H1047R PIK3CA mutation in breast cancer stem cells.
papers.abstract_zh: 引言：乳腺癌干细胞（BCSCs）通过激活异常信号通路（如磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶/蛋白激酶B（PI3K/Akt））促进化疗耐药和转移。α-查茄碱（CHA）是一种甾体糖生物碱，已在多种癌症模型中显示出细胞毒性和抗增殖活性，可能通过调节PI3K/Akt通路实现。然而，其与PI3Kα的直接相互作用及相关改变尚未阐明。本研究旨在通过计算机模拟方法评估CHA作为潜在的靶向BCSCs药物，特别是作为靶向野生型和突变型PI3Kα的PI3K抑制剂。方法：从cBioPortal获取突变数据，并使用MutPred2进行分析。使用SWISS-MODEL生成野生型和突变型PI3Kα结构的同源模型。使用PROCHECK和ERRAT进行结构验证。采用分子对接评估PI3Kα-CHA复合物的结合亲和力。进行分子动力学模拟以评估CHA与PI3Kα之间相互作用的稳定性。结果：三个PIK3CA突变被鉴定为致病性：E542K、E545K和H1047R。分子对接显示alpelisib对野生型和突变型（E542K、E545K和H1047R）p110α形式均具有强结合亲和力。CHA与H1047R突变体表现出最低结合能，对接评分为-9.93 kcal/mol。分子动力学模拟显示alpelisib与野生型、E542K和E545K突变体具有稳定相互作用，而CHA仅与H1047R突变体表现出稳定相互作用。MM-PBSA计算确认alpelisib-野生型p110α和CHA-H1047R复合物的结合自由能最低，分别为-29.21 kcal/mol和-25.88 kcal/mol。结论：这些发现为进一步的体外和体内研究提供了基础，以评估CHA作为靶向乳腺癌干细胞中H1047R PIK3CA突变的选择性PI3K抑制剂。

papers.title: Toward a minimal amino acid alphabet for protein design.
papers.authors: Pubal, Karel; Kushnir, Kseniia; Spiwok, Vojtech; Louzecka, Karolina; Setnicka, Vladimir; Lipovova, Petra
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算蛋白设计和逆折叠模型（ProteinMPNN）探索最小氨基酸字母表对蛋白质结构设计的影响，核心聚焦蛋白质结构设计问题，并采用AI方法，与课题高度相关。
papers.abstract: While proteins are built from 20 canonical amino acids, it is interesting to explore whether proteins can be formed from significantly reduced amino acid alphabets. Our bioinformatics survey of UniProt (more than 250 m sequences) revealed that proteins composed of reduced amino acid alphabets are extremely rare among existing proteins. Next, we used computational protein design to design proteins 100 amino acid residues in length composed of all 1013 possible alphabets of 2-10 early amino acids (Ala, Asp, Glu, Gly, Ile, Leu, Pro, Ser, Thr, and Val). Our findings show that small amino acid alphabets preferred simple helices or helix bundles, while larger amino acid alphabets allowed for the design of more complex structures. We verified a protein composed of 8 amino acid types (Ala, Asp, Gly, Leu, Val, Ser, Thr, and Pro) finding it adopts the beta-sheet-rich fibronectin type III domain architecture. However, attempts to experimentally verify designs composed of 6 and 4 amino acid types were unsuccessful. Furthermore, we show by computational experiment with experimental validation that inverse folding models, namely ProteinMPNN(sol), can stabilize a designed protein within the same eight-amino-acid alphabet. Ultimately, our results show that globular proteins may have formed early in evolution using a minimal amino acid alphabet and that it is possible to design such proteins with interesting properties for biotechnology and synthetic biology.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然蛋白质由20种经典氨基酸构建而成，探索蛋白质是否能由显著简化的氨基酸字母表形成颇具趣味。我们对UniProt（超过2.5亿条序列）进行的生物信息学调查显示，在现有蛋白质中，由简化氨基酸字母表组成的蛋白质极为罕见。接下来，我们利用计算蛋白质设计方法，设计了长度为100个氨基酸残基的蛋白质，这些蛋白质由2-10种早期氨基酸（丙氨酸、天冬氨酸、谷氨酸、甘氨酸、异亮氨酸、亮氨酸、脯氨酸、丝氨酸、苏氨酸和缬氨酸）的所有1013种可能字母表组成。我们的发现表明，小氨基酸字母表偏好简单的螺旋或螺旋束结构，而较大的氨基酸字母表则允许设计更复杂的结构。我们验证了一种由8种氨基酸类型（丙氨酸、天冬氨酸、甘氨酸、亮氨酸、缬氨酸、丝氨酸、苏氨酸和脯氨酸）组成的蛋白质，发现其采用富含β-折叠的纤连蛋白III型结构域架构。然而，尝试实验验证由6种和4种氨基酸类型组成的设计未获成功。此外，我们通过计算实验并结合实验验证表明，逆折叠模型，即ProteinMPNN(sol)，可以在相同的八氨基酸字母表内稳定所设计的蛋白质。最终，我们的结果表明，球状蛋白质可能在进化早期使用最小氨基酸字母表形成，并且设计具有生物技术和合成生物学有趣特性的此类蛋白质是可能的。

papers.title: Reconstructing hidden GPCR conformations and ligand binding modes through integrative DEER modeling.
papers.authors: Belyaeva, Julia; Elgeti, Matthias
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文整合DEER实验数据、深度学习结构预测和分子动力学模拟，重建GPCR隐藏构象及配体结合模式，核心聚焦蛋白质构象采样与结构计算建模，方法创新且可迁移至其他蛋白体系。
papers.abstract: Binding of biased ligands to a G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) stabilizes specific receptor conformations, leading to distinct physiological responses. Recently, intra-transducer bias has emerged as an additional mechanism that fine-tunes receptor function by stabilizing specific architectures of the receptor-transducer complex. This mechanism was demonstrated for the angiotensin receptor (AT1R) and its beta-arrestin-biased ligand TRV026, which selectively promotes beta-arrestin-1 engagement via the receptor C terminus while preventing interaction with the receptor core. Here, we present a computational protocol integrating double electron-electron resonance (DEER) data with deep learning-based structure prediction and molecular dynamics simulations to reconstruct all-atom models of TRV026-bound AT1R. Using a new clustering method, we identify key ligand-receptor interactions underlying high-affinity binding, localized receptor flexibility, and ligand bias. Our results provide a framework for validating neural-network predictions and physics-based simulations to capture rare signaling states of membrane proteins and identify target conformations for designing more functionally selective, efficacious therapeutics.
papers.abstract_zh: 偏向性配体与G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR）的结合稳定了特定的受体构象，从而引发不同的生理反应。近期，转导子内偏向性（intra-transducer bias）作为一种额外机制出现，通过稳定受体-转导子复合物的特定结构来微调受体功能。该机制已在血管紧张素受体（AT1R）及其β-arrestin偏向性配体TRV026上得到证实，后者通过受体C末端选择性促进β-arrestin-1结合，同时阻止与受体核心的相互作用。在此，我们提出一种计算协议，整合双电子-电子共振（DEER）数据、基于深度学习的结构预测和分子动力学模拟，以重建TRV026结合的AT1R的全原子模型。利用一种新的聚类方法，我们识别了高亲和力结合、局部受体灵活性和配体偏向性背后的关键配体-受体相互作用。我们的结果为验证神经网络预测和基于物理的模拟提供了框架，以捕获膜蛋白的稀有信号状态，并识别用于设计更具功能选择性和高效治疗药物的靶向构象。

papers.title: AtomWeaver: Multi-Component Flow Matching with a Structured Geometric Prior Facilitates Non-Canonical Peptide Design
papers.authors: Kitaygorodsky A; Hostallero DE; Broom A; Layne E; Hwang S; Kanawaty AK; Babej T; Butterfoss GL; Fingerhuth M
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出AtomWeaver，利用多组件流匹配和结构化几何先验，在固定骨架条件下生成非规范氨基酸肽序列，实现可扩展的推理时残基词汇选择，属于蛋白质序列设计领域的创新方法。
papers.abstract: Fixed-backbone sequence discovery, or inverse folding , is a critical recurring task in the development of new polypeptide therapeutics. Once promising backbones are established for a target pocket, computational inverse folding methods greatly help accelerate generation of candidate sequences. Such methods are mature for the traditional case of limiting to the fixed twenty-letter canonical vocabulary; however, they cannot access the broader space of non-canonical amino acids (NCAAs). This design constraint is exacerbated for peptide binders, a fast-growing modality that readily incorporates NCAAs, though in practice non-canonical design frequently depends on laborious medicinal-chemistry campaigns. An extension of inverse folding to NCAAs is thus critical to accelerating design of novel therapeutic peptides. AtomWeaver uses a joint all-site, atom-level generative scheme that does not restrict side-chain categorical assignment by either predetermined or co-resolving residue identity. Conditioned only on a fixed peptide backbone and its target protein, its multi-component flow guides side-chain atoms as unlabeled points in R 3 from a nested shell prior to a variable-count final atom cloud. Identity is then read by matching each predicted cloud against a reference library of canonical and non-canonical templates. Since identity is decided only at decode time, the addressable vocabulary is a property of the library rather than of the trained weights: a new NCAA costs one reference structure and no retraining, and the model can select residues it was never prompted for and never saw in training. On a deep mutational scan of two peptide–target systems, AtomWeaver’s canonical readout shows high observed mean agreement with experimental values among the compared inverse-folding methods. In the mixed canonical–noncanonical setting that canonical-only baselines cannot support at all, it likewise retains ranking signal across both systems. AtomWeaver also displayed self-consistent designs on de novo binder backbones, with the highest interface confidence among compared methods. Notably, it reached these metrics while achieving broad empirical coverage of our 300-residue vocabulary, including four non-canonical types never visible in training. AtomWeaver thus serves canonical and non-canonical peptide design alike, while transforming residue vocabulary to an expandable inference-time choice.
papers.abstract_zh: 固定骨架序列发现，或称逆折叠，是新型多肽治疗药物开发中的一个关键重复性任务。一旦为目标口袋确定了有前景的骨架，计算逆折叠方法便大大加速候选序列的生成。这些方法在传统上仅限于固定二十字母标准氨基酸词汇的情况下已相当成熟；然而，它们无法触及更广泛的非标准氨基酸（NCAAs）空间。这一设计限制对肽结合剂尤为突出，这是一种快速增长的模式，易于整合NCAAs，尽管在实践中非标准设计常依赖于繁琐的药物化学活动。因此，将逆折叠扩展到NCAAs对于加速新型治疗性肽的设计至关重要。AtomWeaver采用联合全位点、原子级生成方案，不通过预定或共解析残基身份限制侧链类别分配。仅以固定肽骨架及其靶蛋白为条件，其多组件流引导侧链原子作为R³中的未标记点，从嵌套壳先验到可变计数的最终原子云。随后，通过将每个预测云与标准和非标准模板的参考库匹配来读取身份。由于身份仅在解码时决定，可寻址词汇是库的属性而非训练权重的属性：一种新的NCAA只需一个参考结构且无需重新训练，模型能选择从未被提示过且训练中未见过的残基。在对两个肽-靶系统的深度突变扫描中，AtomWeaver的标准读取在比较的逆折叠方法中显示出与实验值的高观测平均一致性。在仅标准基线完全无法支持的混合标准-非标准设置中，它同样在两个系统中保留了排序信号。AtomWeaver还在从头设计的结合子骨架上展示了自洽设计，其界面置信度在比较方法中最高。值得注意的是，它在达到这些指标的同时，实现了对我们300残基词汇的广泛经验覆盖，包括四种训练中从未出现的非标准类型。因此，AtomWeaver同时服务于标准和非标准肽设计，同时将残基词汇转变为可扩展的推理时选择。

papers.title: Coupling of oceanographic state to the dark proteome: a foundation for genome-informed marine productivity modeling
papers.authors: Nelson DR; Plouviez M; Daakour S; Jaiswal A; Fu W; Amin SA; Salehi-Ashtiani K
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用蛋白语言模型和AlphaFold 3分析海洋浮游植物蛋白组与环境耦合，虽涉及蛋白质结构预测，但核心是生态学建模而非蛋白质结构计算问题。
papers.abstract:
ABSTRACT

Phytoplankton drive ∼ 46% of global primary production, yet whether their protein repertoires encode ocean conditions—and whether reference databases capture the environmentally responsive fraction—is unknown. We used a protein language model to classify 447.7 million proteins from 2,357 samples and analyzed domain profiles for 231.7 million algal proteins across 2,044 samples. Under spatial block cross-validation, environment predicted individual domain abundances at R 2 up to 0.59, while domain profiles predicted sea surface temperature at R 2 = 0.38. The strongest coupling lay beyond annotated sequence space: 33,950 families clustered from 201 million Pfam-dark proteins coupled to environment 2.29-fold more strongly than Pfam domains. Cross-taxonomic selection, protein language modeling, and AlphaFold 3 predictions of 138 well-folded, InterPro-unannotated representatives support the Pfam-dark proteome as a biologically structured evolutionary compartment. Thus, the proteins most tightly coupled to ocean state are those least represented in reference databases.

GRAPHICAL ABSTRACT

Language modeling with AI for algal amino acid Sequence Representation (LA 4 SR) classified 447.7 million proteins from a 2,357-sample input collection; the 2,044-sample domain-analysis set contained 231.7 million proteins classified as algal. Protein domain composition and ocean state predict each other, and 33,950 Pfam-dark protein families show 2.29-fold stronger environmental coupling than Pfam domains.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要

浮游植物驱动约46%的全球初级生产力，但其蛋白质组库是否编码海洋状况——以及参考数据库是否捕获环境响应部分——尚属未知。我们使用蛋白质语言模型对来自2,357个样本的4.477亿个蛋白质进行分类，并分析了来自2,044个样本的2.317亿个藻类蛋白质的结构域谱。在空间块交叉验证下，环境预测单个结构域丰度的R²最高达0.59，而结构域谱预测海表温度的R²为0.38。最强的耦合存在于注释序列空间之外：从2.01亿个Pfam-dark蛋白质中聚类出的33,950个家族，其与环境耦合强度比Pfam结构域高2.29倍。跨分类选择、蛋白质语言建模以及对138个折叠良好、InterPro未注释代表的AlphaFold 3预测，支持Pfam-dark蛋白质组作为生物学结构化的进化区室。因此，与海洋状态耦合最紧密的蛋白质，恰恰是参考数据库中代表性最差的那些。

图形摘要

使用AI进行藻类氨基酸序列表示的语言建模（LA⁴SR）对来自2,357个样本输入集合的4.477亿个蛋白质进行了分类；2,044个样本的结构域分析集包含2.317亿个被分类为藻类的蛋白质。蛋白质结构域组成与海洋状态相互预测，且33,950个Pfam-dark蛋白质家族显示出比Pfam结构域强2.29倍的环境耦合。

papers.title: RNASeek: A Cross-Phyla Generative Foundation Model for Multipurpose RNA Modeling and Reinforcement Learning-Based Design
papers.authors: Shiyuan Chen; Neil R. Fernandes; Wei Vivian Li; Lili Wang; Zhenyu Jia; Joy S. Xiang
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出RNA生成式基础模型RNASeek，用于RNA序列建模与功能设计，虽对象为RNA而非蛋白质，但其预训练-预测-强化学习优化框架可迁移至蛋白质结构/序列设计，对课题有借鉴价值。
papers.abstract: RNA plays central roles in regulating information flow and provides a versatile substrate for engineering biological functions. While large language models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing and protein design, a general framework connecting RNA foundation models to functional sequence design remains limited. Here, we present RNASeek, a 1.6-billion-parameter generative foundation model built on a DeepSeek architecture and trained on a cross-phyla transcriptomic corpus for RNA sequence representation and generation. Natural-language tokens enable flexible conditional prediction and sequence design using a unified backbone. RNASeek captures species-specific transcript features and intron–exon boundaries in a zero-shot setting. We then fine-tune RNASeek to predict ribozyme self-cleavage activity and viral mRNA stability, revealing interpretable sequence features associated with function, including ribozyme loop flexibility and stem stability, as well as AU-rich motifs associated with mRNA stability. We use these functional predictors as reward models and apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to update RNASeek’s generation policy toward sequences with desired properties. GRPO-guided generation produces faster-cleaving ribozymes and stability-enhancing 3′ UTRs while satisfying user-specified IUPAC constraints. Experimentally validated RNASeek-generated ribozymes achieve wild-type levels of activity, while RNASeek-generated 3′ UTR sequences exceed the performance of the training data and benchmarked AI-generated 3′ UTRs. Together, RNASeek establishes a unified pretrain–predict–optimize framework that connects learned RNA function to controllable de novo sequence design and provides a general strategy for engineering regulatory RNAs with desired properties.
papers.abstract_zh: RNA在调控信息流动中发挥核心作用，并为工程化生物功能提供了多功能底物。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）已变革自然语言处理和蛋白质设计，但将RNA基础模型与功能性序列设计相连接的一般框架仍较为有限。在此，我们提出RNASeek，一个基于DeepSeek架构构建的16亿参数生成式基础模型，并在跨门类转录组语料库上训练，用于RNA序列表示和生成。自然语言标记使得通过统一骨干网络实现灵活的条件预测和序列设计成为可能。RNASeek在零样本设置下捕获物种特异性转录特征和内含子-外显子边界。随后，我们对RNASeek进行微调，以预测核酶自切割活性和病毒mRNA稳定性，揭示与功能相关的可解释序列特征，包括核酶环灵活性和茎稳定性，以及与mRNA稳定性相关的AU富集基序。我们使用这些功能预测器作为奖励模型，并应用组相对策略优化（GRPO）更新RNASeek的生成策略，以朝向具有所需特性的序列。GRPO引导的生成产生更快切割的核酶和增强稳定性的3′ UTR，同时满足用户指定的IUPAC约束。实验验证的RNASeek生成核酶达到野生型水平的活性，而RNASeek生成的3′ UTR序列超过训练数据和基准测试的AI生成3′ UTR的性能。综上，RNASeek建立了一个统一的预训练-预测-优化框架，将学习的RNA功能与可控的从头序列设计相连接，并为工程化具有所需特性的调控RNA提供了一般策略。

papers.title: Quantitative machine learning of protein interactions reveals the multiscale organization and molecular syntax of signaling networks
papers.authors: Julia R. Rogers; Loren P. Cardani; Neel H. Shah; Mohammed AlQuraishi
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用统计力学建模和神经网络预测蛋白-肽段结合亲和力，构建信号网络定量图谱，虽非直接结构预测/采样，但以蛋白相互作用结构机制为核心，方法可迁移至蛋白结构计算。
papers.abstract: Cells employ dense networks of transient protein–protein interactions mediated by modular peptide-binding domains and unstructured peptidic motifs for high-fidelity information processing. How these networks physically execute computations through protein interactions governed by complex intra- and intermolecular mechanisms remains indiscernible from current, sparse and non-quantitative, maps of the human interactome. Here, we introduce a quantitative statistical mechanical modeling (QSM) approach for machine learning domain–peptide affinities with experimental-level accuracy. Leveraging a new, principled algorithm for data harmonization and a biophysically informed neural network architecture, QSM learns to predict dissociation constants directly from amino acid sequences with calibrated confidence. We use QSM to construct the first quantitative drafts of human signaling networks and study these networks across three physical scales—recognition mechanisms of modular binding domains, combinatorial logic of multi-dentate proteins, and pathways inferred from de novo inference of protein interaction networks. We find that (i) modular domains, based on their binding preferences, selectivities, and strengths, fall into a limited number of biophysical equivalence groups, (ii) those domains, along with peptidic motifs, are “syntactically” combined within proteins to yield multivalent recognition mechanisms, and (iii) the organization of cellular function can be traced back to algorithmically detectable modules induced by domain-mediated interactions. In aggregate, these analyses instantiate a tractable roadmap towards a comprehensive, mechanistic, and simulatable articulation of the systems biology of signaling.
papers.abstract_zh: 细胞利用由模块化肽结合结构域和非结构化肽基序介导的瞬时蛋白-蛋白相互作用密集网络，进行高保真信息处理。这些网络如何通过受复杂分子内和分子间机制调控的蛋白质相互作用物理地执行计算，目前仍无法从现有稀疏且非定量的人类互作组图谱中辨别。在此，我们引入一种定量统计力学建模（QSM）方法，用于以实验级精度机器学习结构域-肽亲和力。利用一种新的、有原则的数据协调算法和生物物理信息化的神经网络架构，QSM学习直接从氨基酸序列预测解离常数，并带有校准的置信度。我们使用QSM构建人类信号网络的首次定量草图，并在三个物理尺度上研究这些网络——模块化结合结构域的识别机制、多齿蛋白的组合逻辑，以及从头推断蛋白相互作用网络所推导的路径。我们发现：（i）模块化结构域，基于其结合偏好、选择性和强度，归入有限数量的生物物理等价组；（ii）这些结构域连同肽基序，在蛋白质内以“句法”方式组合，产生多价识别机制；（iii）细胞功能的组织可追溯至由结构域介导相互作用诱导的算法可检测模块。总体而言，这些分析为实现信号系统生物学的全面、机制性和可模拟化阐述提供了一条可行的路线图。

papers.title: Discriminating betacoronavirus receptor usage across subgenera using protein structure prediction and molecular dynamics
papers.authors: Shruthi S. Garimella; Guadalupe Lauro; Vardhan Peddamallu; Parth R. Bandivadekar; Anugraha Thyagatur; Roland Faller; Surl-Hee Ahn; Priya S. Shah
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用AlphaFold结构预测与分子动力学模拟，区分不同亚属β冠状病毒与ACE2受体的结合能力，属于蛋白质结构预测与动态模拟在病毒-受体相互作用中的计算应用，方法创新且直接相关。
papers.abstract: A critical step in the emergence of a virus is the ability of the viral protein to bind a host receptor and mediate cell entry. For many coronaviruses, this interaction occurs between the Spike S1 subunit and the human ACE2 receptor. Whether this binding interface can be computationally distinguished across unstudied viruses without experimentally resolved protein structures remains an open question. We predicted how 28 emerging coronaviruses may bind to human ACE2 using structural predictions, static interaction prediction programs, and molecular dynamics simulations. To screen the emerging coronaviruses, we predicted a library of S1 structures using AlphaFold. These predicted structures were then used to model the S1-ACE2 interaction with AlphaFold, ClusPro, and HADDOCK. We used known ACE2-binding sarbecoviruses as positive controls and coronaviruses that bind other receptors as negative controls to threshold predicted binding. Contact analysis quantified the predicted binding and revealed that these static interaction prediction methods varied in discriminative power. Less restrained static predictions separated binders from non-binders, whereas heavily restrained docking did not, potentially forcing an interaction where none should exist. This analysis highlighted an emerging coronavirus, Zhejiang2013, as a potential ACE2 binder. We used molecular dynamics simulations to further assess the static predictions and model the interaction over time. Overall, our results indicate that Zhejiang2013 exhibits dynamic interaction patterns consistent with ACE2 binding. Given that two ACE2-binding coronaviruses have caused global pandemics within the past two decades, identifying potential ACE2 binders is critical for early warning and pandemic preparedness.
papers.abstract_zh: 病毒出现的一个关键步骤是病毒蛋白结合宿主受体并介导细胞进入的能力。对于许多冠状病毒而言，这种相互作用发生在Spike S1亚基与人类ACE2受体之间。在没有实验解析蛋白质结构的情况下，这一结合界面能否通过计算方法在未研究的病毒中区分，仍是一个未解问题。我们利用结构预测、静态相互作用预测程序和分子动力学模拟，预测了28种新兴冠状病毒可能如何与人类ACE2结合。为筛选这些新兴冠状病毒，我们使用AlphaFold预测了一个S1结构库。这些预测结构随后用于通过AlphaFold、ClusPro和HADDOCK模拟S1-ACE2相互作用。我们以已知的ACE2结合型sarbecoviruses作为阳性对照，以结合其他受体的冠状病毒作为阴性对照，来设定预测结合阈值。接触分析量化了预测结合，并揭示这些静态相互作用预测方法在区分能力上存在差异。约束较少的静态预测能区分结合者与非结合者，而高度约束的对接则未能做到，可能强制产生了本不存在的相互作用。该分析突出了一种新兴冠状病毒Zhejiang2013，作为潜在的ACE2结合者。我们使用分子动力学模拟进一步评估静态预测，并随时间模拟相互作用。总体而言，我们的结果表明，Zhejiang2013表现出与ACE2结合一致的动态相互作用模式。鉴于两种ACE2结合型冠状病毒在过去二十年内引发了全球大流行，识别潜在的ACE2结合者对于早期预警和大流行防范至关重要。

papers.title: De novo design of flexible protein interactions with GuideFlip
papers.authors: Kai Yi; Qingchao Chen; Dongqi Zhang; Pengfei Tian; Jane L. Wagstaff; Stephen H. McLaughlin; Christopher G. Tate; Kiarash Jamali; Sjors H. W. Scheres
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出GuideFlip，通过引导式离散流匹配协同设计蛋白质结构与序列，针对柔性靶标（如无序蛋白）实现从头设计蛋白结合剂，并实验验证了高命中率，属于蛋白质结构计算设计的前沿方法创新。
papers.abstract: De novo design of protein binders requires a target structure. However, for flexible targets, such as intrinsically disordered proteins, this structure does not exist until the binder has stabilized the interaction. Such targets are therefore difficult for methods that separate structure generation from sequence design. We introduce GuideFlip, which co-designs structure and sequence through guided discrete flow matching: binder residues are assigned progressively while the complex is re-predicted at each step, allowing the evolving interface to affect the design process. GuideFlip reduces the hydrophobic bias of direct AlphaFold optimization and improves in silico success rates over existing approaches. We release a database of binder candidates for 177 human disordered proteins. Experimentally, we obtain de novo binders to the carboxy terminus of α -synuclein and the disordered amino terminus of RBX1 with hit rates of 13.5% and 41.7%, respectively, and we confirm the epitopes of selected binders by NMR and mutagenesis. Applying GuideFlip to flexibility on the binder side, we design a nanobody that binds the agonist-bound β 1 -adrenergic receptor in its active state, but not the receptor in its inactive state, with a 75% hit rate and a cryo-EM structure confirming the design. GuideFlip enables protein design where bound structures emerge only upon binding.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白结合物的从头设计需要目标结构。然而，对于柔性目标，例如固有无序蛋白，这种结构在结合物稳定相互作用之前并不存在。因此，这类目标对于将结构生成与序列设计分离的方法而言是困难的。我们引入了GuideFlip，它通过引导式离散流匹配协同设计结构和序列：结合物残基逐步分配，同时每一步重新预测复合物，使不断演化的界面影响设计过程。GuideFlip减少了直接AlphaFold优化的疏水偏好，并提高了现有方法的计算机模拟成功率。我们发布了一个包含177个人类无序蛋白结合物候选物的数据库。实验上，我们获得了针对α-突触核蛋白羧基末端和RBX1无序氨基末端的从头结合物，命中率分别为13.5%和41.7%，并通过核磁共振和突变实验确认了选定结合物的表位。将GuideFlip应用于结合物侧的柔性，我们设计了一种纳米抗体，它能结合激动剂结合的β1-肾上腺素能受体处于活性状态，但不结合非活性状态的受体，命中率为75%，冷冻电镜结构确认了该设计。GuideFlip使得在结合结构仅于结合时出现的蛋白质设计成为可能。

papers.title: Target-Specific De Novo Drug Design via Fine-Tuned Language Models and Molecular Docking, Molecular Dynamics Simulation Validation
papers.authors: Phuong Nguyen
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用微调语言模型从蛋白序列生成配体SELFIES，并结合分子对接和MD验证，虽以配体设计为核心，但涉及蛋白-配体结构相互作用计算，算法框架对蛋白结构相关计算有借鉴意义。
papers.abstract: De novo drug design remains an expensive and low-yield process, particularly for targets with limited bioactivity data. In this study, we fine-tuned the Qwen 2.5 0.5B model to treat ligand design as a sequence-to-sequence task from protein amino acid sequences to molecular SELFIES representations. A curated and balanced dataset derived from ChEMBL was used to reduce target-level data imbalance, followed by systematic evaluation using beam search and stochastic sampling. The fine-tuned model demonstrated strong ligand generation capability across multiple targets, achieving high validity, uniqueness, and novelty. Comparative analysis revealed that beam search favored conservative exploitation of learned chemical space, whereas sampling enabled broader exploration and higher novelty. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and MM/PBSA binding free-energy calculations for representative targets showed that generated compounds formed stable complexes with energetically favorable binding profiles comparable to known inhibitors. Notably, target-specific fine-tuning under extreme low data conditions, enabled through molecular representation augmentation, successfully guided ligand generation toward relevant structural frameworks. Our work suggests that small language models can be effectively fine-tuned for structure-aware, target-specific ligand design, even under limited bioactivity information.
papers.abstract_zh: 从头设计药物仍然是一个昂贵且低产出的过程，尤其是对于生物活性数据有限的目标靶点。在本研究中，我们对Qwen 2.5 0.5B模型进行了微调，将配体设计视为从蛋白质氨基酸序列到分子SELFIES表示的序列到序列任务。使用源自ChEMBL的精选且平衡的数据集来减少靶点层面的数据不平衡，随后通过束搜索和随机采样进行系统评估。微调后的模型在多个靶点上展现出强大的配体生成能力，实现了高有效性、独特性和新颖性。比较分析显示，束搜索倾向于对已学习化学空间进行保守性利用，而采样则能够实现更广泛的探索和更高的新颖性。针对代表性靶点的分子对接、分子动力学模拟以及MM/PBSA结合自由能计算表明，生成的化合物形成了稳定的复合物，其结合特征在能量上有利，与已知抑制剂相当。值得注意的是，在极端低数据条件下，通过分子表示增强实现的靶点特异性微调，成功引导了配体生成朝向相关的结构框架。我们的工作表明，即使生物活性信息有限，小型语言模型也能被有效微调用于结构感知的、靶点特异性的配体设计。

papers.title: Atomic resolution structure of human papillomavirus bound to heparin.
papers.authors: Langley, Caroline H; Goetschius, Daniel J; Antolinez, Santiago; Orji, Ebere Precious; Bator, Carol M; Brendle, Sarah A; Christensen, Neil D; Hadden-Perilla, Jodi A; Hafenstein, Susan L
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜解析HPV与肝素复合物的原子分辨率结构，并辅以分子动力学模拟预测氢键，虽以病毒蛋白结构为核心且涉及MD方法，但主要贡献在结构解析而非蛋白质结构计算建模的方法创新。
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is a significant health burden and leading cause of virus-induced cancers. The mechanisms of HPV receptor binding and host entry are not completely understood, although it is known that heparan sulfate proteoglycans (HSPGs) mediate entry. HPV16 quasivirus, composed of L1 and L2 capsid proteins with a packaged cottontail rabbit papillomavirus genome was incubated with heparin. The complex was vitrified, and data were collected for cryoEM single particle analysis. Subparticles were extracted and hexavalent and pentavalent capsomers were refined separately. Here we present the resulting 1.9 A resolution structure, with heparin visualized around the capsomer at the icosahedral fivefold vertex. A model of the asymmetric unit was built unambiguously into the atomic resolution cryoEM map. Hydrogen bonds are predicted between L1 N-terminal regions, which are supported by molecular dynamics. The heparin binding site was identified, along with local L1 conformational changes and global flexibility changes. These changes induced by heparin binding likely reflect the structure of HPV during early stages of entry and provide a framework for future HPV biochemical, genetic, and biophysical studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）是一种重大的健康负担，也是病毒诱导癌症的主要原因。尽管已知硫酸乙酰肝素蛋白聚糖（HSPGs）介导病毒进入，但HPV受体结合和宿主进入的机制尚未完全明了。将含有L1和L2衣壳蛋白并包装有棉尾兔乳头瘤病毒基因组的HPV16准病毒与肝素孵育。复合物经玻璃化处理，并收集数据用于冷冻电镜单颗粒分析。提取亚颗粒，并分别精修六价和五价衣壳粒。本文展示了由此得到的1.9 Å分辨率结构，其中肝素在二十面体五重顶点处的衣壳粒周围可见。不对称单元模型被明确构建到原子分辨率的冷冻电镜图谱中。预测了L1 N端区域之间的氢键，这些氢键得到分子动力学支持。鉴定了肝素结合位点，以及局部L1构象变化和整体灵活性变化。这些由肝素结合诱导的变化可能反映了HPV进入早期阶段的结构，并为未来HPV生化、遗传和生物物理研究提供了框架。

papers.title: Thermodynamics and Kinetics of Dimerization-Coupled Fold Switching in the Chemokine XCL1.
papers.authors: Seifi, Bahman; de Souza, Greg; Wallin, Stefan
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化结构模型研究XCL1蛋白二聚化耦合的折叠转换热力学与动力学，属于蛋白质构象采样与结构计算问题，方法为物理模拟，与课题高度相关。
papers.abstract: Metamorphic proteins challenge the classical view of protein folding by reversibly interconverting between two distinct, stable native structures. XCL1 (lymphotactin) is a prototypical example, transitioning between a monomeric mixed- alpha/beta chemokine fold and an alternate all- beta fold that forms a stable dimer. Here we develop and apply a coarse-grained, structure-based model to investigate how temperature and electrostatic screening control this fold switch. By tuning the relative interaction strength of native contacts in the two folds, we show that the model qualitatively reproduces the experimentally observed temperature dependence of XCL1 fold populations, including an increasing alternate-fold population with increasing temperature. We introduce a sequence-dependent treatment of salt effects, which reveals a strong sensitivity of the fold equilibrium to salt concentration and yields a temperature-salt phase diagram with a broad coexistence region. Focusing on conditions near coexistence, kinetic simulations of the chemokine-to-alternate fold transition show that productive dimerization tends to occur when both chains are at least partially unfolded, and that formation of the final alternate dimer may proceed via an intermediate state characterized by a partially formed dimer interface. Finally, we use the model to examine how charge patterning in ancestral variants of XCL1 modulates the population balance between the two folds.
papers.abstract_zh: 变形蛋白通过两种不同且稳定的天然结构之间的可逆互变，挑战了蛋白质折叠的经典观点。XCL1（淋巴细胞趋化因子）是一个典型例子，它在单体混合α/β趋化因子折叠与形成稳定二聚体的替代全β折叠之间转换。在此，我们开发并应用一种粗粒化、基于结构的模型，以研究温度和静电屏蔽如何控制这一折叠开关。通过调节两种折叠中天然接触的相对相互作用强度，我们表明该模型定性地重现了实验观察到的XCL1折叠群体随温度的变化，包括随温度升高替代折叠群体增加的现象。我们引入了一种序列依赖的盐效应处理方法，揭示了折叠平衡对盐浓度的强烈敏感性，并生成了一个具有宽共存区域的温度-盐相图。聚焦于接近共存的条件，趋化因子到替代折叠转变的动力学模拟显示，当两条链至少部分解折叠时，生产性二聚化往往发生，且最终替代二聚体的形成可能通过一个以部分形成二聚体界面为特征的中间状态进行。最后，我们利用该模型检验XCL1祖先变体中电荷模式如何调节两种折叠之间的群体平衡。

papers.title: Bifunctional architecture enables substrate catalysis and channeling in Paracoccus TMAO demethylase.
papers.authors: Thach, Trung; Dhanabalan, KanagaVijayan; Maurya, Shiwangi; Han-Hallett, Yu; Quan, Senwei; Allison, Jane; Ramanathan, Gurunath; Subramanian, Ramaswamy
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜结构和靶向分子动力学揭示TDM酶底物通道化机制，虽以酶结构为核心但侧重实验表征，计算模拟仅辅助验证，方法贡献较弱。
papers.abstract: Substrate channeling enhances efficiency and prevents toxicity by directing unstable intermediates between active sites. Trimethylamine N-oxide demethylase (TDM) degrades trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO) to dimethylamine and formaldehyde (HCHO), but the fate of HCHO has remained unclear. We report cryo-EM structures of TDM in apo, substrate-, and product-bound states that reveal a previously unknown channeling pathway. Combined structural, biochemical, and target molecular dynamics analyses show that HCHO is generated in a catalytic core and guided through a tunnel to a remote tetrahydrofolate (THF)-binding site, where it forms methylene-THF. Thus, TDM emerges as a bifunctional enzyme that unites TMAO demethylation with one-carbon transfer, providing a mechanistic explanation for its role in metabolic efficiency and detoxification.
papers.abstract_zh: 底物通道化通过将不稳定中间体引导至活性位点之间，提高了效率并防止毒性。三甲胺N-氧化物脱甲基酶（TDM）将三甲胺N-氧化物（TMAO）降解为二甲胺和甲醛（HCHO），但HCHO的去向此前尚不清楚。我们报道了TDM在脱辅基、底物结合和产物结合状态下的冷冻电镜结构，揭示了一条此前未知的通道化途径。结合结构、生化和靶向分子动力学分析表明，HCHO在催化核心中生成，并通过隧道引导至远端四氢叶酸（THF）结合位点，在那里形成亚甲基-THF。因此，TDM显现为一种双功能酶，将TMAO脱甲基与一碳转移相结合，为其在代谢效率和解毒中的作用提供了机制解释。

papers.title: Attribution assignment for deep-generative sequence models enables interpretability analysis using positive-only data.
papers.authors: Frank, Robert; Widrich, Michael; Akbar, Rahmad; Klambauer, Gunter; Sandve, Geir Kjetil; Robert, Philippe A; Greiff, Victor
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出针对自回归生成序列模型的可解释性归因方法GAMA，虽以抗体序列为对象且不直接涉及蛋白质结构计算，但其生成模型归因框架可迁移至蛋白质序列设计中的结构相关分析。
papers.abstract: Generative machine learning models offer a powerful framework for therapeutic design, by efficiently exploring large spaces of biological sequences enriched for desirable properties. Unlike supervised learning methods, which require both positive and negative labeled data, generative models such as LSTMs can be trained solely on positively labeled sequences, for example, high-affinity antibodies. This is particularly advantageous in biological settings where negative data are scarce, unreliable, or biologically ill-defined. However, the lack of attribution methods for generative models has hindered the ability to extract interpretable biological insights from such models. To address this gap, we developed Generative Attribution Metric Analysis (GAMA), an attribution method for autoregressive generative models based on Integrated Gradients. We assessed GAMA using synthetic datasets with known ground truths to characterize its statistical behavior and validate its ability to recover biologically relevant features. We further demonstrated the utility of GAMA by applying it to experimental antibody-antigen binding data. GAMA enables model interpretability and the validation of generative sequence design strategies without the need for negative training data.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式机器学习模型为治疗设计提供了一个强大的框架，能够高效探索富含理想特性的广阔生物序列空间。与需要正负标记数据的监督学习方法不同，诸如LSTM之类的生成模型可以仅使用正标记序列（例如高亲和力抗体）进行训练。这在负数据稀缺、不可靠或生物学定义不清的生物环境中尤为有利。然而，生成模型缺乏归因方法，阻碍了从这些模型中提取可解释的生物学见解。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了生成归因度量分析（Generative Attribution Metric Analysis, GAMA），这是一种基于集成梯度（Integrated Gradients）的自回归生成模型归因方法。我们使用具有已知真实标签的合成数据集评估了GAMA，以刻画其统计行为并验证其恢复生物学相关特征的能力。我们进一步通过将GAMA应用于实验性抗体-抗原结合数据，展示了其实用性。GAMA使得模型可解释性及生成序列设计策略的验证成为可能，而无需负训练数据。

papers.title: Aspects of plant intelligence (ii).
papers.authors: Trewavas, Anthony
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文讨论植物智能的哲学与生物学定义，仅提及钙信号通过蛋白结构转导，未涉及蛋白质结构计算建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
papers.abstract: Plant intelligence was earlier described as adaptively variable behavior during the lifetime of the individual plant (Trewavas 2003). This general definition for animals and plants (biological intelligence) is now justified from generic terms and emphasis on adaptive behavior. Plant intelligence can also be defined from dictionary definitions of intelligence. Artificial intelligence has been indicated as adaptive behavior. Prominent psychological opinion now indicates that human intelligence is adaptive: IQ does not measure human intelligence. The uniformity of intelligence definitions negates views that plant intelligence is controversial. It is suggested that the early stages of transduction through calcium are interpreted through complex protein structures attached to mobile lipid rafts. Cell signaling acting as a cognitive process is investigated and evidence supports a relationship. Plants are biologically purposeful; they express goal-directed behavior throughout their life cycle and act as biologically purposeful agents in the wilderness. The demise of the Modern Synthesis of Evolution is indicated and could be replaced by one that correctly emphasizes biological purpose. Two sensory mechanisms are described for gravitropism as an illustration of the fail-safe mechanisms needed for all forms of behavior because true wilderness is often environmentally uncertain. Definitions of learning and memory are suggested and five kinds of plant biological memories are described.
papers.abstract_zh: 植物智能早前被描述为个体植物在其生命周期中表现出的适应性可变行为（Trewavas 2003）。这一对动物和植物的通用定义（生物智能）现基于通用术语及对适应性行为的强调而得到合理阐述。植物智能也可依据词典中对智能的定义来界定。人工智能已被指为适应性行为。当前重要的心理学观点表明，人类智能是适应性的：智商并不衡量人类智能。智能定义的统一性否定了植物智能具有争议性的观点。有人提出，通过钙进行的信号转导早期阶段是由附着于流动脂筏上的复杂蛋白质结构所介导的。细胞信号传导作为认知过程被研究，证据支持二者之间存在关联。植物具有生物目的性；它们在整个生命周期中表现出目标导向行为，并在荒野中作为具有生物目的性的主体行动。现代综合进化论的衰落已被指出，可能被一个正确强调生物目的性的理论所取代。本文描述了向地性的两种感觉机制，作为所有行为所需故障安全机制的例证，因为真正的荒野环境往往具有不确定性。文中提出了学习与记忆的定义，并描述了五种植物生物记忆类型。

papers.title: Granaticin biosynthesis and engineering: mechanistic understanding, production bottlenecks, and computational opportunities.
papers.authors: Chen, Chang; Zhao, Bingyu; Zhu, Qiaolei; Wang, Xiaodi; Ji, Nairu; Zhu, Yunping
papers.one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦天然产物granaticin的生物合成与工程改造，虽提及蛋白结构预测等计算机会，但核心对象非蛋白质结构计算，方法贡献较弱，仅边缘相关。
papers.abstract: Granaticin, as a member of the benzoisochromanequinone (BIQ) family, exhibits a range of biological activities, including antibacterial, antitumor, and antibiofilm effects. Notably, this compound displays a bright blue color under alkaline conditions, highlighting its potential application as a functional pigment.Although its biosynthetic gene cluster has been identified and partially characterized, efficient production of granaticin remains significantly constrained by an incomplete understanding of pathway regulation, enzymatic specificity, and metabolic flux distribution. Despite these advances, strategies for improving granaticin yield still rely largely on empirical approaches and lack predictive capability within complex biosynthetic systems. With the advancement of computational approaches-such as protein structure prediction, metabolic flux analysis, and data-driven optimization of fermentation processes-granaticin research is shifting from empirical optimization toward system-level and predictive engineering.This review systematically summarizes recent progress in granaticin research, with particular emphasis on biosynthetic mechanisms, pathway regulation, metabolic engineering strategies, tailoring enzyme functions, heterologous expression systems, and emerging computational approaches. In addition, the limitations of current engineering strategies and the major challenges associated with achieving scalable and controllable production are critically discussed.
papers.abstract_zh: Granaticin作为苯并异色烷醌（BIQ）家族的一员，展现出多种生物活性，包括抗菌、抗肿瘤和抗生物膜作用。值得注意的是，该化合物在碱性条件下呈现亮蓝色，凸显其作为功能性色素的潜在应用价值。尽管其生物合成基因簇已被鉴定并部分表征，但granaticin的高效生产仍受到对途径调控、酶特异性和代谢通量分布理解不足的显著制约。尽管取得了这些进展，提高granaticin产量的策略仍主要依赖经验方法，在复杂生物合成系统中缺乏预测能力。随着计算方法（如蛋白质结构预测、代谢通量分析和发酵过程的数据驱动优化）的进步，granaticin研究正从经验优化转向系统级和预测性工程。本综述系统总结了granaticin研究的最新进展，特别强调生物合成机制、途径调控、代谢工程策略、修饰酶功能、异源表达系统以及新兴计算方法。此外，本文还批判性地讨论了当前工程策略的局限性以及实现可扩展和可控生产所面临的主要挑战。

papers.title: Role of ligand-dependent conformational modulation of TNPO3 HEAT-repeat solenoid in nuclear import.
papers.authors: Chatterjee, Sonali; Maity, Atanu; Bahadur, Ranjit Prasad
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过微秒级分子动力学模拟和伞形采样自由能计算，系统研究了配体（SR货物、Ran核苷酸状态及磷酸化）如何调控TNPO3 HEAT重复螺线管的构象景观，揭示了核转运周期中配体依赖的构象通路，属于蛋白质构象采样的核心计算研究，与课题高度相关。
papers.abstract: Transportin-3 (TNPO3) is a HEAT-repeat nuclear transport receptor that mediates nuclear import of serine/arginine-rich (SR) proteins and interacts with Ran GTPase during nuclear transport cycle. Although structures of several TNPO3 complexes are available, how ligand binding modulates the conformational landscape of the receptor remains poorly understood. Here, we combine microsecond-scale molecular dynamics simulations with umbrella sampling free-energy calculations to investigate how SR cargo binding, Ran nucleotide state and cargo phosphorylation regulate TNPO3 conformational dynamics. Equilibrium simulations show that apo TNPO3 samples a broad conformational ensemble, while ligand binding substantially reshapes the conformational landscape. SR cargo protein stabilizes a partially extended solenoid architecture and introduces an energetic penalty to prevent further opening. Ran binding favours compact conformations of TNPO3 scaffold. Among these states, Ran-GTP produces the strongest confined conformational ensemble, while Ran-GDP allows broader structural variability. State-resolved structural analysis indicates that these energetic differences arise from ligand-dependent modulation of interface packing and hydrogen-bond networks. The modulation propagates across the HEAT-repeat array and alters global solenoid curvature. Reduction in phosphorylation of SR cargo weakens binding and increases conformational heterogeneity, highlighting the role of phosphorylation in stabilizing the TNPO3-cargo interface. These findings support a ligand-dependent conformational pathway, in which TNPO3 shifts from a flexible apo ensemble to an SR-bound extended state. This is followed by a structurally compatible intermediate shared with Ran-GTP-bound form before reaching compact Ran-GTP-stabilized state associated with cargo release. Together, these results provide a quantitative framework for understanding how ligand binding reshapes TNPO3 conformations during nuclear transport cycle.
papers.abstract_zh: Transportin-3 (TNPO3) 是一种 HEAT 重复核转运受体，介导富含丝氨酸/精氨酸 (SR) 蛋白的核输入，并在核转运循环中与 Ran GTPase 相互作用。尽管已有若干 TNPO3 复合物的结构可用，但配体结合如何调节该受体的构象景观仍知之甚少。在此，我们结合微秒级分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟与伞形采样自由能计算，研究 SR 货物结合、Ran 核苷酸状态及货物磷酸化如何调控 TNPO3 构象动力学。平衡模拟显示，无配体 (apo) 的 TNPO3 采样广泛的构象系综，而配体结合显著重塑构象景观。SR 货物蛋白稳定部分延伸的螺线管架构，并引入能量惩罚以防止进一步打开。Ran 结合有利于 TNPO3 支架的紧凑构象。在这些状态中，Ran-GTP 产生最强限制的构象系综，而 Ran-GDP 允许更广泛的结构变异性。状态分辨的结构分析表明，这些能量差异源于配体依赖的界面堆积和氢键网络调节。该调节跨 HEAT 重复阵列传播，并改变整体螺线管曲率。SR 货物磷酸化减少会削弱结合并增加构象异质性，突显磷酸化在稳定 TNPO3-货物界面中的作用。这些发现支持一种配体依赖的构象途径，其中 TNPO3 从灵活的 apo 系综转变为 SR 结合的延伸状态，随后经历与 Ran-GTP 结合形式共享的结构兼容中间态，最终达到与货物释放相关的紧凑 Ran-GTP 稳定状态。综合这些结果，为理解配体结合如何在核转运循环中重塑 TNPO3 构象提供了定量框架。

papers.title: Staged computational prioritization of lanmodulin binding-site designs for dysprosium-focused rare-earth separation.
papers.authors: Rahatul Ashakin, M D; Mahata, Avik; Khan, Raiyan; Andriotakis, Gregory; Provencher, Brian; Stuetzle, Christopher; Roosan, Don
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文开发了一个结合ProteinMPNN/LigandMPNN采样、Rosetta筛选和OpenMM几何筛查的分阶段计算流程，用于优先排序镧调素结合位点设计以实现稀土分离，虽对象涉及金属离子但核心是蛋白质结构计算设计，方法有创新但验证有限。
papers.abstract: Rare-earth separations are energy- and solvent-intensive, motivating aqueous protein-based alternatives. We developed a staged computational workflow combining four experimental lanmodulin templates, constrained ProteinMPNN and LigandMPNN sampling, score-only Rosetta triage, and an exploratory OpenMM geometry screen to prioritize a candidate for future reduced-cluster multireference characterization. The residue-role inventory comprised 70 category memberships representing 66 unique positions because four positions belonged to two roles. Fixed-seed sequence generation and subsequent triage yielded three finalist models. Three 100 ps OpenMM replicas were evaluated for each candidate-metal combination, yielding 45 simulations. Audit of the retained systems showed that amber19-all.xml and amber19/opc3.xml were loaded, but no explicit bulk-solvent molecules or counterions were present. The retained system XMLs and execution code contained a standard NonbondedForce and no verified C4/r4 implementation; the calculations therefore cannot be described as verified 12-6-4 simulations. Every replica produced a 3.2 A any-oxygen occupancy fraction of 1.000 using oxygen atoms present in the retained topology, making this descriptor non-discriminating. The Hans pocket and AM1/Mex descriptors each averaged four target-metal sites, whereas the Hans interface descriptor averaged 14 sites, including 10 on fixed chains B-D. Cross-topology distance comparisons were therefore not site matched. Within each topology, Al(III) and Fe(III) produced shorter model-dependent distances than Dy(III), Nd(III), and Y(III), but these observations are not binding free energies or evidence of selectivity. A dimensionless Composite Quality Index, CQI = 0.7L + 0.3G, ranked the Hans chain-A pocket model highest at 0.802 and was used solely for candidate prioritization. The workflow therefore identifies a model-prioritized candidate for further computation and experiment.
papers.abstract_zh: 稀土分离是能源和溶剂密集型的，这促使了基于水性蛋白质的替代方案的发展。我们开发了一个分阶段的计算工作流程，结合了四种实验性兰莫杜林模板、受限的ProteinMPNN和LigandMPNN采样、仅基于评分的Rosetta筛选，以及探索性的OpenMM几何筛查，以优先选择候选物用于未来的减少簇多参考表征。残基角色清单包含70个类别成员资格，代表66个独特位置，因为四个位置属于两个角色。固定种子序列生成及后续筛选产生了三个决赛模型。对每个候选金属组合评估了三个100皮秒的OpenMM副本，共进行了45次模拟。对保留系统的审计显示，加载了amber19-all.xml和amber19/opc3.xml，但不存在显式的体相溶剂分子或抗衡离子。保留的系统XML和执行代码包含标准的NonbondedForce，且没有经过验证的C4/r4实现；因此，这些计算不能描述为经过验证的12-6-4模拟。每个副本使用保留拓扑中存在的氧原子，产生了3.2埃任意氧占据分数为1.000，使得该描述符不具有区分性。Hans口袋和AM1/Mex描述符各平均了四个目标金属位点，而Hans界面描述符平均了14个位点，包括固定链B-D上的10个。因此，跨拓扑距离比较未进行位点匹配。在每个拓扑内，Al(III)和Fe(III)产生的模型依赖距离比Dy(III)、Nd(III)和Y(III)短，但这些观察结果并非结合自由能或选择性证据。一个无量纲的综合质量指数，CQI = 0.7L + 0.3G，将Hans链A口袋模型排名最高，为0.802，并仅用于候选物优先排序。因此，该工作流程确定了一个模型优先的候选物，用于进一步的计算和实验。

papers.title: Cytochrome P450 enzymes in the biosynthesis of bioactive diterpenoids from traditional chinese medicinal plants.
papers.authors: Zhang, Zheng; Li, Wei; Li, Hong
papers.one_liner_zh: 综述P450酶在中药二萜生物合成中的催化机制，并展望AI辅助蛋白设计，但核心是生物合成而非蛋白质结构计算建模，仅部分涉及结构预测和设计。
papers.abstract: Cytochrome P450 enzymes play key catalytic roles in the biosynthesis of diterpenoid natural products from traditional Chinese medicinal plants. Operating through a conserved heme-thiolate catalytic cycle and Compound I-driven oxidation, these enzymes mediate most post-cyclization oxidative tailoring of diterpene scaffolds, including hydroxylation, epoxidation, carbon-skeleton rearrangement, and lactone formation. This review surveys the biosynthetic pathways of seven representative diterpenoids, namely tanshinones, paclitaxel, triptolide, andrographolide, ginkgolides, forskolin, and oridonin, in which sequential site-selective hydroxylation and multifunctional catalysis are recurring features, whereas carbon-skeleton remodeling proceeds through pathway-specific modes, including Wagner-Meerwein methyl migration in triptolide, NIH-shift alkyl migration and dual C-C bond cleavage in ginkgolides, and oxidative oxetane-ring formation in paclitaxel, with lactone ring construction observed in the andrographolide, triptolide, and ginkgolide pathways. Atomic-level studies of representative enzymes CYP76AH1, CYP725A4, TOT1, and TmCYP1 further clarify how substrate recognition, regioselectivity, and catalytic trajectories are governed within the active site, providing a basis for rational enzyme engineering. Finally, the prospects of artificial intelligence-assisted protein design for engineering P450 catalytic elements are discussed, encompassing structure prediction, protein language model-based mutational prescreening, and de novo catalytic-pocket design, along with their potential to facilitate heterologous biosynthesis and the sustainable production of bioactive diterpenoids from medicinal plants.
papers.abstract_zh: 细胞色素P450酶在传统药用植物二萜类天然产物的生物合成中发挥关键催化作用。通过保守的血红素-硫醇盐催化循环和化合物I驱动的氧化机制，这些酶介导了二萜骨架环化后的大部分氧化修饰，包括羟基化、环氧化、碳骨架重排和内酯形成。本综述考察了七种代表性二萜类化合物的生物合成途径，即丹参酮 (tanshinones)、紫杉醇 (paclitaxel)、雷公藤甲素 (triptolide)、穿心莲内酯 (andrographolide)、银杏内酯 (ginkgolides)、毛喉素 (forskolin) 和冬凌草甲素 (oridonin)，其中连续位点选择性羟基化和多功能催化是反复出现的特征，而碳骨架重塑则通过途径特异性模式进行，包括雷公藤甲素中的Wagner-Meerwein甲基迁移、银杏内酯中的NIH-移位烷基迁移和双C-C键断裂，以及紫杉醇中的氧化性氧杂环丁烷环形成，同时在穿心莲内酯、雷公藤甲素和银杏内酯途径中观察到内酯环构建。对代表性酶CYP76AH1、CYP725A4、TOT1和TmCYP1的原子水平研究进一步阐明了底物识别、区域选择性和催化轨迹如何在活性位点内被调控，为理性酶工程提供了基础。最后，讨论了人工智能辅助蛋白质设计用于工程化P450催化元件的前景，涵盖结构预测、基于蛋白质语言模型的突变预筛选和从头催化口袋设计，及其促进药用植物生物活性二萜类化合物异源生物合成和可持续生产的潜力。

papers.title: Cross-Model Uncertainty-Aware Minimal Editing of Cis-Regulatory Elements for Cell-Type-Selective Design.
papers.authors: Xia, Angran; Wang, Changwei; Xia, Yemao
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文开发SafeEdit-CRE算法，通过跨模型不确定性感知的最小编辑优化顺式调控元件（CRE）以实现细胞类型选择性设计，虽涉及序列编辑和AI预测模型，但核心对象是非编码DNA调控元件而非蛋白质结构，且不涉及蛋白质结构预测、构象采样或对接等本课题核心问题，仅序列层面的调控设计方法对蛋白质序列设计有间接启发。
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Cis-regulatory elements (CREs) help mediate cell-type-selective gene expression, yet sequence-to-activity models are rarely converted into compact, experimentally tractable variant panels that retain natural regulatory scaffolds. We developed SafeEdit-CRE to select minimal edits that preserve cross-model specificity while reducing predictive uncertainty, yielding an auditable CRE variant library for reporter-screening prioritization. Methods: SafeEdit-CRE combines the published Malinois sequence-activity predictor with an architecture-distinct reviewer ensemble, validation-calibrated uncertainty, sequence-domain controls, and constrained beam search. Natural 200 nt CREs were edited under fixed substitution budgets of 1, 5, 10, or 20 nucleotides and evaluated by a separately trained multi-kernel ensemble kept entirely separate from candidate generation. Results: Across 600 held-out CRE parents in K562, HepG2, and SK-N-SH cells, SafeEdit-CRE achieved a mean cross-model specificity-margin gain of 0.877 versus 0.822 for greedy editing (paired difference 0.055; 95% CI 0.040-0.071). Relative to a compute-matched primary-model beam, SafeEdit-CRE yielded a similar cross-model specificity-margin gain (difference -0.004; 95% CI -0.011-0.004) with lower ensemble uncertainty (0.314 vs. 0.335). In a locked 90-parent benchmark, 60.6% of designs passed all nine prespecified sequence and model-agreement checks, compared with 38.8% for greedy and 13.1% for random substitution (paired difference 21.8 percentage points; 95% CI 18.3-25.3). Conclusions: SafeEdit-CRE reduced 3240 designs to 74 Tier A computational candidates prioritized for reporter screening across three cell types and four edit budgets. By separating search from cross-model audit and enforcing explicit edit budgets and sequence-domain safeguards, the framework provides a reproducible and auditable approach to computational CRE prioritization, regulatory-grammar studies, and synthetic regulatory-element design.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标：顺式调控元件（cis-regulatory elements, CREs）有助于介导细胞类型选择性基因表达，然而序列-活性模型很少被转化为紧凑且实验上可操作的变异面板，同时保留天然调控支架。我们开发了SafeEdit-CRE，用于选择在降低预测不确定性的同时保持跨模型特异性的最小编辑，从而生成一个可审计的CRE变异文库，用于报告基因筛选的优先级排序。方法：SafeEdit-CRE结合了已发表的Malinois序列-活性预测器与架构不同的评审集成、验证校准的不确定性、序列域控制以及约束束搜索。在固定的1、5、10或20个核苷酸替换预算下，对天然的200 nt CRE进行编辑，并由一个单独训练的多核集成进行评估，该集成与候选生成完全分离。结果：在K562、HepG2和SK-N-SH细胞中的600个保留CRE亲本中，SafeEdit-CRE实现了平均跨模型特异性边际增益0.877，而贪婪编辑为0.822（配对差异0.055；95% CI 0.040-0.071）。相对于计算匹配的主模型束，SafeEdit-CRE产生了相似的跨模型特异性边际增益（差异-0.004；95% CI -0.011-0.004），且集成不确定性更低（0.314对0.335）。在一个锁定的90亲本基准中，60.6%的设计通过了所有九项预设的序列和模型一致性检查，而贪婪编辑为38.8%，随机替换为13.1%（配对差异21.8个百分点；95% CI 18.3-25.3）。结论：SafeEdit-CRE将3240个设计缩减为74个Tier A计算候选，优先用于三种细胞类型和四种编辑预算下的报告基因筛选。通过将搜索与跨模型审计分离，并强制执行明确的编辑预算和序列域保障，该框架为计算CRE优先级排序、调控语法研究和合成调控元件设计提供了一种可重复且可审计的方法。

papers.title: Comparing YAP(WW1) and TAZ(WW): Similar Binding Sites but Different Stability and Conformational Dynamics.
papers.authors: Merlen, Clara; Mesrouze, Yannick; Chau, Suzanne; Diehl, Benjamin A; Hinniger, Alexandra; Zimmermann, Catherine; Meyerhofer, Marco; Fontana, Patrizia; Groebke, Svenya; Hinrichs, Jurgen; Abdul Rahman, Wassim; Gutmann, Sascha; Fernandez, Cesar; Petrovic, Dusan; Chene, Patrick
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究结合NMR、晶体结构和分子动力学模拟，比较YAP(WW1)与TAZ(WW)的结构稳定性及构象动态对配体结合的影响，属于蛋白质结构计算与实验结合的研究，但方法创新性一般。
papers.abstract: The two paralogs YAP and TAZ act through TEAD transcription factors and bind PPxY motif proteins in the Hippo pathway via WW domains. YAP has up to two WW domains, whereas TAZ has one. Because YAP(WW1) and TAZ(WW) are the most similar in sequence, they can be considered as corresponding modules in these two proteins. This study shows that, despite their similarity, they differ strongly in conformational stability and in how they bind flexible ligands. Nano-differential scanning fluorimetry, circular dichroism, and NMR indicate that both isolated domains populate partially folded or exchanging states in solution, but TAZ(WW) is more thermally stable and has a larger folded population. Peptide binding stabilizes both domains, producing sharper NMR signals. Surface plasmon resonance measurements with PPxY peptides show micromolar affinities and generally modest differences between YAP(WW1) and TAZ(WW), although these differences increase for conformationally plastic ligands. A high resolution LATS2:YAP(WW1) crystal structure and molecular dynamics simulations suggest that preorganized peptides bind more tightly and less selectively, while flexible peptides incur larger binding penalties that dynamic YAP(WW1) compensates more effectively. These observations indicate that differences in WW-domain stability contribute to subtle YAP/TAZ binding preferences despite conserved binding surfaces and evolutionary relatedness between the paralogs.
papers.abstract_zh: 两个旁系同源蛋白YAP和TAZ通过TEAD转录因子发挥作用，并在Hippo通路中经由WW结构域结合PPxY基序蛋白。YAP拥有最多两个WW结构域，而TAZ只有一个。由于YAP(WW1)和TAZ(WW)在序列上最为相似，它们可被视为这两种蛋白中的对应模块。本研究显示，尽管它们相似，但在构象稳定性和结合柔性配体的方式上存在显著差异。纳米差示扫描荧光法、圆二色光谱和核磁共振表明，两个分离的结构域在溶液中均部分折叠或处于交换状态，但TAZ(WW)热稳定性更高，且折叠群体更大。肽段结合稳定了两个结构域，产生更清晰的核磁共振信号。使用PPxY肽段的表面等离子体共振测量显示微摩尔级亲和力，且YAP(WW1)与TAZ(WW)之间差异通常不大，尽管这些差异对构象可塑性配体有所增加。高分辨率的LATS2:YAP(WW1)晶体结构和分子动力学模拟表明，预组织的肽段结合更紧密且选择性较低，而柔性肽段则承担更大的结合代价，动态的YAP(WW1)能更有效地补偿这些代价。这些观察表明，尽管旁系同源蛋白间结合表面保守且具有进化相关性，WW结构域稳定性的差异仍促成YAP/TAZ间细微的结合偏好。

papers.title: Unveiling Novel Metalloprotease Inhibitors Targeting Botulinum Neurotoxin Through Structure-Based Virtual Screening of Drug Libraries and Molecular Dynamics Simulations.
papers.authors: Sulaimon, Ridwan; Selvaraj, Gurudeeban; Chan, Nora W C; Hu, Anguang; Peslherbe, Gilles H
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过结构虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟，从FDA药物库中识别肉毒杆菌神经毒素金属蛋白酶抑制剂，属于蛋白质结构相关的对接与MD计算研究，但对象为毒素蛋白而非典型结构建模方法创新。
papers.abstract: Botulinum neurotoxin (BoNT) is one of the most lethal biological substances to humans, which inhibits acetylcholine release by the presynaptic nerve in neuromuscular junctions. Of the existing BoNT serotypes, BoNT serotype A (BoNT/A) is particularly potent, making it the primary focus in neurotoxin research. Its catalytic domain exhibits similar structural features and zinc-dependent activity as thermolysin, a key bacterial enzyme, which provides a foundation for designing antibacterial agents targeting related protease mechanisms. Repurposing of preapproved drugs or existing medications has recently proven an effective strategy to accelerate drug discovery. Accordingly, we employed drug-likeness screening, quantitative estimation of drug-likeness (QED), and molecular docking to screen about 9000 ligands from the FDA-preapproved drug library using the known crystal structures of the toxin's light chain, and we identified potential inhibitors with the highest binding affinity. We further refined our selection using molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the stability of the receptor-ligand complexes. The binding mode analysis and binding free energies of the receptor-ligand complexes provide crucial information about the mechanism of action of our top-ranked potential inhibitors. Notably, 16 ligands exhibit a binding affinity greater (in magnitude) than that of the hydroxamate inhibitors that are co-crystallized in the X-ray structure. Most of these ligands contain fluorine, carboxylic and phosphate moieties as key functional groups that enhance their interactions with key residues of the BoNT active site. Our results suggest that dinoprost and 15 other clinically investigated ligands may serve as candidate scaffolds for further evaluation as potential BoNT/A LC inhibitors, pending experimental validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 肉毒杆菌神经毒素（BoNT）是人类已知最致命的生物物质之一，它通过抑制神经肌肉接头处突触前神经释放乙酰胆碱而发挥作用。在现有的BoNT血清型中，BoNT血清型A（BoNT/A）尤其高效，使其成为神经毒素研究的重点。其催化结构域展现出与关键细菌酶热溶素（thermolysin）相似的结构特征和锌依赖性活性，这为设计针对相关蛋白酶机制的抗菌剂提供了基础。近期，重新利用已批准药物或现有药物已被证明是加速药物发现的有效策略。因此，我们采用药物相似性筛选、药物相似性定量估计（QED）和分子对接（molecular docking），利用毒素轻链的已知晶体结构，从FDA预批准药物库中筛选了约9000个配体，并识别出具有最高结合亲和力的潜在抑制剂。我们进一步通过分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟来研究受体-配体复合物的稳定性，以优化选择。受体-配体复合物的结合模式分析和结合自由能为我们排名靠前的潜在抑制剂的作用机制提供了关键信息。值得注意的是，有16个配体的结合亲和力（绝对值）大于X射线结构中共结晶的羟肟酸抑制剂。这些配体大多含有氟、羧酸和磷酸基团作为关键官能团，增强了它们与BoNT活性位点关键残基的相互作用。我们的结果表明，地诺前列素（dinoprost）及其他15种临床研究中的配体可能作为候选骨架，用于进一步评估其作为潜在BoNT/A LC抑制剂的潜力，有待实验验证。

papers.title: Molecular Engineering of Aptamers for Glioblastoma Therapy: From Simple Antagonists to AI-Driven Approaches, a Narrative Review.
papers.authors: Di Leandro, Luana; Colasante, Martina; Catanesi, Mariano; Giansanti, Francesco; Cimini, Annamaria; D'Angelo, Michele; Castelli, Vanessa; Savino, Rocco; Ippoliti, Rodolfo
papers.one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦胶质母细胞瘤适配体疗法的分子工程，涵盖化学修饰、多价架构及AI驱动的序列优化与结构预测，虽涉及蛋白质靶标结合和计算设计，但核心对象是核酸适配体而非蛋白质结构，算法可部分迁移至蛋白结构计算。
papers.abstract: Glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) is an extremely aggressive and lethal brain tumor, characterized by marked molecular heterogeneity, the persistence of glioma stem cells (GSCs), and the limited permeability of the blood-brain barrier (BBB), which collectively hinder therapeutic efficacy. To address these barriers, nucleic acid aptamers, short single-stranded oligonucleotides with high affinity and specificity for molecular targets, have emerged as a promising therapeutic platform. Early unmodified aptamers, such as AS1411 and U2, demonstrated target engagement but showed limited performance due to instability and rapid systemic clearance.
