Further investigation was carried out by converting the PDB structure into a lattice model using the LatFit tool for visual comparison with the VQE-predicted structure. In addition, quantitative evaluation was performed by comparing the VQE-predicted structure with the original PDB structure using Calpha Root Mean Square Deviation (RMSD) and Template Modeling (TM) score. Furthermore, the TM-scores obtained from the VQE predictions were compared with those obtained from the AlphaFold predictions. This work highlights the benefits of utilizing quantum algorithms to examine protein folding and also paves the road for future quantum biology studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白质结构与折叠机制的探索是分子生物学的基石，对理解生物功能和推进药物发现具有重要意义。传统计算方法，如AlphaFold、RoseTTAFold和I-TASSER，在该领域发挥了重要作用。然而，这些方法在预测训练数据中缺乏显著同源序列的蛋白质结构时，常面临广泛挑战，影响了对新型或特征不明确蛋白质的预测准确性。相比之下，量子计算通过变分量子本征求解器（VQE）等算法，为克服这些限制提供了一条有前景的途径。量子计算在优化问题（尤其是蛋白质折叠）方面仍处于早期阶段。本研究利用VQE的力量，探索了从RCSB蛋白质数据银行（PDB）中选取的15个肽段（每个由八个氨基酸组成）的折叠行为和低能构象景观。采用经典的100纳秒分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟来表征相应原子构象的结构稳定性和相对能量趋势。这些结果随后与使用VQE算法在IBM量子模拟器上执行的基于格点哈密顿量优化所得能量进行对比。尽管MD和格点哈密顿量模型之间的绝对能量尺度不同，但这种比较能够基于相关性评估VQE在识别物理上合理的低能折叠状态方面的有效性。结果表明，VQE始终收敛于具有竞争力的低能构象。进一步研究通过使用LatFit工具将PDB结构转换为格点模型，以便与VQE预测结构进行视觉比较。此外，通过使用Cα均方根偏差（RMSD）和模板建模（TM）分数，将VQE预测结构与原始PDB结构进行比较，进行了定量评估。进一步地，将VQE预测获得的TM分数与AlphaFold预测获得的TM分数进行了比较。这项工作突显了利用量子算法研究蛋白质折叠的优势，也为未来的量子生物学研究铺平了道路。

papers.title: Voltage-sensor conformational microenvironments encode isoform-selective ion channel activation.
papers.authors: Manville, Rian W; Foglia, Lorenzo; Yoshimura, Ryan F; Santos, Daniel E; Yu, Alvin; Abbott, Geoffrey W
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文结合MD模拟与电生理实验，揭示Kv7.3电压传感器构象微环境决定香紫苏酸异构体选择性激活机制，虽以离子通道为对象，但其构象采样与结合机制计算方法可迁移至蛋白质结构计算研究。
papers.abstract: Isoform-selective opening of voltage-gated potassium (Kv) channels is desirable for its therapeutic potential yet mechanistically little-understood. Rosemary leaf metabolite carnosic acid (CA) is a high-efficacy opener of the neuronal Kv7.3 channel but exerts minimal effects on Kv7.2 or Kv7.2/3 heteromers. Here, using alanine-scanning mutagenesis, electrophysiology, radioligand binding, and all-atom molecular dynamics simulations, we found that CA achieves high-efficacy activation of Kv7.3 by binding at the extracellular cap of the voltage-sensing domain (VSD), independent of the canonical retigabine pore binding site. Kv7.3 samples a binding-competent VSD conformation absent in Kv7.2, characterized by an expanded extracellular pocket and a favorable electrostatic environment. Central to this mechanism, Kv7.3-L226 functions as a hydrophobic latch that tunes the energetic landscape of the voltage sensor to control ligand efficacy. Unexpectedly, CA potentiates Kv7.2/3 activation by retigabine via ligand-initiated positive allosteric coupling between the VSD and pore, thus enhancing the anticonvulsant action of retigabine despite CA lacking standalone anticonvulsant activity. The findings establish a mechanistic framework in which isoform selectivity arises from VSD conformational microenvironments rather than canonical binding determinants and highlight the voltage sensor as a tunable target for developing selective Kv channel openers.
papers.abstract_zh: 电压门控钾（Kv）通道的亚型选择性开放因其治疗潜力而备受期待，但其机制尚不明确。迷迭香叶代谢物鼠尾草酸（carnosic acid, CA）是神经元Kv7.3通道的高效能开放剂，但对Kv7.2或Kv7.2/3异源多聚体影响甚微。在此，我们利用丙氨酸扫描诱变、电生理学、放射性配体结合及全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟发现，CA通过结合电压传感域（voltage-sensing domain, VSD）的胞外帽区实现Kv7.3的高效能激活，且不依赖于经典的瑞替加滨孔域结合位点。Kv7.3采样一种在Kv7.2中缺失的结合胜任型VSD构象，其特征为扩大的胞外口袋和有利的静电环境。该机制的核心在于，Kv7.3-L226作为疏水闩锁，调节电压传感器的能量景观以控制配体效能。出乎意料的是，CA通过配体引发的VSD与孔域之间的正变构偶联增强瑞替加滨对Kv7.2/3的激活，从而增强瑞替加滨的抗惊厥作用，尽管CA本身缺乏独立的抗惊厥活性。这些发现建立了一个机制框架，其中亚型选择性源于VSD构象微环境而非经典结合决定因素，并强调电压传感器作为开发选择性Kv通道开放剂的可调靶点。

papers.title: The Evolution of Artificial Intelligence in Antibody Design: From Structure-Based Engineering to Generative Models.
papers.authors: Szataniak, Ida; Packi, Kacper
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文综述了AI在抗体设计中的演进，涵盖结构预测与生成模型，虽为综述且对象为抗体，但核心涉及蛋白质结构计算与生成方法，对本课题有参考价值。
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed computational antibody engineering by enabling accurate prediction of antibody structures, rational optimization of therapeutic properties, and de novo antibody design. Recent advances in deep learning, protein language models, and generative AI have fundamentally changed the way antibodies are discovered and engineered. This review aims to present the historical evolution of computational antibody engineering, from early structure-based design strategies to modern AI-driven approaches, while highlighting the major computational tools, publicly available databases, current limitations, and future directions of the field. Methods: A comprehensive narrative review of the literature was conducted using PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar. Original research articles, methodological studies, and review papers published between 1985 and 2026 were evaluated. Publications were selected according to their scientific relevance, methodological quality, and contribution to the historical development of computational antibody engineering. Results: The review describes the progression of antibody engineering from phage display and structure-based computational methods to machine learning, deep learning, protein language models, and generative artificial intelligence. It summarizes key public databases supporting antibody research, discusses advances in antibody structure prediction and developability assessment, and reviews recent generative models capable of designing antibody sequences and structures. Current challenges, including limited experimental validation, dataset bias, prediction of highly flexible regions, model interpretability, and clinical translation, are also discussed. Conclusions: Artificial intelligence has fundamentally reshaped computational antibody engineering by integrating sequence, structural, and functional information into increasingly accurate predictive and generative frameworks. Although important challenges remain, recent developments indicate that AI-driven approaches will play an increasingly central role in the discovery and optimization of next-generation therapeutic antibodies.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标：人工智能（AI）通过实现抗体结构的准确预测、治疗特性的合理优化以及抗体从头设计，已彻底改变了计算抗体工程领域。深度学习、蛋白质语言模型和生成式AI的最新进展，从根本上改变了抗体发现与工程化的方式。本综述旨在呈现计算抗体工程的历史演进，从早期基于结构的设计策略到现代AI驱动方法，同时重点介绍该领域的主要计算工具、公开数据库、当前局限性及未来方向。方法：使用PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar对文献进行了全面的叙述性综述。评估了1985年至2026年间发表的原创研究文章、方法学研究和综述论文。根据科学相关性、方法学质量以及对计算抗体工程历史发展的贡献，对出版物进行了筛选。结果：本综述描述了抗体工程从噬菌体展示和基于结构的计算方法，到机器学习、深度学习、蛋白质语言模型和生成式人工智能的进展过程。总结了支持抗体研究的关键公共数据库，讨论了抗体结构预测和可开发性评估的进展，并回顾了近期能够设计抗体序列和结构的生成模型。还讨论了当前挑战，包括实验验证有限、数据集偏差、高度柔性区域的预测、模型可解释性以及临床转化。结论：人工智能通过将序列、结构和功能信息整合到日益准确的预测和生成框架中，从根本上重塑了计算抗体工程。尽管仍存在重要挑战，但近期发展表明，AI驱动方法将在下一代治疗性抗体的发现和优化中发挥越来越核心的作用。

papers.title: A spectral framework for measuring diversity in multiple sequence alignments.
papers.authors: Opuu, Vaitea
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于谱分析的Leff指标量化MSA有效多样性，并关联蛋白质结构预测精度，虽非直接建模但为结构预测提供数据质量评估工具，方法可迁移至蛋白结构计算。
papers.abstract: Machine learning (ML) methods for proteins and RNAs rely on multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) and related datasets such as experimental mutagenesis libraries, yet the amount of usable information they contain remains unclear. Here, a spectral measure of information is recast into an interpretable quantity for MSAs, denoted Leff, defined as the number of fully independent alignment positions that reproduce the observed sequence diversity. Applied to RNA MSAs, this measure shows that evolutionary constraints nearly halve diversity relative to the secondary structure alone, quantifying functional and phylogenetic restrictions beyond base pairing. The same analysis indicates even lower effective diversity in proteins, reflecting tighter packing and coevolutionary constraints. Leff further correlates with protein structure prediction accuracy, anticipating cases with insufficient evolutionary signal. When applied to experimentally and computationally generated libraries, it measures both produced diversity and cross-library overlap, quantifying novelty rather than redundant sampling. Together, these results establish Leff as an operational tool to estimate effective information in MSAs, anticipate modeling difficulties, and guide protein and RNA design.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对蛋白质和RNA的机器学习（ML）方法依赖于多序列比对（MSAs）及相关数据集，如实验诱变文库，然而它们所含可用信息量仍不明确。在此，一种谱信息度量被重新表述为MSAs的可解释量，记为Leff，定义为再现观察到的序列多样性所需的完全独立比对位置数。应用于RNA MSAs时，该度量显示，进化约束相对于仅考虑二级结构几乎将多样性减半，量化了碱基配对之外的功能和系统发育限制。同样的分析表明，蛋白质中的有效多样性更低，反映了更紧密的堆积和共进化约束。Leff进一步与蛋白质结构预测准确性相关，可预判进化信号不足的情况。当应用于实验和计算生成的文库时，它衡量了产生的多样性及跨文库重叠，量化新颖性而非冗余采样。综合来看，这些结果确立了Leff作为估计MSAs有效信息、预判建模困难及指导蛋白质和RNA设计的操作工具。

papers.title: When Riemann flows with Wasserstein: Generative Modeling of Probability Distributions on Manifolds
papers.authors: Doron Haviv; Edward De Brouwer; Rishabh Anand; Rex Ying; Aïcha Bentaieb; Gabriele Scalia; Hector Corrada Bravo
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出黎曼Wasserstein熵流匹配生成框架，在流形上的概率分布空间生成蛋白构象系综，属于蛋白质构象生成与AI方法结合的核心课题。
papers.abstract: Many scientific datasets, such as molecular conformational ensembles or single-cell tissue measurements, are naturally modeled as meta-distributions: distributions over probability measures on non-Euclidean domains. Existing generative methods largely assume Euclidean geometry and fail to capture this structure. We introduce Riemannian Wasserstein Entropic Flow Matching (RWEFM), a generative framework on the Wasserstein space $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ of a Riemannian manifold $(\mathcal{M},g)$. RWEFM is trained by regressing a neural vector field onto Riemannian optimal transport velocities, using McCann displacement interpolations as conditional paths. We confirm theoretically that this construction leads to a valid flow matching approach on $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ and introduce the Riemannian Entropic Map, a GPU-efficient approximation of the optimal transport map on manifolds. Our experiments show that by respecting the intrinsic geometry of the data, RWEFM can generate whole single-cell samples in hyperspherical latent spaces and protein conformational ensembles on the torus. As RWEFM requires only a geodesic distance and a projection operator, it is not restricted to manifolds with closed-form geometry, which we demonstrate by generating distributions on a general triangulated mesh.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多科学数据集，如分子构象系综或单细胞组织测量，天然地被建模为元分布（meta-distributions）：即非欧几里得域上概率测度的分布。现有生成方法大多假设欧几里得几何，未能捕捉这一结构。我们引入了黎曼Wasserstein熵流匹配（Riemannian Wasserstein Entropic Flow Matching, RWEFM），这是一个在黎曼流形 $(\mathcal{M},g)$ 的Wasserstein空间 $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ 上的生成框架。RWEFM通过将神经向量场回归到黎曼最优传输速度进行训练，使用McCann位移插值作为条件路径。我们从理论上确认了这一构造在 $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ 上导致有效的流匹配方法，并引入了黎曼熵映射（Riemannian Entropic Map），这是流形上最优传输映射的GPU高效近似。我们的实验表明，通过尊重数据的内在几何，RWEFM能够在超球面潜空间中生成完整的单细胞样本，并在环面上生成蛋白质构象系综。由于RWEFM仅需测地距离和投影算子，它不限于具有闭式几何的流形，我们通过在一股三角化网格上生成分布来证明这一点。

papers.title: Knowledge-as-Skill: A Structural Design for Autonomous Knowledge-Base Use by LLM Agents
papers.authors: Jiangxu Wu
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究LLM智能体的知识库组织设计，不涉及蛋白质结构计算，与课题无关。
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) gives large language models (LLMs) access to external knowledge, but its conventional retrieve-concatenate-generate pipeline makes retrieval decisions on behalf of the model. As tool use and agent loops become more reliable, an agent can decide whether to retrieve, what to inspect, and when to stop. This shift exposes a new bottleneck: the agent may not know what a knowledge base contains. Traditional knowledge bases expose documents as anonymous text chunks with limited information about scope, purpose, provenance, or relations. We propose Knowledge-as-Skill, an organization scheme that makes a knowledge base discoverable, navigable, and self-descriptive. It has three layers: a discovery layer centered on SKILL.md; a navigation layer with one index.md per directory; and a knowledge layer containing documents with YAML frontmatter for topic, type, provenance, and lifecycle. The design follows the Open Knowledge Format (OKF) and the Skill protocol without modifying the agent framework. We also provide knowledge-as-skill, a pipeline for converting heterogeneous collections of PDFs, Word files, web exports, and notes into this structure. In a preliminary evaluation on the WixQA enterprise customer-support benchmark, our setup obtains 0.889 Factuality and 0.816 Context Recall, compared with reported Corpus2Skill values of 0.767 and 0.708. It obtains slightly lower Faithfulness, lower Context Precision, and more interaction turns. Because the models, prompts, and knowledge-package construction differ, these results are directional cross-work evidence rather than a controlled comparison.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（retrieval-augmented generation, RAG）使大型语言模型（large language models, LLMs）能够访问外部知识，但其传统的检索-拼接-生成流程替模型做出了检索决策。随着工具使用和智能体循环变得更加可靠，智能体可以决定是否检索、检查什么以及何时停止。这种转变暴露了一个新的瓶颈：智能体可能不知道知识库中包含什么。传统知识库将文档暴露为匿名文本块，关于范围、目的、来源或关系的信息有限。我们提出知识即技能（Knowledge-as-Skill），一种使知识库可发现、可导航且自描述的组织方案。它包含三层：以SKILL.md为中心的发现层；每个目录包含一个index.md的导航层；以及包含带有YAML前置元数据（涵盖主题、类型、来源和生命周期）的文档的知识层。该设计遵循开放知识格式（Open Knowledge Format, OKF）和技能协议，无需修改智能体框架。我们还提供了知识即技能（knowledge-as-skill），一个将异构的PDF、Word文件、网页导出和笔记集合转换为这种结构的流水线。在WixQA企业客户支持基准的初步评估中，我们的设置获得了0.889的事实性和0.816的上下文召回率，而报告的Corpus2Skill值分别为0.767和0.708。它在忠实度上略低，上下文精确度较低，且交互轮次更多。由于模型、提示和知识包构建不同，这些结果是跨工作的方向性证据，而非受控比较。

papers.title: OMatG-flash: An All-Atom Flow Map with Reinforce Adjoint Matching for Scalable Materials Discovery
papers.authors: Thomas Egg; Harry Winston Sullivan; Ellad B. Tadmor; Stefano Martiniani
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出用于无机材料晶体结构预测与生成的流模型OMatG-flash，虽对象非蛋白质，但其全原子流映射与强化伴随匹配的生成框架可迁移至蛋白质构象采样与结构生成，对课题有方法借鉴价值。
papers.abstract: The discovery of novel inorganic materials drives technological breakthroughs in critical fields such as computing and energy storage. Generative AI has promised to accelerate the materials discovery pipeline, but state-of-the-art flow and diffusion models remain bottlenecked by the cost of proposing candidate materials. To address this, we introduce OMatG-flash, an all-atom flow map for inorganic crystal structure prediction (CSP) and de novo generation (DNG). OMatG-flash is a Pareto-optimal inference engine for materials, sampling candidate materials with an order of magnitude fewer inference steps and less wall-clock time than existing flow and diffusion models while demonstrating benchmark performance on par with the state-of-the-art. To enable post-training fine-tuning we apply Reinforce Adjoint Matching to flow maps, further improving match rates and RMSE on the unconditional CSP task. OMatG-flash showcases the potential of flow maps to accelerate generation of high-quality candidate inorganic materials and demonstrates a step forward in sample throughput necessary for data-hungry materials discovery workflows.
papers.abstract_zh: 新型无机材料的发现推动了计算和能源存储等关键领域的技术突破。生成式人工智能有望加速材料发现流程，但最先进的流模型和扩散模型仍受限于提出候选材料的成本。为解决这一问题，我们引入了OMatG-flash，一种用于无机晶体结构预测（CSP）和从头生成（DNG）的全原子流映射。OMatG-flash是一种帕累托最优的材料推理引擎，其采样候选材料所需的推理步骤和墙钟时间比现有流模型和扩散模型少一个数量级，同时在基准测试中表现出与最先进技术相当的性能。为支持训练后微调，我们将伴随匹配强化（Reinforce Adjoint Matching）应用于流映射，进一步提高了无条件CSP任务中的匹配率和均方根误差（RMSE）。OMatG-flash展示了流映射在加速生成高质量候选无机材料方面的潜力，并在数据密集型材料发现工作流所需的样本吞吐量方面迈出了一步。

papers.title: Deep Generative Crystal Structure Prediction: A Benchmark Study and a Controlled Test of Prototype Dependence
papers.authors: Lai Wei; Rongzhi Dong; Ying Feng; Madeline Miklos; Jianjun Hu
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文系统评估了12种深度生成模型在晶体结构预测中的表现，发现其性能高度依赖原型库，虽非蛋白质体系，但其对生成模型原型依赖性的基准测试方法可迁移至蛋白质构象生成研究。
papers.abstract: Deep generative models are widely reported to enable de novo crystal structure prediction (CSP), but their capability has not been measured consistently against template-based methods. We evaluate 12 representative generative CSP models, spanning latent-variable, diffusion, flow-matching, autoregressive, and manifold random-walk architectures, against TCSP 2.0 on 180 test structures and a leakage-controlled subset of 46. All methods use identical structure-matching, symmetry, and consensus criteria. Template retrieval is the strongest single method, reaching 68.3% top-1 success; symmetry-aware EquiCSP (66.4%) and Uni-3DAR (62.9%) form the next tier. However, comparison with TCSP 2.0 shows that most structures correctly predicted by generative models are also correctly predicted by template substitution. Thus, the set of structures uniquely reachable by generation is small, limiting its practical advantage for discovering structures outside existing prototype libraries. To test the source of this performance, we removed entire stoichiometric prototype families from the training set and retrained the strongest generative model. Accuracy declined by 50-78% across four families, establishing that performance is substantially prototype-dependent. A small minority of structures survived removal of their prototype family, demonstrating a real but limited retrieval-independent predictive capacity. Present generative CSP models therefore function largely as implicit, softer-edged prototype libraries rather than genuinely de novo predictors. Enlarging this residual capacity, rather than aggregate match rate alone, is the central open problem.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度生成模型被广泛报道能够实现从头晶体结构预测（CSP），但其能力尚未与基于模板的方法进行一致性衡量。我们评估了12种具有代表性的生成式CSP模型，涵盖潜变量、扩散、流匹配、自回归和流形随机游走架构，并与TCSP 2.0在180个测试结构及一个泄漏控制的46个子集上进行比较。所有方法使用相同的结构匹配、对称性和一致性标准。模板检索是最强的单一方法，达到68.3%的top-1成功率；对称感知的EquiCSP（66.4%）和Uni-3DAR（62.9%）构成下一梯队。然而，与TCSP 2.0的比较显示，生成模型正确预测的大多数结构也能通过模板替换正确预测。因此，生成方法唯一可达的结构集合较小，限制了其在发现现有原型库之外结构方面的实际优势。为测试这一性能的来源，我们从训练集中移除了整个化学计量原型家族，并重新训练了最强的生成模型。四个家族的准确率下降了50-78%，表明性能在很大程度上依赖于原型。少数结构在其原型家族被移除后仍能存活，展示了真实但有限的、不依赖检索的预测能力。因此，当前的生成式CSP模型主要作为隐式、边缘柔化的原型库运作，而非真正的从头预测器。扩大这种残余能力，而非仅关注总体匹配率，是核心的开放问题。

papers.title: FiberPro 1.0: Multiagent AI-Guided Design for High-Throughput Production and Conformal Deposition of Functional Protein Micro/Nanofibers
papers.authors: Longwen Li; Carter Moses; Yechan Noh; Charlie Hsu; Fatima Calderon Gutierrez; Cody Ruiz; Wenjie Liu; Juan Felipe Mogollón Molina; Kaiyu Fu; Huibin Chang
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用大语言模型多智能体框架指导蛋白质微/纳米纤维的高通量纺丝与沉积，虽涉及蛋白质材料加工，但核心是制造工艺优化而非蛋白质结构计算建模，与课题关联较弱。
papers.abstract: Functional protein micro/nanofibers integrate high specific surface areas with bioactive architectures but remain hampered low production throughput and severe processing instability. Focused rotary jet spinning (FRJS) shows promising to break these throughput constraints while enabling direct, conformal deposition onto complex, irregular substrates. However, navigating FRJS’s narrow processing windows in proteins remains failure-prone without closed-loop experimental guidance. Here, we report FiberPro 1.0, a large language model–driven multi-agent framework that unites high-throughput spinning with real-time experimental feedback for autonomous design, execution, and optimization. Across three protein systems, FiberPro 1.0 converged on spinnable formulations within an average of two iterations. To demonstrate high-throughput conformal deposition in a translational setting, FiberPro designed a zein-based active packaging system applied directly onto diverse food matrices. The resulting conformal coating combined potent antibacterial activity with real-time freshness monitoring, markedly suppressing Escherichia coli and extending shelf life. This work connects autonomous AI reasoning with high-throughput processing, establishing a verifiable route for scalable manufacturing and conformal coating of functional protein micro/nanofibers.
papers.abstract_zh: 功能性蛋白微/纳米纤维兼具高比表面积与生物活性结构，但其低生产通量和严重加工不稳定性仍构成制约。聚焦旋转喷射纺丝（FRJS）展现出突破这些通量限制的潜力，同时能够直接、保形地沉积到复杂、不规则基底上。然而，在缺乏闭环实验指导的情况下，在蛋白质中导航FRJS的狭窄加工窗口仍易失败。在此，我们报告FiberPro 1.0，一种由大语言模型驱动的多智能体框架，将高通量纺丝与实时实验反馈相结合，实现自主设计、执行和优化。在三种蛋白质体系中，FiberPro 1.0平均在两次迭代内收敛于可纺配方。为在转化场景中展示高通量保形沉积，FiberPro设计了一种基于玉米醇溶蛋白的活性包装系统，直接应用于多种食品基质。所得保形涂层兼具强效抗菌活性与实时新鲜度监测功能，显著抑制大肠杆菌并延长货架期。这项工作将自主AI推理与高通量加工相连接，为功能性蛋白微/纳米纤维的可扩展制造和保形涂层建立了一条可验证的路径。

papers.title: Structure-guided allosteric modulation of the delta opioid receptor.
papers.authors: Mobbs, Jesse I; Nguyen, M Deborah; Deo, Owindeep; Bartuzi, Damian; Venugopal, Hariprasad; Alvi, Sadia; Pham, Vi; Barnes, Nicholas; Christopoulos, Arthur; Poole, Daniel P; Carbone, Simona E; Jorg, Manuela; Capuano, Ben; Carlsson, Jens; Gondin, Arisbel B; Scammells, Peter J; Valant, Celine; Thal, David M
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜结构解析和分子动力学模拟，揭示了δ阿片受体正变构调节剂的作用机制，属于蛋白质结构指导的GPCR变构调控计算研究，与课题相关但侧重实验结构验证。
papers.abstract: Opioid analgesics remain essential for pain management but are associated with significant adverse effects, including respiratory depression, tolerance, and dependence. The delta-opioid receptor (deltaOR) represents a promising therapeutic target for developing safer opioid analgesics with reduced adverse effects compared to conventional mu-opioid receptor-targeting drugs. Positive allosteric modulators (PAMs) offer advantages over direct agonists by enhancing endogenous opioid signaling while preserving natural spatiotemporal activation patterns, potentially avoiding tolerance and dependence issues. Here, we present high-resolution cryo-EM structures of deltaOR complexed with the peptide agonist DADLE and the PAM MIPS3614, revealing a lipid-facing allosteric binding site formed by transmembrane helices 2, 3, and 4. MIPS3614 stabilizes the active receptor conformation through a critical hydrogen bond with residue N131(3.35) in the conserved sodium binding site, a key regulatory region controlling GPCR activation. Comprehensive mutagenesis, molecular dynamics simulations, and structure-activity relationships validate this proposed mechanism. Structure-guided optimization yields MIPS3983 with enhanced binding affinity and retained cooperativity. Our findings describe a molecular basis for deltaOR allosteric modulation and provide structural information relevant to the rational design of opioid therapeutics with improved safety profiles.
papers.abstract_zh: 阿片类镇痛药在疼痛管理中仍然不可或缺，但伴随显著的不良反应，包括呼吸抑制、耐受性和依赖性。δ-阿片受体（deltaOR）代表了一个有前景的治疗靶点，用于开发比传统靶向μ-阿片受体药物具有更少不良反应的更安全阿片类镇痛药。正向别构调节剂（PAMs）相比直接激动剂具有优势，通过增强内源性阿片信号传导，同时保留自然时空激活模式，可能避免耐受性和依赖性问题。在此，我们展示了deltaOR与肽激动剂DADLE及PAM MIPS3614复合物的高分辨率冷冻电镜结构，揭示了一个由跨膜螺旋2、3和4形成的脂质面向别构结合位点。MIPS3614通过与保守钠结合位点中的残基N131(3.35)形成关键氢键来稳定受体的活性构象，该位点是控制GPCR激活的关键调控区域。综合突变分析、分子动力学模拟和构效关系验证了所提出的机制。基于结构的优化产生了MIPS3983，其结合亲和力增强且保持协同性。我们的发现描述了deltaOR别构调节的分子基础，并为合理设计具有改善安全性的阿片类治疗药物提供了结构信息。

papers.title: Quaternionic response geometry for proteins: toward a noncommutative theory of ordered deformations.
papers.authors: Chen, Xiaoting; Kam, Chon-Fai; Li, Yu; Medina-Ortiz, David; Damour, Cedric; Chabriat, Jean Pierre; Miranville, Alain; Bessafi, Miloud; Cadet, Frederic
papers.journal: Theory in biosciences = Theorie in den Biowissenschaften
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于四元数框架的蛋白质有序变形几何理论，用于区分构象轨迹中的顺序信息，虽偏理论且未用AI/物理模拟，但为蛋白质构象采样和生成模型提供可借鉴的数学框架。
papers.abstract: Protein function may depend not only on endpoint conformations but also on the ordered deformation histories through which they are reached. This distinction is relevant to allostery, conformational switching, mutation-induced rearrangements, and epistatic effects, where different perturbation sequences may produce similar visible structures while retaining distinct internal transport histories. Current state-centered or endpoint-centered representations do not always preserve this order-sensitive information. The practical motivation is therefore to provide a foundation for future descriptors of protein deformation trajectories that can distinguish ordered histories even when endpoint conformations are similar. Such descriptors could support analyses of allosteric switching, mutation-order effects, conformational memory, and path-dependent response in molecular-dynamics trajectories, NMR ensembles, structural families, and outputs of geometric generative models. We propose a deformation-first geometric framework based on quaternionic frame transport along the protein backbone. Local backbone frames are lifted to quaternionic variables, with infinitesimal rotation encoded by [Formula: see text]. Ordered concatenation of admissible deformation paths generates a noncommutative transport algebra, recording that deformation [Formula: see text] followed by [Formula: see text] need not be equivalent to [Formula: see text] followed by [Formula: see text]. From this ordered transport layer, we construct a spectral-response layer comprising a global Dirac-type operator, local spectral germs, a renormalized spectral density, and a mixed response form. A minimal realization on an idealized alpha-helix shows how localized pitch and bending perturbations can yield similar endpoint descriptors while producing a nonzero endpoint-derived ordered-transport discrepancy. At the formal level, the framework separates an order-sensitive transport-memory sector, lost under a commutative shadow, from a spectral-response sector that remains visible.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白质功能可能不仅取决于终点构象，还取决于达到这些构象所经历的有序变形历史。这一区分与变构效应、构象切换、突变诱导重排以及上位效应相关，在这些情形中，不同的扰动序列可能产生相似的可见结构，同时保留不同的内部输运历史。当前以状态为中心或终点为中心的表征并不总能保留这种顺序敏感信息。因此，实际动机是为未来蛋白质变形轨迹的描述符提供基础，使其即使在终点构象相似时也能区分有序历史。此类描述符可支持对分子动力学轨迹、核磁共振系综、结构家族以及几何生成模型输出中的变构切换、突变顺序效应、构象记忆和路径依赖响应的分析。我们提出一种基于四元数框架沿蛋白质主链输运的变形优先几何框架。局部主链框架被提升为四元数变量，无穷小旋转由[公式：见原文]编码。可容许变形路径的有序串联生成一个非交换输运代数，记录变形[公式：见原文]后接[公式：见原文]不必等价于[公式：见原文]后接[公式：见原文]。从这一有序输运层出发，我们构建一个谱响应层，包含全局Dirac型算子、局部谱芽、重整化谱密度以及混合响应形式。在理想化α-螺旋上的最小实现表明，局部螺距和弯曲扰动如何能产生相似的终点描述符，同时产生非零的终点衍生有序输运差异。在形式层面，该框架将顺序敏感的输运记忆扇区（在交换阴影下丢失）与保持可见的谱响应扇区分离开来。

papers.title: Learning and extrapolating scale-invariant processes.
papers.authors: Alvez, Anaclara; Furtlehner, Cyril; Landes, Francois
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究尺度不变过程的机器学习外推预测，虽涉及自相似系统与生成模型，但核心对象非蛋白质结构，算法框架对蛋白构象采样仅有间接启发。
papers.abstract: Machine learning has deeply changed some fields recently, like language and vision. In the case of complex systems, spectacular breakthroughs happened too (e.g., for protein folding) and more are expected to come. Our question is: how and to which extent can one regress scale-free processes, i.e., processes displaying power law behavior, like earthquakes or avalanches? The events one is interested in predicting are the large ones, i.e., events that are typically rare in the training set, so we are basically in the extrapolation regime. While some recent works also tackle scale-free systems by proposing generative models closely aligned with the renormalization group framework, here instead we explore the problem of prediction in the extrapolation regime. We consider two paradigmatic problems that are statistically self-similar. The first one is a two-dimensional fractional Gaussian field obeying linear dynamics, self-similar by construction and amenable to exact analysis. The second one is the Abelian sandpile model, exhibiting self-organized criticality. The emerging paradigm of geometric deep learning shows that including known symmetries into the model's architecture is key to success (as translation invariance for images). Here one may hope to extrapolate only by leveraging scale invariance, which is, however, a peculiar symmetry, as it involves possibly nontrivial coarse-graining operations and anomalous scaling. We perform experiments on various existing architectures like U-net, the Riesz network (scale-invariant by construction), or our own proposals: a wavelet-decomposition-based Graph Neural Network (with discrete scale symmetry), a Fourier embedding layer, and a Fourier-Mellin Neural Operator. Based on these experiments and a complete characterization of the linear case, we identify the main issues relative to spectral biases and coarse-grained representations, and discuss how to alleviate them with the relevant inductive biases.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器学习近年来深刻改变了某些领域，如语言和视觉。在复杂系统方面，也出现了显著的突破（例如蛋白质折叠），并且预计还会有更多进展。我们的问题是：如何以及在何种程度上可以回归无标度过程，即表现出幂律行为的过程，如地震或雪崩？我们感兴趣预测的事件是那些大规模事件，即通常在训练集中稀有的事件，因此我们基本上处于外推（extrapolation）领域。虽然一些近期工作也通过提出与重正化群框架紧密对齐的生成模型来处理无标度系统，但我们这里则探索外推领域中的预测问题。我们考虑两个具有统计自相似性的典型问题。第一个是二维分数高斯场，遵循线性动力学，构造上自相似且可进行精确分析。第二个是阿贝尔沙堆模型，表现出自组织临界性。几何深度学习的新兴范式表明，将已知对称性纳入模型架构是成功的关键（如图像的平移不变性）。在这里，人们可能希望仅通过利用尺度不变性来进行外推，然而这是一种特殊的对称性，因为它涉及可能非平凡的粗粒化操作和异常标度。我们对各种现有架构进行了实验，如U-net、Riesz网络（构造上尺度不变）、以及我们自己的提议：基于小波分解的图神经网络（具有离散尺度对称性）、傅里叶嵌入层和傅里叶-梅林神经算子。基于这些实验和对线性情况的完整刻画，我们识别了与谱偏差和粗粒化表示相关的主要问题，并讨论了如何通过相关归纳偏置来缓解这些问题。

papers.title: Time-Dependent Voronoi Analysis of Amino Acid Side-Chain Packing in Simulations.
papers.authors: Bettencourt, Sofiya B; Hwang, Wonmuk
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用Voro++对分子动力学轨迹进行时间依赖的Voronoi分析，追踪氨基酸侧链堆积动态，以探测蛋白质构象变化前的细微结构变化，属于蛋白质结构计算模拟的应用性方法研究。
papers.abstract: Protein conformational motion depends on geometric and chemical constraints in side-chain packing. Thermal forces and incomplete packing produce "breathing" motions that allow internal rearrangement. Packing dynamics therefore inform protein allostery, conformational change, and folding. While Voronoi tessellation is a promising approach to this end, its application to proteins has been mainly focused on static structures. Here, the Voro++ library is adopted to investigate time-dependent amino acid packing in molecular dynamics trajectories of a titin immunoglobulin domain at 300 and 400 K. Tracking per-residue Voronoi volume changes and reorganization of neighbor faces in the Voronoi lattice reveals residue-level volume shifts and the corresponding timing of localized protein swelling. Side-chain motion into and out of the protein core can also be monitored by mapping neighbor switching. This framework is applicable to detecting delicate changes preceding protein conformational transition or unfolding, and analyzing protein-protein interface reorganization or surface hydration.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白质构象运动取决于侧链堆积中的几何与化学约束。热力与不完全堆积产生“呼吸”运动，允许内部重排。因此，堆积动力学为蛋白质变构、构象变化和折叠提供信息。虽然Voronoi镶嵌是实现此目的的一种有前景的方法，但其在蛋白质中的应用主要集中于静态结构。在此，采用Voro++库研究titin免疫球蛋白结构域在300和400 K下分子动力学轨迹中时间依赖的氨基酸堆积。追踪每个残基的Voronoi体积变化及Voronoi晶格中邻居面的重组，揭示了残基水平的体积变化及局部蛋白质膨胀的相应时间。侧链运动进出蛋白质核心也可通过映射邻居切换来监测。该框架适用于检测蛋白质构象转变或去折叠前的细微变化，并分析蛋白质-蛋白质界面重组或表面水合作用。

papers.title: Cryo-EM Pipeline for Actin Filament End Structures.
papers.authors: Palmer, Nicholas J; Dominguez, Roberto
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文描述了一套基于冷冻电镜和机器学习粒子挑选的肌动蛋白丝末端结构测定流程，虽以实验方法为主，但涉及结构计算处理，对蛋白丝状结构计算建模有参考价值。
papers.abstract: Actin filaments undergo dynamic growth and disassembly at their ends, regulated by many actin-binding proteins. However, structural analysis of filament end dynamics has been challenging due to the low abundance of filament ends in cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) micrographs, their intrinsic polymorphisms, and the diversity and flexibility of end-binding proteins. Here, we describe a standardized cryo-EM protocol for determining actin filament end structures. First, short actin filaments are generated either biochemically using capping or severing proteins or mechanically through shearing. Filaments are then vitrified under conditions optimized for each specific end-binding protein. We describe data collection parameters using a 300 kV Titan Krios G3i microscope, including optimized grid preparation and imaging settings. Finally, we present a data processing pipeline for filament end structure determination based on machine learning-based particle picking, masking, and sorting strategies. This protocol has enabled the determination of multiple high-resolution structures of free, capped, elongating, and depolymerizing actin filament ends, and we further discuss considerations for extending this approach to other end-binding proteins. Key features * Generation of short actin filaments for cryo-EM using capping proteins, severing proteins, or mechanical shearing. * Integrated data collection and image processing workflow for filament end structure determination. * Common challenges, solutions, and experimental considerations for diverse actin filament end-binding complexes.
papers.abstract_zh: 肌动蛋白丝在其末端经历动态生长和解聚，受多种肌动蛋白结合蛋白调控。然而，由于冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）显微图中丝末端的丰度低、其固有多态性以及末端结合蛋白的多样性和灵活性，对丝末端动力学的结构分析一直具有挑战性。在此，我们描述了一种用于测定肌动蛋白丝末端结构的标准化冷冻电镜方案。首先，通过使用封端蛋白或切割蛋白进行生化方法，或通过机械剪切，生成短肌动蛋白丝。随后，在针对每种特定末端结合蛋白优化的条件下对丝进行玻璃化处理。我们描述了使用300 kV Titan Krios G3i显微镜的数据采集参数，包括优化的网格制备和成像设置。最后，我们提出了一种基于机器学习粒子拾取、掩膜和分类策略的丝末端结构测定数据处理流程。该方案已成功测定了游离、封端、延伸和解聚肌动蛋白丝末端的多个高分辨率结构，并进一步讨论了将该方法扩展到其他末端结合蛋白的考虑因素。关键特征 * 使用封端蛋白、切割蛋白或机械剪切生成用于冷冻电镜的短肌动蛋白丝。 * 用于丝末端结构测定的集成数据采集和图像处理工作流程。 * 针对多种肌动蛋白丝末端结合复合物的常见挑战、解决方案和实验考虑。

papers.title: Constrained diffusion-enabled construction of a highly expressed and robust peptide asparaginyl ligase.
papers.authors: Pang, Shuo; Hao, Yuxing; Mo, Jiarong; He, Yingying; Cui, Yinglu; Wu, Bian; Hemu, Xinya
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用约束扩散模型生成序列并结合多模型引导突变，设计出高表达、高稳定性的肽天冬酰胺连接酶，属于蛋白质结构/序列设计计算与实验结合的核心课题。
papers.abstract: Peptide asparaginyl ligases (PALs) hold great promise for peptide macrocyclization and protein bioconjugation, yet their broader application is limited by insufficient thermal stability and low recombinant expression. Here, we report FortiPAL-1, a diffusion-enabled PAL developed through an integrated computational-experimental strategy that couples de novo sequence generation with multi-model-guided mutagenesis and PAL-specific functional refinements. Compared with natural PALs, FortiPAL-1 exhibits markedly enhanced thermal stability (T (m) = 69  degrees C versus  approximately 50  degrees C for typical PALs) and achieves a soluble zymogen expression level of 64 mg L(-1) in E. coli, substantially exceeding reported expression levels for natural PALs, while maintaining catalytic efficiency comparable to the fastest known natural PAL, butelase-1 (k (cat)/K (m) = 1.3 x 10(6) M(-1) s(-1)). Notably, the enhanced structural stability does not translate into a corresponding shift in the optimal reaction temperature, highlighting a decoupling between global folding stability and catalytic performance. Together, these results demonstrate how a constrained, diffusion-enabled engineering workflow can transform fragile enzyme scaffolds into robust, application-ready biocatalysts and highlight the importance of integrating generative protein design with experimental optimization to translate in silico designs into high-performance dynamic enzymes.
papers.abstract_zh: 肽天冬酰胺连接酶（PALs）在肽大环化和蛋白质生物偶联方面具有巨大潜力，但其更广泛的应用受限于热稳定性不足和重组表达水平低。在此，我们报道了FortiPAL-1，一种通过整合计算-实验策略开发的扩散增强型PAL，该策略将从头序列生成与多模型引导的诱变及PAL特异性功能优化相结合。与天然PALs相比，FortiPAL-1表现出显著增强的热稳定性（T (m) = 69 摄氏度，而典型PALs约为 50 摄氏度），并在大肠杆菌中实现可溶性酶原表达水平达64 mg L(-1)，大幅超过已报道的天然PALs表达水平，同时保持与已知最快天然PAL——butelase-1相当的催化效率（k (cat)/K (m) = 1.3 x 10(6) M(-1) s(-1)）。值得注意的是，增强的结构稳定性并未转化为最适反应温度的相应变化，凸显了整体折叠稳定性与催化性能之间的解耦。综合来看，这些结果展示了受限的、扩散增强型工程工作流如何将脆弱的酶支架转化为稳健的、可直接应用的生物催化剂，并强调了将生成式蛋白质设计与实验优化相结合以将计算机模拟设计转化为高性能动态酶的重要性。

papers.title: Ligand-induced reshaping of the conformational free energy landscape drives dynamic restriction in Trypanosoma brucei alternative oxidase.
papers.authors: Mas'od, Nurul Hana; Bahari, Mohammad Nazri Abdul; Ayub, Wan Mardhiyana Wan; Jamali, Mohamad Arif Mohamad
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过微秒级MD模拟与马尔可夫状态模型，揭示抑制剂通过重塑布氏锥虫交替氧化酶的构象自由能景观实现动态限制，属于蛋白质构象采样与动力学计算研究，与课题高度相关。
papers.abstract: The alternative oxidase (AOX) of Trypanosoma brucei is a validated therapeutic target for Human African Trypanosomiasis; however, the dynamic mechanisms governing its potent inhibition by lipophilic antibiotics remain poorly resolved. While static crystal structures provide insight into binding poses, the thermodynamic and kinetic drivers of picomolar efficacy are largely undefined. In this study, we employed triplicate microsecond-scale molecular dynamics (MD) simulations coupled with Markov state modeling (MSM) to compare the conformational ensembles of AOX bound to the ubiquinone-2 (UQ2) substrate analogue and the potent inhibitors ascofuranone (ASCO) and ferulenol. Our kinetic analysis reveals that inhibition is governed by a fundamental reshaping of the protein's free energy landscape. The enzyme-substrate (UQ2) complex maintains a dynamic equilibrium across three metastable macrostates (stationary populations of 56.2%, 23.7%, and 20.1%), connected by low energetic barriers that facilitate the rapid conformational cycling required for catalysis. Conversely, inhibitor (ASCO) binding triggers a conformational ensemble, causing the free energy landscape to funnel into a single, deep dynamic restriction containing 98.5% of the population. The stabilization of this trapped state is driven by a core hydrogen-bond network that rigidifies the active site, a process thermodynamically compensated by a substantial increase in entropic disorder at the C-terminus. We propose that high-affinity inhibitors function not solely through steric occlusion, but by inducing a "dynamic restriction" that effectively decouples the enzyme from the thermal fluctuations necessary for catalytic turnover. These findings provide a rigorous kinetic framework for engineering next-generation AOX inhibitors with optimized drug-target residence times.
papers.abstract_zh: 布氏锥虫（Trypanosoma brucei）的交替氧化酶（AOX）是治疗人类非洲锥虫病的已验证药物靶点；然而，亲脂性抗生素对其强效抑制的动态机制仍不清楚。尽管静态晶体结构提供了结合构象的见解，但皮摩尔级效力的热力学和动力学驱动因素在很大程度上尚未明确。在本研究中，我们采用三次重复的微秒级分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，并结合马尔可夫状态建模（Markov state modeling, MSM），比较了AOX与泛醌-2（UQ2）底物类似物及强效抑制剂ascorfuranone（ASCO）和ferulenol结合时的构象系综。我们的动力学分析揭示，抑制由蛋白质自由能景观的根本重塑所主导。酶-底物（UQ2）复合物在三个亚稳态宏观状态（稳态群体分别为56.2%、23.7%和20.1%）之间维持动态平衡，这些状态由低能垒连接，从而促进催化所需的快速构象循环。相反，抑制剂（ASCO）结合触发构象系综变化，使自由能景观漏斗化为一个包含98.5%群体的单一深动态限制态。该捕获态的稳定化由核心氢键网络驱动，该网络刚性化活性位点，这一过程在热力学上通过C端熵无序性的显著增加得到补偿。我们提出，高亲和力抑制剂不仅通过空间位阻发挥作用，还通过诱导“动态限制”有效解耦酶与催化周转所需的热波动。这些发现为设计具有优化药物-靶点驻留时间的下一代AOX抑制剂提供了严格的动力学框架。

papers.title: All-atom molecular dynamics simulation of Cyclophilin A in complex with Sanglifehrin A.
papers.authors: Aliabadi, Zahra; Mohebbi, Alireza
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子分子动力学模拟研究亲环蛋白A与抑制剂Sanglifehrin A复合物的构象动态和结合自由能，属于蛋白质-配体复合物的结构计算研究，方法上使用MD模拟，与本课题的蛋白质结构计算方向高度相关。
papers.abstract: Cyclophilin A (CypA), a key peptidyl-prolyl cis/trans isomerase, plays a pivotal role in various biological processes and is a target for therapeutic intervention, particularly in viral and cancer-related diseases. This study explores the structural and dynamic effects of Sanglifehrin A (SangfA), a potent CypA inhibitor, using molecular dynamics (MD) simulation. All-atom MD simulations (100 ns) of apo CypA and its complex with SangfA were performed using GROMACS v2023. In addition to MD analyses, essential dynamics, clustering, secondary structure, and binding free energy were analyzed. SangfA binding induces a dual dynamic response: local rigidification of the active-site beta2-beta3 loop, residues 100-102 and 108-111 with a coil‑to‑beta-strand transition (beta-sheet content rises from 28.0% to 32.3%), alongside enhanced mobility in distal loops and a 1.1‑fold expansion of the conformational ensemble. Principal component analysis shows redistribution of motions from a single dominant mode (apo PC1 = 44.2%) to more diffuse fluctuations (holo PC1 = 30.4%), increasing configurational entropy. The ligand forms a dynamic hydrogen‑bond network (1-2 persistent bonds) anchored by Arg55 and hydrophobic contacts with Phe60 and Lys105, while Arg55 remains uninvolved. The computed binding free energy (DeltaG = -20.45 +/- 3.07 Kcal/mol) accords with picomolar potency. SangfA acts via conformational selection, stabilizing a pre‑existing CypA substate with augmented beta-structure and broader dynamics. This entropically driven mechanism challenges static inhibition paradigms. Future efforts should validate the beta2-beta3 loop transition experimentally and exploit the Lys105 contact to design next‑generation cyclophilin inhibitors.
papers.abstract_zh: 亲环蛋白A（Cyclophilin A, CypA）是一种关键的肽基脯氨酰顺反异构酶，在多种生物过程中发挥重要作用，并且是治疗干预的靶点，尤其在病毒和癌症相关疾病中。本研究利用分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，探讨了强效CypA抑制剂Sanglifehrin A（SangfA）的结构和动态效应。使用GROMACS v2023对apo CypA及其与SangfA的复合物进行了全原子MD模拟（100 ns）。除MD分析外，还分析了本质动力学、聚类、二级结构和结合自由能。SangfA结合诱导双重动态响应：活性位点beta2-beta3环的局部刚性化，残基100-102和108-111发生卷曲至β-折叠转变（β-折叠含量从28.0%升至32.3%），同时远端环的流动性增强，构象集合扩大1.1倍。主成分分析显示，运动从单一主导模式（apo PC1 = 44.2%）重新分布为更弥散的波动（holo PC1 = 30.4%），增加了构象熵。配体形成由Arg55锚定的动态氢键网络（1-2个持久键）以及与Phe60和Lys105的疏水接触，而Arg55未参与其中。计算的结合自由能（DeltaG = -20.45 +/- 3.07 Kcal/mol）与皮摩尔级效力一致。SangfA通过构象选择发挥作用，稳定了CypA预先存在的亚态，该亚态具有增强的β结构和更广泛的动态性。这种熵驱动的机制挑战了静态抑制范式。未来工作应通过实验验证beta2-beta3环转变，并利用Lys105接触来设计下一代亲环蛋白抑制剂。

papers.title: Kinesins as dynamic drug targets: structural insights and emerging therapeutic strategies.
papers.authors: Allingham, John S; Kwok, Benjamin H; Sosa, Hernando
papers.one_liner_zh: 该综述探讨驱动蛋白作为动态药物靶点的结构见解和治疗策略，虽涉及蛋白质结构预测和构象状态，但核心是药物靶点而非蛋白质结构计算建模本身，方法贡献较弱。
papers.abstract: Kinesins are essential for intracellular organization and cell division, and their involvement in disease has generated interest in their therapeutic potential. However, pharmacological studies have focused on a limited subset of kinesins and have mainly targeted the conserved motor domain. Advances in cryogenic electron microscopy and artificial intelligence-based structure prediction are revealing new opportunities for selective modulation. These approaches show that specific kinesin families may be inhibited by targeting conformational states induced by nucleotide and microtubule binding. They have also identified regulatory sites outside the motor domain, including stalk and tail interfaces that control autoinhibition, cargo binding, and localization. These insights redefine kinesins as dynamic, multidomain machines and highlight opportunities for selective, mechanism-guided therapeutic strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 驱动蛋白（kinesins）对细胞内组织及细胞分裂至关重要，其与疾病的关联引发了对其治疗潜力的关注。然而，药理学研究主要集中在有限的驱动蛋白亚群上，并主要靶向其保守的运动结构域。低温电子显微镜和基于人工智能的结构预测进展正揭示选择性调控的新机遇。这些方法表明，特定驱动蛋白家族可通过靶向核苷酸和微管结合诱导的构象状态而被抑制。它们还识别了运动结构域之外的调控位点，包括控制自抑制、货物结合和定位的茎部及尾部界面。这些见解将驱动蛋白重新定义为动态的多结构域机器，并凸显了选择性、机制导向治疗策略的潜力。

papers.title: PREpiBind: Protein Representation-integrated Epitope–MHC Class II Binding Prediction
papers.authors: Jang DH; Kim D; Park B; Hwang U; Choi Y; Lee J
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文开发了整合多种蛋白表征的pMHC-II结合预测框架PREpiBind，虽以肽-MHC结合预测为核心，但系统评估了结构预测衍生表征和蛋白语言模型在蛋白质序列-结构表征中的适用性，对蛋白质结构计算建模有方法学参考价值。
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of peptide–MHC class II (pMHC-II) binding remains challenging because of extensive MHC polymorphism and context-dependent peptide recognition, and it is unclear which protein representation best captures these determinants when the downstream model is held fixed. Here, we present PREpiBind, a pMHC-II prediction method based on a dual-stream, joint-attention framework that integrates MHC and epitope representations. We integrated ten protein representations spanning substitution-matrix, structure-prediction-derived, and protein language model (PLM) families and evaluated them under a common downstream architecture and identical splits across Qualitative, mass spectrometry (MS), and thresholded IC50 datasets. Overall, PREpiBind with PLM representations yielded higher performance than the evaluated reference methods in the Qualitative and MS datasets, whereas NetMHCIIpan-4.3 was higher on the thresholded IC50 datasets using its binding-affinity head. In pooled evaluations, PLM representations yielded the highest ROC-AUC values among the tested representations. ESM3 Large led the Qualitative dataset with an AUC value of 0.927 ± 0.002, and PLMs also led on the MS and thresholded IC50 datasets. This advantage remained, but narrowed in allele-wise and leave-one-molecule-out evaluations, where structure-prediction-derived Chai-1 was competitive with the leading PLM representations. Under cross-species H2-out transfer, PLMs led when all H2 rows were pooled, whereas Chai-1 led when the eight H2 molecules were weighted equally. The small H2 panel did not support a stable ordering among these leading representations. The results indicate that protein representation choice should depend on the intended prediction scenario rather than on a single global ranking. PREpiBind is an openly available pMHC-II prediction framework with modular and flexible protein representations.
papers.abstract_zh: 肽–MHC II类（pMHC-II）结合的准确预测仍具挑战性，原因在于MHC的高度多态性和依赖上下文的肽识别，且当下游模型固定时，尚不清楚哪种蛋白质表示最能捕捉这些决定因素。在此，我们提出PREpiBind，一种基于双流联合注意力框架的pMHC-II预测方法，该框架整合了MHC和表位表示。我们整合了十种蛋白质表示，涵盖替换矩阵、结构预测衍生和蛋白质语言模型（PLM）家族，并在共同的下游架构和相同的划分下，对定性、质谱（MS）和阈值化IC50数据集进行了评估。总体而言，采用PLM表示的PREpiBind在定性和MS数据集中表现优于所评估的参考方法，而NetMHCIIpan-4.3在阈值化IC50数据集中使用其结合亲和力头时表现更高。在汇总评估中，PLM表示在测试的表示中获得了最高的ROC-AUC值。ESM3 Large在定性数据集中领先，AUC值为0.927 ± 0.002，PLM在MS和阈值化IC50数据集中也领先。这一优势在等位基因-wise和留一分子-out评估中仍然存在，但有所缩小，其中结构预测衍生的Chai-1与领先的PLM表示相当。在跨物种H2-out转移中，当所有H2行汇总时，PLM领先，而当八个H2分子等权时，Chai-1领先。小型H2面板未能支持这些领先表示之间的稳定排序。结果表明，蛋白质表示的选择应取决于预期的预测场景，而非单一的全局排名。PREpiBind是一个公开可用的pMHC-II预测框架，具有模块化和灵活的蛋白质表示。

papers.title: A Step-by-Step Protocol for Efficient Global Accuracy Estimation of Protein Complex Structural Models with MViewEMA.
papers.authors: Xie, Lei; Ye, Enjia; Liu, Dong; Zhang, Guijun
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出MViewEMA协议，利用多视图表示学习从单一输入结构估计蛋白质复合物模型的全局精度，属于蛋白质结构预测中的模型质量评估方法，与课题高度相关。
papers.abstract: Estimation of model accuracy (EMA) is a critical step in protein structure prediction, enabling the ranking and selection of models in the absence of experimental structures. EMA methods aim to function independently of modeling approaches, ensuring broad applicability across diverse prediction workflows. Recent state-of-the-art EMA methods often improve estimation accuracy by incorporating consensus information from model pools, multiple sequence alignments (MSAs), structural templates, or protein language model representations. However, these strategies typically incur substantial computational cost or rely on information derived from the modeling process itself, which may introduce bias and compromise the independence of the assessment. This protocol describes the use of MViewEMA for global accuracy estimation of protein complex models from a single input structure. MViewEMA extracts residue-residue interaction features from complementary micro-, meso-, and macro-environmental perspectives and integrates multi-scale structural representations through a multi-view representation learning framework to predict global confidence scores. The protocol provides detailed procedures for input structure preparation, feature extraction, model inference, and global confidence score output, together with a tutorial for using the MViewEMA web server. The protocol provides a workflow based solely on structural information from the input model, achieving a balance between computational efficiency and estimation accuracy. It enables large-scale evaluation and selection of predicted models for protein structure prediction and downstream structural analysis applications. Key features * Provides an efficient and accurate single-model EMA framework for protein complex accuracy estimation. * Integrates residue-residue interaction features across micro-, meso-, and macro-environmental views through multi-view representation learning. * Performs independent protein structural model assessment without requiring MSAs, templates, protein language models, or consensus information from model ensembles. * Supports large-scale protein complex model ranking and selection for downstream structural analysis applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 模型精度估计（EMA）是蛋白质结构预测中的关键步骤，可在缺乏实验结构的情况下对模型进行排序和选择。EMA方法旨在独立于建模方法运行，确保在多样化的预测工作流程中具有广泛适用性。近年来，最先进的EMA方法通常通过整合模型池中的共识信息、多序列比对（MSAs）、结构模板或蛋白质语言模型表示来提高估计精度。然而，这些策略通常会产生大量计算成本，或依赖于从建模过程本身获取的信息，这可能引入偏差并损害评估的独立性。本协议描述了使用MViewEMA从单一输入结构对蛋白质复合物模型进行全局精度估计的方法。MViewEMA从互补的微观、中观和宏观环境视角提取残基-残基相互作用特征，并通过多视图表示学习框架整合多尺度结构表示，以预测全局置信度分数。该协议提供了输入结构准备、特征提取、模型推理和全局置信度分数输出的详细步骤，以及使用MViewEMA网络服务器的教程。该协议提供了一种仅基于输入模型结构信息的工作流程，在计算效率和估计精度之间实现了平衡。它支持对蛋白质结构预测及下游结构分析应用中的预测模型进行大规模评估和选择。关键特性 * 为蛋白质复合物精度估计提供高效且准确的单模型EMA框架。 * 通过多视图表示学习整合微观、中观和宏观环境视角下的残基-残基相互作用特征。 * 执行独立的蛋白质结构模型评估，无需MSAs、模板、蛋白质语言模型或模型集合的共识信息。 * 支持大规模蛋白质复合物模型排序和选择，用于下游结构分析应用。

papers.title: mRNA Therapeutics Beyond Infectious Diseases: Expanding Therapeutic Applications and Future Perspectives.
papers.authors: Dejen, Gedion Mengistu
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文综述mRNA疗法在传染病之外的扩展应用，聚焦递送系统和临床转化，未涉及蛋白质结构计算建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Messenger RNA (mRNA) therapeutics have rapidly evolved from experimental nucleic acid constructs into a clinically validated therapeutic platform. Their successful application during the COVID-19 pandemic accelerated interest in broader therapeutic uses beyond infectious diseases. AIMS: This review summarizes the expanding therapeutic applications of mRNA technologies, recent technological advances, translational progress, current challenges, and future prospects across diverse medical fields. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A comprehensive review of the published literature was conducted, synthesizing evidence from preclinical investigations, clinical studies, and recent advances in mRNA engineering, delivery systems, and translational research. RESULTS: Advances in mRNA design, nucleoside modification, codon optimization, and delivery platforms, particularly lipid nanoparticles and emerging organ-targeted carriers, have expanded applications to cancer immunotherapy, personalized vaccines, autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, protein replacement therapy, cardiovascular regeneration, neurological disorders, and rare genetic diseases. Emerging technologies, including self-amplifying and circular RNA systems, further enhance therapeutic potential. DISCUSSION: Despite significant progress, challenges remain, including optimization of targeted delivery, long-term safety, repeat-dose tolerability, manufacturing complexity, cold-chain requirements, production costs, and equitable global access. Continued technological innovation and regulatory harmonization are critical for successful clinical translation. CONCLUSION: mRNA therapeutics are transitioning from a vaccine-centered technology to a versatile platform for precision medicine. Advances in delivery systems, scalable manufacturing, and artificial intelligence-assisted sequence design are expected to accelerate their integration into the treatment of chronic, genetic, and regenerative diseases.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：信使RNA（mRNA）疗法已迅速从实验性核酸构建体发展为经过临床验证的治疗平台。其在COVID-19大流行期间的成功应用，加速了对其在传染病之外更广泛治疗用途的兴趣。目的：本综述总结了mRNA技术在多个医学领域不断扩展的治疗应用、近期技术进展、转化进展、当前挑战及未来前景。材料与方法：对已发表文献进行了全面综述，综合了来自临床前研究、临床研究以及mRNA工程、递送系统和转化研究近期进展的证据。结果：mRNA设计、核苷修饰、密码子优化及递送平台（特别是脂质纳米颗粒和新兴的器官靶向载体）方面的进展，已将应用扩展至癌症免疫治疗、个性化疫苗、自身免疫性和炎症性疾病、蛋白质替代疗法、心血管再生、神经系统疾病及罕见遗传病。新兴技术，包括自扩增和环状RNA系统，进一步增强了治疗潜力。讨论：尽管取得了显著进展，但挑战依然存在，包括靶向递送的优化、长期安全性、重复给药耐受性、制造复杂性、冷链要求、生产成本及全球公平可及性。持续的技术创新和监管协调对于成功的临床转化至关重要。结论：mRNA疗法正从以疫苗为中心的技术转变为精准医学的多功能平台。递送系统、可扩展制造及人工智能辅助序列设计方面的进展，预计将加速其融入慢性病、遗传病和再生性疾病的治疗。

papers.title: Deep learning-driven de novo discovery of binders targeting the transmembrane domain of BamA.
papers.authors: Du, Minghui; Xin, Yuqiao; Xu, Benao; Zhang, Yang; Han, Linjie; Ji, Bingjie; Zhao, Jian; Zhao, Yongshan
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究利用深度学习框架DeepTM-Bind和分子动力学模拟，从头设计靶向BamA跨膜结构域的蛋白结合物，属于蛋白质结构计算与AI驱动的设计研究，与课题高度相关。
papers.abstract: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is an escalating global health threat, with multidrug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria presenting a particularly serious clinical challenge. The unique outer membrane (OM) structure serves as a natural barrier against conventional therapeutics, so that treatment strategies become more complicated. Notably, drug development aimed at the transmembrane (TM) domains of membrane proteins remains highly limited. To overcome this bottleneck, we established an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven framework for the design and screening of BamA transmembrane (TM) domain-targeting binders. This framework employs a multi-channel convolutional neural network (DeepTM-Bind), which integrates heterogeneous protein features to achieve high predictive accuracy. Building upon this foundation, we further developed a multidimensional evaluation system to guide de novo design strategies. Using this integrated approach, binders targeting the lateral gate of BamA were successfully generated. All-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations within a membrane environment, combined with multiscale mechanistic analyses, confirmed the structural stability and strong binding potential of the candidate molecules, and revealed a previously unrecognized binding mode. Collectively, this study introduces an advanced computational paradigm for therapeutic design targeting TM domains and provides a promising strategy to combat multidrug-resistant Gram-negative pathogens.
papers.abstract_zh: 抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）是一个日益严峻的全球健康威胁，其中多重耐药革兰氏阴性菌构成了尤为严重的临床挑战。其独特的外膜（OM）结构作为常规治疗药物的天然屏障，使得治疗策略变得更加复杂。值得注意的是，针对膜蛋白跨膜（TM）结构域的药物开发仍然极为有限。为突破这一瓶颈，我们建立了一个人工智能（AI）驱动的框架，用于设计和筛选靶向BamA跨膜（TM）结构域的结合分子。该框架采用多通道卷积神经网络（DeepTM-Bind），整合异质性蛋白质特征以实现高预测精度。在此基础上，我们进一步开发了一个多维评估系统，以指导从头设计策略。利用这一集成方法，成功生成了靶向BamA侧向门控的结合分子。在膜环境中进行的全原子分子动力学（MD）模拟，结合多尺度机制分析，确认了候选分子的结构稳定性和强结合潜力，并揭示了一种此前未被识别的结合模式。总体而言，本研究引入了一种针对TM结构域治疗设计的高级计算范式，并为对抗多重耐药革兰氏阴性病原体提供了一种有前景的策略。

papers.title: Structural analysis of Sphingobium yanoikuyae P4 carboxylesterase reveals conformational and catalytic determinants for PET biodegradation.
papers.authors: Bhatt, Sunidhi; Akhter, Yusuf; Chatterjee, Subhankar
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过序列分析、分子对接、500ns分子动力学模拟、MM/PBSA及DFT计算，系统表征了Sphingobium yanoikuyae P4羧酸酯酶降解PET的结构与催化机制，属于蛋白质结构计算研究，方法上结合物理模拟与电子结构计算，对PET降解酶工程有直接参考价值。
papers.abstract: The accumulation of poorly biodegradable polyethylene terephthalate (PET) in the environment has become an emerging ecological and health problem, with a strong need to develop environmentally friendly, biobased degradation methods. This in silico study demonstrates the structural and mechanistic characterization of a carboxylesterase from the phthalate-degrading Sphingobium yanoikuyae P4 for its potential to catalyze the hydrolysis of PET. Sequence analysis of the amino acid residues revealed the conserved alpha/beta-hydrolase fold and the sequence motifs GXSXG and GGX, typical of PET-active enzymes, with evolutionary conservation of the active-site residues. Structural similarity to known PET hydrolases, such as a carboxylesterase from Thermobifida fusca and lipase from Streptomyces exfoliatus, suggested the conservation of the catalytic scaffold. The defined PET backbone oligomer and the hydrolysis intermediates BHET and MHET docked at the same catalytic site with the scissile ester in an ideal conformation for the nucleophilic attack of the Ser215-His418-Glu332 catalytic triad and also stabilized by the Gly217 oxyanion hole. Further, the molecular dynamics simulation for 500 ns supported the stability of the catalytic core of the enzyme-substrate complex, and MM/PBSA revealed a binding free energy of -14.03 kcal/mol, which was strongly affected by van der Waals interactions. Free-energy landscape and principal-component analyses found a flexible, low-energy dominant state in which the loop is mobile, and DFT single-point calculations showed that the catalytic center is electronically well-defined and preorganized. Collectively, these analyses indicate that S. yanoikuyae P4 carboxylesterase possesses the structural and mechanistic prerequisites for PET hydrolysis, providing a candidate scaffold for further experimental and protein-engineering studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 环境中难降解的聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）的积累已成为一个新兴的生态和健康问题，迫切需要开发环境友好、基于生物降解的方法。这项计算机模拟研究展示了一种来自降解邻苯二甲酸盐的Sphingobium yanoikuyae P4的羧酸酯酶的结构和机制特征，以评估其催化PET水解的潜力。氨基酸残基的序列分析揭示了保守的α/β-水解酶折叠以及序列基序GXSXG和GGX，这些是PET活性酶的典型特征，且活性位点残基在进化上保守。与已知PET水解酶（如来自Thermobifida fusca的羧酸酯酶和来自Streptomyces exfoliatus的脂肪酶）的结构相似性表明催化支架的保守性。定义的PET骨架寡聚体及水解中间体BHET和MHET对接在同一催化位点，可裂解酯键处于理想构象，便于Ser215-His418-Glu332催化三联体的亲核攻击，并由Gly217氧阴离子孔稳定。此外，500 ns的分子动力学模拟支持了酶-底物复合物催化核心的稳定性，MM/PBSA分析显示结合自由能为-14.03 kcal/mol，这主要受范德华相互作用影响。自由能景观和主成分分析发现了一个柔性、低能的主导状态，其中环区具有移动性，而DFT单点计算表明催化中心在电子层面定义明确且预组织良好。综合这些分析表明，S. yanoikuyae P4羧酸酯酶具备PET水解的结构和机制前提，为进一步的实验和蛋白质工程研究提供了候选支架。

papers.title: AlloPool is a deep learning framework that infers protein allostery from molecular dynamics simulations.
papers.authors: Marfoglia, Matthieu; Pedraza-Joya, Miguel A; Guirardel, Lucas; Chatzi Souleiman, Aisima; Barth, Patrick
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于图神经网络的AlloPool框架，从分子动力学模拟中推断蛋白质变构通讯网络与构象动态，属于蛋白质构象动态与结构计算建模的核心课题，方法创新且应用广泛。
papers.abstract: Recent advances in artificial intelligence have transformed protein structure prediction and design. However, protein function is governed not only by static structures but also by the conformational dynamics that allow proteins to access distinct functional states. Predicting these dynamic transitions, central to many biological processes, remains challenging due to the scarcity of high-resolution experimental data, which limits the training of machine-learning models for dynamic and energetic property prediction. Here, we present AlloPool, a graph neural network (GNN)-based framework that interprets molecular dynamics simulations by iteratively pruning residue-residue interactions to uncover minimal, time-resolved interaction networks that govern protein conformational dynamics and structural responses to chemical or mechanical perturbations, collectively known as allostery. By integrating temporal attention with graph aggregation, AlloPool learns evolving interaction graphs from equilibrium and non-equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations, enabling accurate reconstruction of dynamic trajectories and the interaction networks that drive conformational transitions. Validated across diverse dynamic protein systems, including binding domains, mechanosensors, signaling receptors, and enzymes, AlloPool maps allosteric communication pathways, predicts the effects of ligand binding, mechanical forces, and mutations, discovers transient dynamic states and outperforms existing machine-learning approaches in dynamic trajectory reconstruction. This advance provides a general framework for interpreting protein dynamics with broad implications for drug discovery, synthetic biology, and protein engineering.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能的最新进展已经改变了蛋白质结构预测与设计。然而，蛋白质功能不仅受静态结构控制，还受构象动力学影响，后者使蛋白质能够进入不同的功能状态。预测这些动态转变（许多生物过程的核心）仍然具有挑战性，因为高分辨率实验数据稀缺，限制了用于动态和能量性质预测的机器学习模型的训练。在此，我们提出AlloPool，一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的框架，通过迭代修剪残基-残基相互作用来解读分子动力学模拟，揭示控制蛋白质构象动力学及其对化学或机械扰动结构响应的最小时间分辨相互作用网络，这些响应统称为变构（allostery）。通过将时间注意力与图聚合相结合，AlloPool从平衡和非平衡分子动力学模拟中学习演化相互作用图，从而能够准确重建动态轨迹及驱动构象转变的相互作用网络。在多种动态蛋白质系统（包括结合域、机械传感器、信号受体和酶）中验证后，AlloPool绘制变构通信通路，预测配体结合、机械力和突变的影响，发现瞬态动态状态，并在动态轨迹重建方面优于现有机器学习方法。这一进展为解读蛋白质动力学提供了通用框架，对药物发现、合成生物学和蛋白质工程具有广泛意义。

papers.title: Non-muscle proteins alleviate 118  degrees C sterilization-induced gel quality deterioration by non-covalently modulating myofibrillar protein conformation and aggregation.
papers.authors: Wu, Wenmin; Chen, Fan; Gao, Pei; Yu, Dawei; Jiang, Qixing; Liao, E; Xia, Wenshui
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究非肌肉蛋白对高温灭菌鱼糜凝胶品质的改善，虽涉及分子对接和动力学模拟，但核心对象是食品凝胶体系而非蛋白质结构计算，方法仅作为辅助验证，与蛋白质结构计算课题关联较弱。
papers.abstract: The improvement effects of non-muscle proteins (soy protein isolate (SPI), egg white protein (EWP) and whey protein concentrate (WPC)) on the quality deterioration of high-temperature (118  degrees C) sterilized surimi gels were systematically compared. Supplementation with 4% SPI, 4% EWP, or 8% WPC effectively alleviated the heat-induced quality deterioration of gels, among which 4% SPI exhibiting the best improvement effect, increasing gel strength by 49.15% and water holding capacity by 7.6% compared with the control group. Multi-spectral analysis showed SPI improved myofibrillar protein (MP) solubility, promoted protein unfolding, and strengthened molecular cross-linking. Rheology indicated increased storage modulus (G'), while microstructural images confirmed denser gel network. SPI also inhibited excessive aggregation of MP at 118  degrees C. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations confirmed stable MP-SPI complexes through non-covalent interactions. These findings demonstrate innovative application of SPI in sterilized surimi gels, providing new insights for the development of ready-to-eat surimi products.
papers.abstract_zh: 系统比较了非肌肉蛋白（大豆分离蛋白（SPI）、蛋清蛋白（EWP）和浓缩乳清蛋白（WPC））对高温（118 摄氏度）灭菌鱼糜凝胶品质劣化的改善效果。添加4% SPI、4% EWP或8% WPC能有效缓解热诱导的凝胶品质劣化，其中4% SPI表现出最佳改善效果，与对照组相比，凝胶强度提高49.15%，持水性提高7.6%。多光谱分析显示，SPI改善了肌原纤维蛋白（MP）的溶解性，促进了蛋白质展开，并增强了分子交联。流变学结果表明储能模量（G'）增加，而微观结构图像证实了更致密的凝胶网络。SPI还抑制了MP在118 摄氏度下的过度聚集。分子对接和动力学模拟证实，MP-SPI复合物通过非共价相互作用稳定形成。这些发现展示了SPI在灭菌鱼糜凝胶中的创新应用，为即食鱼糜产品的开发提供了新见解。

papers.title: Comparative Sequence Analysis of the Envelope Gene of Kyasanur Forest Disease Virus Vaccine Strain With Currently Circulating Field Strains.
papers.authors: Kaje, Keerthi; Marinaik, Chandranaik B; Gomes, Amitha Reena; Rizwan, Apsana; Hiremath, Jagadish; Rathnamma, Doddamane; Isloor, Shrikrishna; Patil, Sharanagouda S; Archana, M
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文对KFDV疫苗株与流行株的包膜基因进行序列比较，并辅以同源建模和AlphaFold结构分析，但核心是病毒学序列比对而非蛋白质结构计算建模，方法贡献较弱。
papers.abstract: The present study was undertaken with the objective of performing comparative sequence analysis of the envelope (E) gene of Kyasanur forest disease virus (KFDV) vaccine strain P9605 with the circulating field strains. The study was taken up as the currently used KFDV vaccine strain, KFDV P9605, was isolated in the 1960s. For this study, we designed two sets of primers targeting the complete amplification of the E gene of KFDV. The sequencing was performed by the Sanger method, and the deduced sequence of the vaccine virus was deposited in GenBank with accession number PX067005. This sequence obtained for the vaccine virus was aligned and compared with sequences of GenBank-deposited circulating field strains. We also performed comparative sequence analysis of the Kyasanur forest disease (KFD) vaccine seed virus having passaged twice in mouse brain with the vaccine seed virus passaged six times in mouse brain to investigate whether multiple passages in mouse brain will lead to genetic mutation in the immunologically important E gene. The phylogenetic analysis revealed seven amino acid mutations in the field strains at positions A123T, S158N, D178E, D239N, A313S, M429I, and G479A when compared with the vaccine strain. We did not find any mutations at the critical fusogenic segment (residues 98-113) in the E gene of currently circulating field strains compared to the vaccine seed virus. The study found no genetic variations in the E gene of the KFD virus passed two times and passed six times in mouse brain. We performed SWISS-MODEL homology modeling, AlphaFold protein analysis, and Ramachandran plot analysis to study the E protein structures and stability. The observations made in this study suggest slow evolutionary drift and conserved structural stability of the envelope gene of KFDV ever since its emergence 7 decades ago; however, the functional implications of these amino acid substitutions need further studies on their roles in viral infectivity, transmission, and impact on immunity.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在对Kyasanur森林病病毒（KFDV）疫苗株P9605的包膜（E）基因与流行现场株进行比较序列分析。由于目前使用的KFDV疫苗株KFDV P9605分离于20世纪60年代，故开展本研究。为此，我们设计了两对引物，用于KFDV E基因的完整扩增。测序采用Sanger法，疫苗病毒的推导序列已提交至GenBank，登录号为PX067005。将获得的疫苗病毒序列与GenBank中收录的流行现场株序列进行比对和比较。我们还对在小鼠脑中传代两次的KFD疫苗种子病毒与在小鼠脑中传代六次的疫苗种子病毒进行了比较序列分析，以探讨小鼠脑内多次传代是否会导致免疫学上重要的E基因发生遗传突变。系统发育分析显示，与疫苗株相比，现场株在A123T、S158N、D178E、D239N、A313S、M429I和G479A位点存在七处氨基酸突变。与疫苗种子病毒相比，当前流行现场株E基因的关键融合片段（残基98-113）未发现任何突变。研究发现，在小鼠脑中传代两次和六次的KFD病毒E基因无遗传变异。我们采用SWISS-MODEL同源建模、AlphaFold蛋白分析和Ramachandran图分析来研究E蛋白的结构和稳定性。本研究观察结果表明，自KFDV出现以来的70年间，其包膜基因存在缓慢的进化漂移并保持保守的结构稳定性；然而，这些氨基酸替换的功能意义需进一步研究其在病毒传染性、传播及对免疫影响中的作用。

papers.title: Engineering carboxyl methyltransferase for high-efficiency biosynthesis of methyl salicylate in Escherichia coli.
papers.authors: Gao, Yuan; Guo, Shibo; Wu, Jun; Wang, Jingyan; Liu, Huan; Guo, Jimin; Sun, Xinxiao; Wang, Jia; Shen, Xiaolin; Yuan, Qipeng
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过融合蛋白设计改造羧甲基转移酶并利用分子动力学模拟解析多组氨酸标签增强催化效率的机制，虽以酶工程和代谢工程为核心，但MD模拟涉及蛋白质结构-功能关系，对蛋白结构计算研究有一定参考价值。
papers.abstract: Methyl salicylate (MeSA) is a volatile methylated aromatic ester widely used in agriculture, food, and pharmaceuticals. Microbial biosynthesis offers a sustainable alternative to plant extraction and petrochemical synthesis; however, efficient MeSA production remains limited by the low catalytic efficiency of carboxyl methyltransferases, insufficient intracellular supply of S-adenosylmethionine (SAM), and severe product volatilization during fermentation. In this study, we systematically screened salicylate carboxymethyltransferase and identified CbSAMT as a relatively efficient catalyst for salicylic acid (SA). To further improve catalytic performance, we engineered CbSAMT through fusion-protein design. Remarkably, the catalytic efficiency of 7 x His-CbSAMT was 12-fold higher than that of the wild-type. Molecular dynamics simulations and computational analyses revealed that the polyhistidine tag reshaped the catalytic microenvironment by remodeling the hydrogen-bonding network and reducing the distance between SA and key substrate-positioning residues, thereby enhancing substrate binding and catalytic turnover. To further enhance MeSA biosynthesis, we reinforced intracellular SAM regeneration and established an in situ two-phase fermentation system using n-dodecane as the extractant to alleviate product volatilization. Finally, fed-batch fermentation achieved a MeSA titer of 5.12 g/L, representing the highest production level reported to date. Collectively, this study highlights the potential of polyhistidine tags in enzyme engineering and provides an efficient platform for the biosynthesis of volatile methylated natural products.
papers.abstract_zh: 水杨酸甲酯（MeSA）是一种挥发性甲基化芳香酯，广泛应用于农业、食品和制药领域。微生物生物合成提供了一种可持续的替代植物提取和石油化工合成的方法；然而，高效的MeSA生产仍受限于羧基甲基转移酶的低催化效率、细胞内S-腺苷甲硫氨酸（SAM）供应不足，以及发酵过程中严重的产物挥发。在本研究中，我们系统筛选了水杨酸羧基甲基转移酶，并鉴定出CbSAMT作为水杨酸（SA）的相对高效催化剂。为进一步提升催化性能，我们通过融合蛋白设计对CbSAMT进行了工程改造。值得注意的是，7 x His-CbSAMT的催化效率比野生型高出12倍。分子动力学模拟和计算分析揭示，多组氨酸标签通过重塑氢键网络并缩短SA与关键底物定位残基之间的距离，重构了催化微环境，从而增强了底物结合和催化周转。为进一步提高MeSA生物合成，我们强化了细胞内SAM再生，并建立了以正十二烷为萃取剂的原位两相发酵系统，以缓解产物挥发。最终，补料分批发酵实现了5.12 g/L的MeSA滴度，代表了迄今报道的最高生产水平。总体而言，本研究凸显了多组氨酸标签在酶工程中的潜力，并为挥发性甲基化天然产物的生物合成提供了高效平台。

papers.title: TRPM8 virtual screening: the essential role of target-specific, inactive-enriched machine-learning scoring functions.
papers.authors: James, Nivya; Ballester, Pedro J
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文针对TRPM8离子通道建立结构基虚拟筛选基准，评估机器学习打分函数，虽涉及蛋白结构对接和ML方法，但核心是药物筛选而非蛋白质结构计算建模，且对象为离子通道，算法可部分迁移至蛋白体系。
papers.abstract: The Transient Receptor Potential Melastatin 8 (TRPM8) ion channel is an emerging therapeutic target implicated in pain, inflammation and other disorders. While structure-based virtual screening (VS) is widely used in drug discovery, the effectiveness of generic and target-specific machine-learning (ML) scoring functions (SFs) for ion channels such as TRPM8 remains to be investigated. We established the first comprehensive structure-based VS benchmark for TRPM8. This evaluates classical docking SFs, generic ML SFs and target-specific ML models retrospectively across multiple TRPM8 protein conformations and docking protocols. The evaluation revealed that generic ML rescoring at most provided modest and conformation-dependent improvements over classical docking on this target. Target-specific ML models based only on protein-ligand interaction fingerprints improved early enrichment on test sets when regression algorithms were employed. However, performance remained sensitive to protein conformation choice and chemical dissimilarity. Systematic evaluation of feature representations showed that combining structure-derived interaction features with ligand-based descriptors enhanced enrichment under selected docking tool-protein conformation combinations. Critically, presenting the learning algorithm with many more negative training instances, via inactive-enriched training, strongly reduced false positives. This also resulted in markedly improved generalization to chemically dissimilar test sets for structure-based models. By contrast, ligand-only QSAR models collapsed under the same class-imbalanced regime. Under inactive-enriched training, PLEC-based support vector regression (SVR) models achieved robust and strong VS performance, highlighting the critical role of learning the vast diversity of inactive molecules better during model training in developing predictive target-specific ML SFs for TRPM8 VS.
papers.abstract_zh: 瞬时受体电位M8（TRPM8）离子通道是一个新兴的治疗靶点，涉及疼痛、炎症及其他疾病。尽管基于结构的虚拟筛选（VS）在药物发现中广泛应用，但通用及靶标特异性机器学习（ML）打分函数（SFs）对TRPM8等离子通道的有效性仍有待研究。我们建立了首个针对TRPM8的全面基于结构的VS基准。该基准回顾性评估了经典对接SF、通用ML SF及靶标特异性ML模型，涵盖多种TRPM8蛋白构象和对接协议。评估结果显示，通用ML重打分在该靶标上最多仅提供适度的、依赖构象的改进，优于经典对接。基于仅蛋白-配体相互作用指纹的靶标特异性ML模型，在采用回归算法时，提高了测试集上的早期富集度。然而，性能仍对蛋白构象选择和化学不相似性敏感。对特征表示的系统评估表明，将结构衍生的相互作用特征与基于配体的描述符相结合，在选定的对接工具-蛋白构象组合下增强了富集度。关键的是，通过非活性富集训练，向学习算法提供更多负训练实例，显著减少了假阳性。这也导致基于结构的模型在化学不相似测试集上的泛化能力显著提升。相比之下，仅基于配体的QSAR模型在同一类不平衡条件下崩溃。在非活性富集训练下，基于PLEC的支持向量回归（SVR）模型实现了稳健且强大的VS性能，突显了在模型训练期间更好地学习大量非活性分子多样性，对于开发预测性靶标特异性ML SF以用于TRPM8 VS的关键作用。

papers.title: High-speed atomic force microscopy of membrane proteins: From dynamic imaging to integrative structural biology.
papers.authors: Shin, Eunji; Mount, Jonathan; Scheuring, Simon
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文综述高速原子力显微镜对膜蛋白动态成像及与MD模拟等整合的结构生物学应用，涉及蛋白质结构动态但以实验技术为主，计算建模仅作为辅助整合手段。
papers.abstract: High-speed atomic force microscopy (HS-AFM) enables direct, label-free visualization of membrane proteins in lipid bilayers with nanometer spatial resolution and millisecond temporal resolution. Recent studies revealed transient conformational states, dynamic oligomerization changes, and membrane-mediated organization of membrane proteins that are not readily captured by conventional structural or biophysical approaches. Advances in experimental design-including membrane reconstitution strategies, stimulus-coupled imaging, high-temporal-resolution acquisition, and computational reconstruction-have further expanded the scope of HS-AFM. When integrated with complementary techniques such as cryo-electron microscopy, molecular dynamics simulations, and single-molecule methods, HS-AFM provides a powerful and versatile tool for linking membrane protein structure, dynamics, and function in native-like environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 高速原子力显微镜（HS-AFM）能够直接、无标记地可视化脂质双分子层中的膜蛋白，具备纳米级空间分辨率和毫秒级时间分辨率。近期研究揭示了膜蛋白的瞬态构象状态、动态寡聚化变化及膜介导的组织结构，这些现象难以通过传统结构或生物物理方法捕获。实验设计的进展——包括膜重构策略、刺激耦合成像、高时间分辨率采集及计算重建——进一步拓展了HS-AFM的应用范围。当与冷冻电子显微镜、分子动力学模拟及单分子方法等互补技术整合时，HS-AFM为在类天然环境中连接膜蛋白结构、动力学与功能提供了强大且多功能的工具。

papers.title: AASIA: A comprehensive protein structural interactome database for agricultural animals.
papers.authors: Li, Jiajun; Yuan, Mengdi; Jiang, Linyang; Li, Dianke; Yin, Zhongtao; Zhu, Feng; Shi, Wenyu; Hou, Zhuocheng; Zhang, Ziding
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文构建了农业动物蛋白质结构互作组数据库，利用深度学习预测PPI并生成复合物结构，虽非核心方法创新，但涉及蛋白质结构计算建模，对结构互作组研究有参考价值。
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Agricultural animals are essential for global food production and sustainable agriculture. Improving disease resistance and economically important traits is critical for ensuring food security. Proteome-wide protein-protein interactions (PPIs), termed as interactomes, underlie key biological processes in cells, making them critical for deciphering the genome-phenome relationship. However, species-specific PPI resources remain limited for most agricultural animals. OBJECTIVES: Motivated by the rapid development of deep learning and breakthroughs in AI-driven protein structure prediction, we attempted to develop an integrated structural interactome resource for agricultural animals. METHODS: We predicted species-specific interactomes through an integrative prediction pipeline that combines interolog mapping, domain-domain interaction inference, and deep learning. The 3D complex structures of all predicted PPIs were further generated using ESMFold. RESULTS: We established AASIA (Agricultural Animals Structural Interactome Atlas; https://aasia.zzdlab.com), a user-friendly database comprising 410,421 high-confidence PPIs and corresponding complex structures across five key species, including Anas platyrhynchos, Bos taurus, Gallus gallus, Ovis aries, and Sus scrofa. CONCLUSIONS: AASIA provides the first proteome-scale structural interactome resource for five key agricultural animals. By integrating interaction prediction with structural modeling, it enables mechanistic insight into agriculturally relevant traits and supports applications in variant interpretation, multi-omics integration, and molecular breeding.
papers.abstract_zh: 引言：农业动物对全球粮食生产和可持续农业至关重要。提高抗病性和经济重要性状对于确保粮食安全十分关键。全蛋白质组范围内的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs），称为相互作用组（interactomes），是细胞中关键生物过程的基础，因此对于解读基因组-表型组关系具有重要意义。然而，大多数农业动物的物种特异性PPI资源仍然有限。目标：受深度学习快速发展和AI驱动的蛋白质结构预测突破的启发，我们试图为农业动物开发一个整合的结构性相互作用组资源。方法：我们通过一个整合预测流程预测了物种特异性相互作用组，该流程结合了interolog映射、结构域-结构域相互作用推断和深度学习。所有预测PPIs的三维复合物结构进一步使用ESMFold生成。结果：我们建立了AASIA（农业动物结构性相互作用组图谱；https://aasia.zzdlab.com），这是一个用户友好的数据库，包含五个关键物种的410,421个高置信度PPIs及相应的复合物结构，这些物种包括绿头鸭（Anas platyrhynchos）、家牛（Bos taurus）、原鸡（Gallus gallus）、绵羊（Ovis aries）和家猪（Sus scrofa）。结论：AASIA为五种关键农业动物提供了首个蛋白质组规模的结构性相互作用组资源。通过将相互作用预测与结构建模相结合，它能够对农业相关性状提供机制性见解，并支持在变异解读、多组学整合和分子育种中的应用。

papers.title: Computational methods for alternative proteins.
papers.authors: Vyshnav, S; Sundararajan, Vino; Sudhakaran, Sajitha Lulu
papers.journal: Advances in protein chemistry and structural biology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该综述系统总结了替代蛋白研发中的计算生物学方法，涵盖结构建模、分子模拟和蛋白设计等，虽以食品蛋白为对象，但方法框架对蛋白质结构计算研究有参考价值。
papers.abstract: The growing demand for sustainable food systems has accelerated research into alternative proteins derived from plant sources, microorganisms, insects, and cultured animal cells. These protein systems offer promising solutions to environmental, ethical, and nutritional challenges associated with conventional livestock production. However, designing and optimizing alternative proteins requires deep understanding of molecular structures, biochemical properties, and production processes. Computational biology has emerged as a powerful approach to address these challenges by enabling predictive modeling, data-driven protein engineering, and large-scale bioinformatic analyses. This chapter provides a comprehensive overview of computational methods applied in alternative protein research and development. Key approaches discussed include sequence-based bioinformatics, structural modeling, molecular simulations, protein design algorithms, machine learning techniques, metabolic modeling, and process simulation. The chapter further explores how these computational frameworks support discovery of novel protein sources, optimization of functional properties, and scaling of industrial production processes. Challenges and future research directions are also discussed, particularly the integration of artificial intelligence, multi-omics data, and digital twin technologies for food manufacturing. Computational technologies are expected to play a pivotal role in shaping next-generation protein foods by accelerating innovation, reducing development costs, and enabling sustainable protein production systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 可持续食品系统日益增长的需求加速了对源自植物、微生物、昆虫及培养动物细胞的替代蛋白质的研究。这些蛋白质系统为传统畜牧业生产所带来的环境、伦理和营养挑战提供了有前景的解决方案。然而，设计和优化替代蛋白质需要深入理解分子结构、生化特性和生产过程。计算生物学已成为应对这些挑战的有力方法，通过实现预测建模、数据驱动的蛋白质工程和大规模生物信息学分析。本章全面概述了应用于替代蛋白质研究与开发的计算方法。讨论的关键方法包括基于序列的生物信息学、结构建模、分子模拟、蛋白质设计算法、机器学习技术、代谢建模和过程模拟。本章进一步探讨了这些计算框架如何支持新型蛋白质来源的发现、功能特性的优化以及工业生产过程的规模化。还讨论了挑战和未来研究方向，特别是人工智能、多组学数据和数字孪生技术在食品制造中的整合。计算技术有望通过加速创新、降低开发成本和实现可持续蛋白质生产系统，在塑造下一代蛋白质食品中发挥关键作用。

papers.title: Computational structural insights into alternative proteins: The impact of AlphaFold and AI-based prediction.
papers.authors: Natarajan, Shiammala Periyasamy; Ramarajan, Bagavathi Lakshmi; Sivakumar, Rani; Mani, Jayaprakashvel
papers.journal: Advances in protein chemistry and structural biology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦AlphaFold等AI方法在替代蛋白（植物、微生物等）结构预测中的应用，对象为蛋白质结构且方法涉及AI预测，但以应用综述为主、缺乏方法创新，故评6分。
papers.abstract: Proteins are fundamental biomolecules composed of amino acids linked by peptide bonds, forming complex macromolecules that determine cellular structure and biological function. The three-dimensional conformation of proteins plays a crucial role in defining their biochemical activity, stability, and interactions. In the emerging field of alternative proteins, such as microbial, algal, plant-based, and precision-fermented proteins, understanding structural organization is essential for improving functional properties including digestibility, nutritional value, texture, and enzymatic performance. Experimental determination of protein structures through conventional techniques remains time-consuming, technically demanding, and expensive. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence have revolutionized protein structure prediction, particularly with the development of AlphaFold by Google DeepMind. AlphaFold integrates deep learning algorithms, attention mechanisms, and evolutionary information derived from multiple sequence alignments to accurately predict spatial relationships among amino acid residues. Its performance has been validated through the Critical Assessment of Structure Prediction (CASP) competitions, demonstrating unprecedented accuracy in computational structure prediction. The application of AlphaFold provides significant opportunities for accelerating research in alternative proteins by enabling rapid structural characterization, enzyme engineering, and functional optimization of novel protein sources. This review highlights the scientific developments that led to AlphaFold, describes its architectural innovations, and discusses its potential applications in alternative protein discovery, design, and processing. Furthermore, current limitations and future perspectives in AI-assisted structural prediction for sustainable protein production are discussed.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白质是由氨基酸通过肽键连接而成的基本生物分子，形成决定细胞结构和生物学功能的复杂大分子。蛋白质的三维构象在定义其生化活性、稳定性和相互作用方面起着至关重要的作用。在新兴的替代蛋白质领域，如微生物、藻类、植物基和精密发酵蛋白质，理解结构组织对于改善功能特性（包括消化性、营养价值、质地和酶学性能）至关重要。通过传统技术实验测定蛋白质结构仍然耗时、技术要求高且成本高昂。人工智能的最新进展彻底改变了蛋白质结构预测，尤其是谷歌DeepMind开发的AlphaFold。AlphaFold整合了深度学习算法、注意力机制和源自多序列比对的进化信息，以准确预测氨基酸残基之间的空间关系。其性能已通过蛋白质结构预测关键评估（CASP）竞赛得到验证，展示了计算结构预测中前所未有的准确性。AlphaFold的应用为加速替代蛋白质研究提供了重要机遇，能够实现快速结构表征、酶工程和新蛋白质来源的功能优化。本综述重点介绍了促成AlphaFold的科学进展，描述了其架构创新，并讨论了其在替代蛋白质发现、设计和加工中的潜在应用。此外，还讨论了当前局限性以及人工智能辅助结构预测在可持续蛋白质生产中的未来前景。

papers.title: Latent generative search unlocks de novo design of untapped biomolecular interactions at scale
papers.authors: Didi K; Reidenbach D; Penner M; Ravichandran S; Case M; Nichols M; Swanson E; Reis A; Prescott M; Qian Y; Qian D; Yang J; Li W; Li L; Shonai D; Gay S; Basu Mallik B; Chim HY; Chen L; Atienza Juanatey M; Klein H; Rieger D; Schlegel P; Macintyre AU; Secor M; Granata D; Cha S; Cao Z; Zhou G; Geffner T; Chen X; Livne M; Zhang Z; Zhang T; Gion K; Bronstein MM; Steinegger M; Deibler K; Soderling S; Schoeder CT; Khmelinskaia A; Hollfelder F; Dallago C; Kucukbenli E; Vahdat A; Ogden P; Kreis K
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出潜空间生成搜索框架，利用奖励引导的推理时搜索驱动Proteina-Complexa生成模型协同设计蛋白序列与结构，实现针对极性表位和柔性配体的全新蛋白结合剂设计，直接命中蛋白质结构生成与设计核心问题，方法创新性强。
papers.abstract: De novo protein design has advanced rapidly, yet designing binders to polar, solvent-exposed epitopes and small, flexible ligands remains challenging. Such hydrated surfaces and flexible molecules, including carbohydrates, provide few of the hydrophobic contacts favoured by current methods and have largely resisted de novo binders. To address this challenge, here we introduce latent generative search for binder design, a novel framework that uses reward-guided search at inference time to steer the Proteina-Complexa generative model. The model codesigns sequence and structure - generating them together in a continuous latent space - and thereby removes the inverse-folding step on which current methods rely. In a screen of more than one million designs by multiplexed phage display, latent generative search produced more validated binders than every other method tested, its codesigned sequences surpassing post hoc redesign.
