Receptor/sensor protein structures derived from AlphaFold predictions, X-ray crystallography, or cryo-electron microscopy were retrieved, prepared, and refined for molecular docking. Ligand structures included the reference agonists tetrachlorodibenzodioxin and tert‑butylhydroquinone, as well as the environmental pollutants climbazole, daidzein, thiabendazole, and metazachlor. Docking was performed using AutoDock Vina, generating the best-energy poses for each ligand-protein pair within defined docking grids. AlphaFold-predicted structures were evaluated by parallel docking into available partial X-ray crystal structures of the corresponding variants. For Keap1 variants, blind and site-directed docking approaches were applied, including grids covering reactive cysteine-associated binding regions, and potential effects of Keap1 dimerisation were considered. For AhR variants, docking focused on the PAS-B ligand-binding domain. Protein sequence alignment was conducted using the ClustalW algorithm to compare human and zebrafish receptor/sensor variants and support cross-species comparison of docking outputs. The dataset comprises prepared protein and ligand files, representative docking poses, binding-affinity outputs, and sequence-alignment data. These files provide reusable input and output material for comparative toxicology, cross-species extrapolation, receptor-ligand interaction assessment, and benchmarking of molecular docking workflows. The data may inform scientists and regulators interested in molecular initiating events, toxicity-pathway conservation, and interspecies differences in receptor-mediated responses. This data article complements a related research article by providing supporting docking data, receptor/sensor variant sequence-alignments, and quality-assurance procedures for the molecular docking workflow.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对不良细胞结局的生物分析方法在环境毒理学中的应用日益广泛，包括与饮用水、废水及其他环境样品高通量监测相关的受体介导毒性通路。然而，尽管这些方法在监管接受度上不断提升，源自人体组织的生物测定在评估对水生生物毒性方面的代表性仍不确定。鉴于这些情况，本数据文章提供了分子对接和序列比对数据集，用于比较与氧化应激反应（Keap1/Nrf2）和外源物代谢（AhR/ARNT）通路相关的人源和斑马鱼受体/传感器变体。数据集包括hKeap1、zfKeap1a和zfKeap1b，以及hAhR、zfAhR1a、zfAhR1b和zfAhR2受体/传感器变体的对接数据，并涉及选定的参考配体和环境污染物。受体/传感器蛋白结构来源于AlphaFold预测、X射线晶体学或冷冻电镜，经过检索、制备和优化后进行分子对接。配体结构包括参考激动剂四氯二苯并二噁英和叔丁基对苯二酚，以及环境污染物克霉唑、大豆苷元、噻菌灵和甲氧咪草烟。对接使用AutoDock Vina进行，在定义的对接网格内生成每个配体-蛋白对的最佳能量构象。AlphaFold预测结构通过与相应变体的可用部分X射线晶体结构进行平行对接来评估。对于Keap1变体，采用了盲对接和定点对接方法，包括覆盖反应性半胱氨酸相关结合区域的网格，并考虑了Keap1二聚化的潜在影响。对于AhR变体，对接聚焦于PAS-B配体结合域。蛋白序列比对使用ClustalW算法进行，以比较人源和斑马鱼受体/传感器变体，并支持对接结果的跨物种比较。数据集包含制备好的蛋白和配体文件、代表性对接构象、结合亲和力输出和序列比对数据。这些文件为比较毒理学、跨物种外推、受体-配体相互作用评估以及分子对接工作流程的基准测试提供了可重复使用的输入和输出材料。这些数据可为关注分子起始事件、毒性通路保守性以及受体介导反应中物种间差异的科学家和监管人员提供参考。本数据文章通过提供支持性对接数据、受体/传感器变体序列比对和分子对接工作流程的质量保证程序，补充了相关研究文章。

papers.title: An Engineered beta-Aminopeptidase With Better Product Selectivity for L-Carnosine Production.
papers.authors: Guan, Bi-Han; Yin, Wu-Tong; Zhao, Chen; Pan, Jiang; Xu, Jian-He
papers.journal: Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过结构引导突变和分子动力学模拟工程化β-氨基肽酶以提高L-肌肽合成选择性，虽以酶工程为主，但涉及蛋白质结构计算和MD模拟，对蛋白结构-功能关系研究有参考价值。
papers.abstract: Efficient enzymaticsynthesis of L-carnosine (L-Car) is often limited by competing hydrolysis and side reactions that reduce substrate utilization and product yield. In this study, a beta-aminopeptidase (CbAP) from Caulobacter sp. was systematically engineered to enhance catalytic selectivity toward L-Car using beta-alaninamide and L-histidine as substrates. Analysis of beta-alaninamide-derived byproducts revealed two major competing pathways, namely beta-alaninamide hydrolysis and self-ligation into short oligopeptides. To evaluate the balance between L-Car synthesis and competing reactions, a composite apparent selectivity index (R(S)) was introduced. Structure-guided mutagenesis targeting residues within 4-6 A of the active site identified several improved variants. Iterative combination of beneficial mutations yielded the optimal mutant CbAP(Q138FF96Y) (CbAP(M2)), exhibiting an approximately 2.3-fold increase in R(S) relative to Q138F and an approximately 3.1-fold increase relative to the wild-type enzyme, with substantial suppression of undesired side reactions. Molecular dynamics simulations indicated that these improvements arise from reduced substrate binding stability and disrupted hydrogen-bonding interactions with beta-alaninamide and L-Car. Under optimized 10 mL-scale conditions, CbAP(M2) produced 37.3 mM L-Car within 1 h, corresponding to a 74.6% yield based on beta-alanine methyl ester, with an STY of 8.44 g L(-) (1) h(-1).
papers.abstract_zh: L-肌肽（L-Car）的高效酶法合成常受竞争性水解和副反应限制，这些反应降低了底物利用率和产物产率。在本研究中，来自柄杆菌属（Caulobacter sp.）的β-氨基肽酶（CbAP）被系统改造，以增强其以β-丙氨酰胺和L-组氨酸为底物时对L-Car的催化选择性。对β-丙氨酰胺衍生副产物的分析揭示了两个主要竞争途径，即β-丙氨酰胺水解和自连接形成短寡肽。为评估L-Car合成与竞争反应之间的平衡，引入了复合表观选择性指数（R(S)）。针对活性位点4-6 Å范围内残基的结构引导突变鉴定出若干改进变体。有益突变的迭代组合产生了最优突变体CbAP(Q138FF96Y)（CbAP(M2)），其R(S)相对于Q138F提高了约2.3倍，相对于野生型酶提高了约3.1倍，并显著抑制了不良副反应。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟表明，这些改进源于底物结合稳定性降低以及与β-丙氨酰胺和L-Car的氢键相互作用被破坏。在优化的10 mL规模条件下，CbAP(M2)在1小时内产生37.3 mM L-Car，基于β-丙氨酸甲酯的产率为74.6%，时空产率（STY）为8.44 g L⁻¹ h⁻¹。

papers.title: Molecular Dynamics Simulations Suggest Folded Chain Ends Compatible with the Cellulose-II Fibril Structure.
papers.authors: Kong, Linghan; Eichhorn, Stephen J; Bryce, Richard A
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究纤维素-II晶体中链折叠末端的结构可行性，对象为多糖而非蛋白质，但MD方法可迁移至蛋白质构象采样，与课题关系较弱。
papers.abstract: The structural feasibility of chain folding within an accepted cellulose-II structure is investigated in this study. We incorporate 3-residue and 5-residue folded glucosyl turns into a cellulose-II fibril crystal model to assess if the dominant structure can be retained. Ten candidate turn models were generated by metadynamics simulations and ranked by semiempirical quantum mechanical energies. Across >30 independent 300 ns molecular dynamics trajectories, the crystalline core retains its unit cell parameters, X-ray diffraction pattern, hydrogen bonding network, and canonical 4C1 ring conformation. This suggests that, should such folds be present, they need not compromise bulk crystalline integrity. No significant fibril twisting was observed in either the unfolded or chain-fold models. At the chain-folding ends of the fibril, high-energy boat and skew-boat conformations drive hydroxymethyl rotamer redistribution and noncanonical hydrogen bonding contacts. The greater structural flexibility of the 5-residue folded turns allows the chain-fold ends to access a broader conformational space, yet the structural perturbation remains localized within the same 3-residue region as the 3-residue folded turns. The 3-residue turn is therefore considered the more plausible chain-fold structure for cellulose-II, should such a structure actually exist in reality.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在公认的纤维素-II结构中链折叠的结构可行性。我们将3残基和5残基折叠的葡萄糖基转角纳入纤维素-II原纤维晶体模型，以评估主导结构是否能够得以保留。通过元动力学模拟生成了十个候选转角模型，并依据半经验量子力学能量进行排序。在超过30条独立的300 ns分子动力学轨迹中，晶体核心保持了其晶胞参数、X射线衍射图谱、氢键网络以及经典的4C1环构象。这表明，若此类折叠确实存在，它们未必会损害块体晶体的完整性。在未折叠模型和链折叠模型中均未观察到显著的原纤维扭转。在原纤维的链折叠末端，高能量的船式和扭船式构象驱动羟甲基旋转异构体重新分布及非经典氢键接触。5残基折叠转角具有更大的结构灵活性，使得链折叠末端能够进入更广泛的构象空间，但结构扰动仍局限于与3残基折叠转角相同的3残基区域内。因此，若此类结构在现实中确实存在，3残基转角被认为是纤维素-II更合理的链折叠结构。

papers.title: Dynamic inter-glycan interactions regulate site-specific N-glycan maturation in human Fcgamma receptor III.
papers.authors: Zhang, Yue; Yagi, Hirokazu; Okina, Masako; Hashimoto, Yutaka; Kato, Koichi; Yamaguchi, Takumi
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文结合糖基化位点突变与分子动力学模拟，研究FcgammaRIII中相邻聚糖动态互作对位点特异性N-糖基化成熟的调控，虽以糖蛋白为对象，但MD模拟方法可迁移至蛋白质结构计算研究。
papers.abstract: Protein N-glycosylation generates diverse glycoforms that influence protein structure and function, yet the molecular rules governing site-specific glycan maturation remain incompletely understood. Accumulating evidence indicates that glycosylation outcomes are shaped by determinants embedded within glycoproteins themselves, beyond enzyme availability alone. Here, we investigate how neighboring glycans modulate site-specific N-glycan maturation in human Fcgamma receptor III (FcgammaRIII). Building on previous glycoproteomic studies showing restricted processing of the N45 glycan in FcgammaRIII molecules, we combined reciprocal glycosylation-site mutagenesis with molecular dynamics simulations. Introduction of an N64 glycosylation sequon into FcgammaRIIIa reduced N45 glycan maturation, whereas removal of the N64 sequon from FcgammaRIIIb produced the reciprocal effect. Simulations using glycan models, analyzed primarily by contact maps and contact frequencies, showed that the N45 glycan dynamically contacts neighboring N64 and N169 glycans. These findings support a model in which the isoform-specific N64 glycan, in addition to the adjacent N169 glycan shared by both FcgammaRIII isoforms, contributes to reduced N45 glycan maturation by reshaping the local glycan environment around N45.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白质N-糖基化产生多种糖型，这些糖型影响蛋白质的结构与功能，然而调控位点特异性聚糖成熟的分子规则仍未完全阐明。累积证据表明，糖基化结果受糖蛋白自身嵌入的决定因素塑造，而不仅仅依赖于酶的可用性。在此，我们研究了邻近聚糖如何调节人Fcgamma受体III（FcgammaRIII）中的位点特异性N-聚糖成熟。基于先前糖蛋白组学研究显示FcgammaRIII分子中N45聚糖加工受限，我们将互惠糖基化位点突变与分子动力学模拟相结合。在FcgammaRIIIa中引入N64糖基化序列降低了N45聚糖成熟，而从FcgammaRIIIb中移除N64序列则产生相反效果。使用聚糖模型进行的模拟，主要通过接触图和接触频率分析，显示N45聚糖动态接触邻近的N64和N169聚糖。这些发现支持一个模型，即异构体特异性的N64聚糖，连同FcgammaRIII两种异构体共有的相邻N169聚糖，通过重塑N45周围的局部聚糖环境，共同促成N45聚糖成熟的减少。

papers.title: A Dual-Mode Crystal Structure Prediction Framework for Fixed Element Sets and Fixed Structural Prototypes.
papers.authors: Qin, Chenglong; Luo, Xiangyan; Fan, Zhixiang; Fan, Qunchao
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出一种面向晶体结构预测的双模式深度学习框架，虽以无机材料为对象，但其结构生成与元素替换算法可迁移至蛋白质结构计算，具有方法借鉴价值。
papers.abstract: Crystal structure prediction (CSP) is a cornerstone technology for the efficient discovery and rational design of functional materials. Here, we propose a deep-learning-enabled dual-mode CSP framework that simultaneously supports two complementary tasks: predicting stable crystal structures for given elemental compositions and identifying chemically viable elemental substitutions for a predefined crystal topology. The framework employs an improved normalized structural fingerprint descriptor that integrates local coordination topology without global spatial-scale information. A cascaded site-probability model, composed of an autoencoder and sigmoid-based classifiers, is developed to predict the occupancy probabilities of 84 chemical elements at crystallographically distinct sites and to efficiently rank candidate structures accordingly. Remarkably, even when trained solely on topological information, the model autonomously captures elemental chemical similarity and intrinsic periodic trends, yielding chemically meaningful multielement probability distributions. Application of the proposed framework to high-throughput screening of superhard materials in the B-N system successfully identifies a thermodynamically, mechanically, and dynamically stable hexagonal BN phase, together with a metastable monoclinic B2N3 structure. Furthermore, elemental substitution screening on the zinc-blende prototype reveals two metastable compounds, In4Sb4 and Ga4Sb4. The proposed framework provides a low-cost, high-efficiency, data-driven strategy for the rapid discovery of inorganic materials.
papers.abstract_zh: 晶体结构预测（CSP）是高效发现和理性设计功能材料的关键技术。在此，我们提出了一种基于深度学习的双模式CSP框架，同时支持两个互补任务：针对给定元素组成预测稳定晶体结构，以及为预定义晶体拓扑识别化学上可行的元素替代。该框架采用一种改进的归一化结构指纹描述符，该描述符整合了局部配位拓扑而不包含全局空间尺度信息。开发了一个级联位点概率模型，由自编码器和基于Sigmoid的分类器组成，用于预测84种化学元素在晶体学上不同位点的占据概率，并据此高效地对候选结构进行排序。值得注意的是，即使仅基于拓扑信息进行训练，该模型也能自主捕捉元素化学相似性和内在周期趋势，产生具有化学意义的多元素概率分布。将该框架应用于B-N体系中超硬材料的高通量筛选，成功识别出一种热力学、力学和动力学稳定的六方BN相，以及一种亚稳态的单斜B2N3结构。此外，在闪锌矿原型上的元素替代筛选揭示了两种亚稳态化合物In4Sb4和Ga4Sb4。该框架为无机材料的快速发现提供了一种低成本、高效率的数据驱动策略。

papers.title: Closing the Empirical Loop: Autonomous AI Agents Conduct End-to-end Research With Human Participants.
papers.authors: Wehr, Gabrielle; Rideaux, Reuben; Fox, Amaya J; Lightfoot, David R; Tangen, Jason; Mattingley, Jason B; Ehrhardt, Shane E
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文介绍自主AI智能体完成心理学实验研究，虽提及蛋白质结构预测但非核心，不涉及蛋白质结构计算建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence systems are transforming scientific discovery by accelerating specific research tasks, from protein structure prediction to materials design, yet remain confined to narrow domains requiring substantial human oversight. Exponential growth of scientific literature and increasing domain specialization constrain researchers' capacity to synthesize knowledge across disciplines and develop unifying theories, motivating exploration of general-purpose AI systems for science. Here we show that a domain-agnostic, agentic AI Scientist system can independently navigate the scientific workflow -from hypothesis generation through data collection to manuscript preparation. The system autonomously designed and executed three psychological studies on visual working memory, mental rotation, and imagery vividness, executed online data collection with 288 participants, developed analysis pipelines through 8h+ continuous coding sessions, and produced completed manuscripts. The results demonstrate the capability of AI scientific discovery pipelines to conduct research with theoretical reasoning and methodological rigor comparable to experienced researchers, though with limitations in conceptual nuance and theoretical interpretation. This is a step toward embodied AI that can test hypotheses through real-world experiments, accelerating discovery by autonomously exploring regions of scientific space that human cognitive and resource constraints might otherwise leave unexplored. It raises important questions about the nature of scientific understanding and attribution of scientific credit.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能系统正通过加速特定研究任务（从蛋白质结构预测到材料设计）来变革科学发现，但仍局限于狭窄领域，需要大量人类监督。科学文献的指数级增长和领域专业化的加深，限制了研究者跨学科综合知识并发展统一理论的能力，这促使人们探索面向科学的通用人工智能系统。在此，我们展示了一个领域无关的、代理型AI科学家系统能够独立导航科学工作流程——从假设生成到数据收集，再到手稿准备。该系统自主设计并执行了三项关于视觉工作记忆、心理旋转和意象生动性的心理学研究，通过在线数据收集获取了288名参与者的数据，在8小时以上的连续编码会话中开发了分析流程，并产出了完整的手稿。结果表明，AI科学发现流程能够以与经验丰富的研究者相当的理论推理和方法论严谨性进行研究，尽管在概念细微差别和理论解释方面存在局限。这是向具身AI迈出的一步，使其能够通过真实世界实验检验假设，通过自主探索人类认知和资源限制可能无法触及的科学空间来加速发现。这引发了关于科学理解本质和科学贡献归属的重要问题。

papers.title: Ser715 Phosphorylation Induces beta-Hairpin Unfolding and Destabilization of FOXM1 Autoinhibition.
papers.authors: AlRawashdeh, Sara; Obidat, Raghd; Del Moral-Morales, Aylin; Medina-Franco, Jose L; Velazquez-Martinez, Carlos A
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过5微秒全原子分子动力学模拟揭示FOXM1磷酸化诱导β-hairpin解折叠及自抑制解除的构象变化机制，核心聚焦蛋白质构象采样与结构动态计算，方法为MD模拟，与课题高度相关。
papers.abstract: FOXM1 is a cell proliferation-driving transcription factor activated by phosphorylation-induced conformational changes. In its inactive state, an intramolecular beta-hairpin within the transactivation domain (TAD) binds the N-terminal repressor domain (NRD), forming a composite beta-sheet that locks the protein in an autoinhibited conformation. Despite the known importance of this regulatory switch, the molecular events that unlock FOXM1 remain poorly characterized. Here, we performed 5 mus all-atom molecular dynamics simulations of human FOXM1b NRD-TAD complexes in both unphosphorylated and tetra-phosphorylated states, modeling four experimentally validated regulatory phosphosites. Our results showed that phosphorylation induces local unfolding of the beta-hairpin beginning at Ser715, located at the hairpin turn, and propagates to global disruption of the NRD interface through hydrogen bond loss, salt bridge rupture, and secondary structure collapse. In contrast, the unphosphorylated complex maintains stable hairpin geometry and interdomain contacts. Additional replicate tetra-phosphorylated simulations and a monophosphorylated Ser715 simulation reproduced the beta-hairpin unfolding event, supporting both reproducibility and the sufficiency of Ser715 phosphorylation in initiating this transition. Per-residue MM-PBSA energy decomposition further reveals that phosphorylation redistributes interdomain interaction energetics, with Ser715 emerging as the dominant locus of energetic perturbation despite the presence of multiple phosphosites. Together, these findings support a phosphorylation-triggered order-to-disorder transition that relieves FOXM1 autoinhibition and highlight Ser715 as a key structural and energetic switch. Our study provides a dynamic molecular framework for targeting FOXM1 activation via its regulatory fold.
papers.abstract_zh: FOXM1是一种由磷酸化诱导构象变化激活的细胞增殖驱动转录因子。在其非活性状态下，反式激活域（TAD）内的分子内β-发夹与N端抑制域（NRD）结合，形成复合β-折叠，将蛋白质锁定在自抑制构象中。尽管已知此调控开关的重要性，但解锁FOXM1的分子事件仍鲜有表征。在此，我们对人FOXM1b NRD-TAD复合物进行了5微秒全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，涵盖非磷酸化和四磷酸化状态，建模了四个经实验验证的调控磷酸化位点。结果表明，磷酸化诱导β-发夹从Ser715（位于发夹转角处）开始的局部解折叠，并通过氢键丢失、盐桥断裂和二级结构崩溃传播至NRD界面的全局破坏。相比之下，非磷酸化复合物保持稳定的发夹几何结构和域间接触。额外的重复四磷酸化模拟和单磷酸化Ser715模拟重现了β-发夹解折叠事件，支持了该转变的可重复性以及Ser715磷酸化在启动此过程中的充分性。逐残基MM-PBSA能量分解进一步揭示，磷酸化重新分配了域间相互作用能量，尽管存在多个磷酸化位点，Ser715仍成为能量扰动的主要位点。综合这些发现，支持了一种磷酸化触发的有序到无序转变，解除FOXM1自抑制，并突出Ser715作为关键结构和能量开关。我们的研究为通过其调控折叠靶向FOXM1激活提供了动态分子框架。

papers.title: Mechanistic Origins of Enhanced PET Hydrolase Activity from Molecular Dynamics and Deep Learning-Assisted Network Analysis.
papers.authors: Wang, Jiawen; Pan, Haozhe; Dong, Huilong; Ji, Yujin; Li, Youyong
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟、增强采样和深度学习辅助网络分析，揭示PET水解酶LCC变体高活性的预反应态机制，属于蛋白质结构-动力学-功能关系计算研究，与蛋白质结构计算课题高度相关。
papers.abstract: Polyethylene terephthalate (PET) hydrolase-based biodegradation offers a promising route for plastic waste remediation, yet the dynamic origins of high activity and their linkage across catalytic stages still require further elucidation. Here, we focus on the Leaf-Branch Compost Cutinase (LCC) system to reveal the possible mechanistic origins underlying the elevated activity of the LCC variants. By integrating molecular dynamics simulations, enhanced sampling, and deep learning-assisted network analysis, we systematically investigate the critical prereactive stage of amorphous PET adsorption and substrate binding. We identify three mechanistic origins underlying the high activity of LCC-LANL in the prereactive state and clarify its structure-dynamics-function relationship: (i) enhanced interaction strength coupled with an active-pocket orientation that, despite not directly facing the amorphous PET surface, maintains closer proximity to it than LCC-WT, thus promoting substrate recruitment; (ii) higher occupancy of the PET ester bond near the catalytic triad, which forms the basis for catalysis, coupled with the efficient dynamic interchange between the "W" and coiled conformations near the catalytic triad; and (iii) the enhancement of prereactive organization through long-range allosteric communication by distal mutations in LCC-LANL. Additionally, we propose a region-specific cooperative optimization strategy tailored to domain-specific functional roles and distill six design principles for efficient PETases. In summary, this work elucidates the prereactive origins underlying the high activity of LCC-LANL, paving the way for future studies on actual catalytic PET hydrolysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）水解酶的生物降解为塑料废物治理提供了一条有前景的途径，然而高活性的动态起源及其在催化阶段之间的关联仍需进一步阐明。在此，我们聚焦于叶枝堆肥角质酶（LCC）系统，以揭示LCC变体高活性背后可能的机制起源。通过整合分子动力学模拟、增强采样和深度学习辅助网络分析，我们系统研究了无定形PET吸附和底物结合的关键预反应阶段。我们识别出LCC-LANL在预反应状态下高活性的三个机制起源，并阐明其结构-动力学-功能关系：（i）增强的相互作用强度结合活性口袋取向，尽管不直接面向无定形PET表面，但比LCC-WT更接近该表面，从而促进底物募集；（ii）PET酯键在催化三联体附近具有更高的占据率，这构成催化的基础，同时伴随催化三联体附近“W”构象与卷曲构象之间的高效动态互换；（iii）通过LCC-LANL中远端突变的长程变构通信增强预反应组织。此外，我们提出一种针对结构域特定功能角色的区域特异性协同优化策略，并提炼出高效PET酶的六项设计原则。总之，本研究阐明了LCC-LANL高活性的预反应起源，为未来实际催化PET水解的研究铺平了道路。

papers.title: Combining AI Structure Prediction and Integrative Modeling for Nanobody-Antigen Complexes.
papers.authors: Sanchez-Marin, Miguel; Giulini, Marco; Bonvin, Alexandre M J J
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究结合AlphaFold2/ImmuneBuilder结构预测与HADDOCK集成对接，构建纳米抗体-抗原复合物结构预测流程，属于蛋白质结构计算建模与AI/物理模拟结合的方法创新。
papers.abstract: Nanobodies exhibit antigen-binding affinities of the same order as those of antibodies, which, along with their small size and unique structural characteristics, makes them well-suited for therapeutic and diagnostic applications. The lack of coevolutionary signals in nanobody-antigen complexes, together with the broad complementarity determining region 3 loop (CDR3) conformational space, poses a challenge for predicting the 3D structure of those complexes with computational modeling and artificial intelligence-based methods. In this context, physics-based information-driven docking can provide an alternative solution. This study evaluates the state-of-the-art machine-learning-based methods for nanobody structure prediction and benchmarks various HADDOCK workflows to model their interaction with antigens using different input nanobody ensembles and information scenarios. We propose an ensemble docking pipeline that achieves high success rates starting from nanobody structural models predicted by AlphaFold2 and ImmuneBuilder. Provided that some information on the epitope is available, our pipeline achieves higher success rates than the AlphaFold baseline on all generated models.
papers.abstract_zh: 纳米抗体（nanobodies）对抗原的结合亲和力与抗体处于同一数量级，加之其体积小和独特的结构特征，使其非常适合治疗和诊断应用。然而，纳米抗体-抗原复合物中缺乏共进化信号，加上互补决定区3环（CDR3）构象空间广泛，这给通过计算建模和基于人工智能的方法预测这些复合物的三维结构带来了挑战。在此背景下，基于物理学的信息驱动对接可提供一种替代解决方案。本研究评估了最先进的基于机器学习的纳米抗体结构预测方法，并基准测试了多种HADDOCK工作流程，以使用不同的输入纳米抗体集合和信息场景来模拟其与抗原的相互作用。我们提出了一种集成对接流程，该流程从AlphaFold2和ImmuneBuilder预测的纳米抗体结构模型出发，实现了高成功率。在可获得表位某些信息的前提下，我们的流程在所有生成的模型上均取得了高于AlphaFold基线的成功率。

papers.title: Biasing Conformational Sampling in AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2 via Pair Representation Scaling.
papers.authors: Suzuki, Shosuke; Amagasa, Toshiyuki
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出一种无需重训练的推理时方法，通过缩放AlphaFold 3和Boltz-2的pair表示来偏置构象采样，从而恢复蛋白质的替代功能态，直接针对蛋白质构象采样这一核心计算问题，方法创新且可迁移。
papers.abstract: Deep learning has transformed protein structure prediction, yet most systems return a single dominant conformation with little control over the alternative functional states. We introduce pair representation scaling, an inference-time method that biases conformational sampling in diffusion-based structure predictors by multiplying the latent pair representation by a single scalar before the Pairformer trunk, without retraining, an auxiliary model, or a second forward pass. On 86 two-state targets spanning domain motions and membrane transporters, scaling broadens the conformational ensembles of both AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2 and recovers alternative states that default inference misses, most strongly in AlphaFold 3, where the gains extend even to targets deposited after the training cutoff. It approaches the alternative-state recovery of alignment-based sampling methods, and the benefit persists even without a multiple-sequence alignment. The predicted distance distributions show that scaling shifts the encoded two-state distribution toward the experimentally observed alternative state, a directed modulation rather than an arbitrary perturbation. Pair representation scaling is an interpretable, low-cost handle for the conformational ensembles of deep-learning structure predictors.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度学习已彻底改变了蛋白质结构预测，但大多数系统仅返回单一主导构象，对替代功能状态的控制有限。我们引入了配对表示缩放（pair representation scaling），这是一种推理时方法，通过在Pairformer主干之前将潜在配对表示乘以单一标量，来偏置基于扩散的结构预测器中的构象采样，无需重新训练、辅助模型或第二次前向传播。在涵盖结构域运动和膜转运蛋白的86个双态靶标上，缩放拓宽了AlphaFold 3和Boltz-2的构象系综，并恢复了默认推理遗漏的替代状态，在AlphaFold 3中效果最为显著，其增益甚至扩展到训练截止日期后提交的靶标。该方法接近基于比对采样方法的替代状态恢复能力，且即使在没有多序列比对的情况下，其益处依然存在。预测的距离分布表明，缩放将编码的双态分布向实验观察到的替代状态移动，这是一种定向调制而非任意扰动。配对表示缩放为深度学习结构预测器的构象系综提供了一个可解释、低成本的调控手段。

papers.title: To ML-Predict or Not to ML-Predict: The Impact of Machine Learning-Predicted Protein Structures on FEP Accuracy and Data Augmentation.
papers.authors: Dryja, Parker; Muller, Morne; Horn, Monique; Balabin, Ilya; Dentmon, Zackery W; Rimal, Prawin; Peterson, Yuri K; Joubert, Fourie; Kaiser, Thomas M; Burger, Pieter B
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文系统评估了ML预测蛋白结构（如AlphaFold2/3）作为FEP计算输入的性能，聚焦蛋白-配体复合物结构对自由能预测精度的影响，属于蛋白质结构计算与物理模拟结合的应用研究，但方法创新性有限。
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of machine learning (ML)-based protein structure prediction, exemplified by AlphaFold2 and extended by newer models such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2, has generated significant optimism for structure-guided drug discovery. In particular, ligand-protein cofolding approaches offer the potential to overcome limitations in generating starting structures for physics-based free energy perturbation (FEP) calculations. However, the practical readiness of ML-predicted structures for FEP applications remains insufficiently evaluated. Here, we systematically assess experimentally determined crystal structures, a homology model, and ML-predicted protein structures as inputs for FEP using a well-characterized congeneric series targeting the tyrosine kinase cSrc. A data set of 133 compounds was evaluated through more than 1400 FEP calculations under minimal optimization to approximate "out-of-the-box" performance. By maintaining consistent preparation protocols, we isolate the impact of structural origin on predictive accuracy. Variable performance was observed across both experimental and ML-predicted structures, highlighting that even under this idealized benchmark scenario, significant challenges remain in reliably generating and refining predictive protein-ligand complexes. This study demonstrates that predictive variation in micro and macro conformational states horizontal line rather than the structural source horizontal line governs predictive reliability, underscoring the need for careful validation when integrating ML-derived structures into FEP workflows.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于机器学习（ML）的蛋白质结构预测的快速发展，以AlphaFold2为代表，并由AlphaFold3和Boltz-2等新模型进一步扩展，为结构引导的药物发现带来了巨大乐观前景。特别是，配体-蛋白质共折叠方法有望克服基于物理的自由能微扰（FEP）计算中起始结构生成的局限性。然而，ML预测结构在FEP应用中的实际准备程度仍未得到充分评估。在此，我们系统评估了实验确定的晶体结构、同源模型以及ML预测的蛋白质结构作为FEP输入，使用一个针对酪氨酸激酶cSrc的充分表征的同源系列化合物。在最小优化条件下，通过超过1400次FEP计算评估了133个化合物的数据集，以近似“开箱即用”的性能。通过保持一致的制备方案，我们隔离了结构来源对预测准确性的影响。在实验和ML预测结构中均观察到可变的性能，突显即使在理想化基准场景下，可靠生成和优化预测性蛋白质-配体复合物仍面临重大挑战。本研究表明，微宏观构象状态中的预测变异性（而非结构来源）主导了预测可靠性，强调在将ML衍生结构整合到FEP工作流中时需进行仔细验证。

papers.title: AI-Driven Drug-Target Interaction Prediction: From Data Representation to Model Design.
papers.authors: Hu, Jiaxuan; Wu, Lianlian; He, Song; Bo, Xiaochen; Lu, Jiang
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文是AI驱动的药物-靶点相互作用预测综述，涵盖数据表示与模型设计，虽以药物-靶点相互作用为核心而非纯蛋白质结构计算，但涉及蛋白质结构表示与复合物结构预测，对蛋白结构相关计算建模有参考价值。
papers.abstract: Drug-target interaction (DTI) prediction is central to drug discovery, target identification, and drug repurposing. With the rapid growth of biomedical data and advances in artificial intelligence (AI), DTI prediction has shifted from docking, similarity-based inference, and hand-crafted features toward data-driven representation learning and interaction modeling. This review examines AI-driven DTI prediction methodologies, covering binding theories, task formulations, data representation, model design, translational applications, and unresolved challenges. First, we introduce classical molecular binding theories, including the lock-and-key model, induced fit, and conformational selection, highlighting the transition from static matching to dynamic interaction. Second, we summarize major DTI task settings, including binary interaction classification, binding affinity regression, and multitask prediction with uncertainty assessment. We then discuss data resources and multimodal representation approaches for drugs, target proteins, interaction labels, and auxiliary biomedical data, including molecular sequences, graph structures, 3D conformations, physicochemical properties, biological perturbation profiles, protein sequences and structures, and biomedical knowledge networks. Representative approaches are compared across orthogonal methodological dimensions, including input representation, encoder architecture, interaction-modeling mechanism, representation learning and pretraining, learning objective, prediction output, data acquisition or optimization strategy, and generalization setting. Finally, we outline DTI applications in disease target mining, compound virtual screening, affinity and selectivity optimization, complex structure prediction, and industrial drug discovery pipelines and discuss key challenges such as data distribution shifts, dynamic protein conformational variability, and insufficient experimental validation. This survey aims to provide a systematic reference for future algorithm design, mechanism exploration, and real-world drug discovery applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 药物-靶点相互作用（drug-target interaction, DTI）预测是药物发现、靶点识别和药物重定位的核心环节。随着生物医学数据的快速增长和人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）的进步，DTI预测已从对接、基于相似性的推断和手工特征工程转向数据驱动的表示学习和相互作用建模。本综述审视了AI驱动的DTI预测方法，涵盖结合理论、任务设定、数据表示、模型设计、转化应用及未解决的挑战。首先，我们介绍经典分子结合理论，包括锁钥模型、诱导契合和构象选择，强调从静态匹配到动态相互作用的转变。其次，我们总结主要的DTI任务设置，包括二元相互作用分类、结合亲和力回归以及带不确定性评估的多任务预测。随后，我们讨论药物、靶点蛋白、相互作用标签及辅助生物医学数据的数据资源和多模态表示方法，涵盖分子序列、图结构、三维构象、理化性质、生物扰动谱、蛋白序列与结构以及生物医学知识网络。代表性方法在正交的方法论维度上进行比较，包括输入表示、编码器架构、相互作用建模机制、表示学习与预训练、学习目标、预测输出、数据获取或优化策略以及泛化设置。最后，我们概述DTI在疾病靶点挖掘、化合物虚拟筛选、亲和力与选择性优化、复合物结构预测及工业药物发现流程中的应用，并讨论关键挑战，如数据分布偏移、动态蛋白构象变异和实验验证不足。本综述旨在为未来算法设计、机制探索及实际药物发现应用提供系统性参考。

papers.title: Mutation-Guided Recovery of Ligand-Compatible Holo-Like Conformations in Proteins with Cryptic Pockets.
papers.authors: Routh, Reshob; Radhakrishna, Mithun
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出一种计算框架，利用预测的隐秘口袋残基作为突变手柄扰动自由能景观，从apo结构恢复可结合配体的holo样构象，并通过MD和对接验证，核心贡献在蛋白质构象采样与结构计算建模。
papers.abstract: Cryptic pockets are transient ligand-binding sites that remain hidden in apo protein structures and become accessible only through conformational change, making them difficult to identify and exploit in structure-based ligand discovery. Although recent AI/ML approaches can identify residues associated with cryptic pocket formation, they do not directly yield the corresponding holo-like conformations. Enhanced-sampling and mixed-solvent strategies can promote pocket opening, but often under non-native conditions and without demonstrating stable ligand-bound holo-like states. Here, we present a computational framework in which residues with high cryptic-pocket propensity are used as mutation handles to perturb the free-energy landscape and expose ligand-compatible open states even in the absence of ligand binding. We establish this strategy on TEM-1 beta-lactamase, a canonical cryptic-pocket system, and show that mutation-induced perturbations can shift the conformational ensemble toward an open pocket state prior to ligand binding. The resulting open state supports ligand binding in both docked structures and unbiased simulations, and the ligand remains stably bound after reversion to the wild-type sequence, consistent with recovery of a holo-like wild-type conformation. Importantly, the residues targeted for mutation are not the principal determinants of the ligand interactions observed in the bound state, indicating that their role is to reshape the conformational landscape and promote access to an open, ligand-compatible pocket rather than to form the binding interface itself. We further generalize this framework to LfrR, FtsZ, and Bombyx mori pheromone-binding protein, where mutation of predicted cryptic residues likewise generates open conformations capable of supporting ligand binding. Together, these results show that cryptic residue predictions can be used not only to identify hidden binding sites but also to recover holo-like conformations from apo structures, providing a practical framework for studying and targeting cryptic pockets.
papers.abstract_zh: 隐秘口袋（cryptic pockets）是瞬态的配体结合位点，在脱辅基（apo）蛋白结构中保持隐藏，仅通过构象变化才变得可及，这使得它们在基于结构的配体发现中难以识别和利用。尽管近期的AI/ML方法能够识别与隐秘口袋形成相关的残基，但它们并不直接产生相应的全样（holo-like）构象。增强采样和混合溶剂策略可以促进口袋开放，但往往在非天然条件下进行，且未证明稳定的配体结合全样状态。在此，我们提出一个计算框架，其中具有高隐秘口袋倾向性的残基被用作突变手柄，以扰动自由能景观并在缺乏配体结合的情况下暴露配体兼容的开放状态。我们在TEM-1 β-内酰胺酶（TEM-1 beta-lactamase）这一典型隐秘口袋系统上建立了该策略，并表明突变诱导的扰动可以在配体结合前将构象集合转向开放口袋状态。所得的开放状态在对接结构和无偏模拟中均支持配体结合，且在恢复野生型序列后配体仍稳定结合，这与恢复全样野生型构象一致。重要的是，靶向突变的残基并非结合态中观察到的配体相互作用的主要决定因素，表明它们的作用是重塑构象景观并促进进入开放、配体兼容的口袋，而非形成结合界面本身。我们进一步将该框架推广至LfrR、FtsZ和家蚕信息素结合蛋白（Bombyx mori pheromone-binding protein），其中预测隐秘残基的突变同样产生能够支持配体结合的开放构象。综合来看，这些结果表明隐秘残基预测不仅可用于识别隐藏结合位点，还可用于从脱辅基结构中恢复全样构象，为研究和靶向隐秘口袋提供了实用框架。

papers.title: Ensemble-Based Reconstruction and Prioritization of Binding Sites in Influenza A Nucleoprotein.
papers.authors: Qi, Xinyu; Rahali, Ines Sabine; Munier, Sandie; Badel, Anne; Flatters, Delphine; Camproux, Anne-Claude
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文基于分子动力学模拟的流感核蛋白构象系综重建并优先排序动态结合口袋，属于蛋白质构象采样与结合位点计算分析，与蛋白质结构计算课题高度相关。
papers.abstract: Influenza A nucleoprotein (NP) is essential for viral RNA binding, ribonucleoprotein assembly, and NP oligomerization, making it an attractive antiviral target; however, static structures incompletely capture the conformational variability governing pocket formation and accessibility. Here, 17,178 pockets detected across 753 monomeric NP conformations from three independent molecular dynamics simulations were grouped by pocket-lining residue composition to reconstruct recurrent binding-site regions. Six potentially druggable sites were retained and characterized according to their recurrence, residue-level organization, conformational plasticity, and assembly context, revealing three compact, residue-stable sites, two adaptive RNA-proximal regions, and an extended E339-centered interdomain groove. Four sites corresponded to experimentally characterized or structurally supported ligand-binding environments, while assembly mapping revealed context-dependent exposure near RNA- and NP-NP interaction surfaces, thereby identifying dynamic NP binding-site regions prioritized for ligand-specific investigation and distinguishing stable pockets from plastic regions whose organization and accessibility depend on conformational and assembly context.
papers.abstract_zh: 甲型流感核蛋白（NP）对于病毒RNA结合、核糖核蛋白组装及NP寡聚化至关重要，使其成为有吸引力的抗病毒靶点；然而，静态结构无法完全捕捉控制口袋形成和可及性的构象变异性。在此，从三个独立分子动力学模拟中检测到的753个单体NP构象中识别出的17,178个口袋，根据口袋内衬残基组成进行分组，以重建反复出现的结合位点区域。保留了六个潜在可成药位点，并根据其重现性、残基水平组织、构象可塑性和组装背景进行表征，揭示出三个紧凑且残基稳定的位点、两个适应性RNA邻近区域，以及一个以E339为中心的延伸结构域间沟槽。四个位点对应于实验表征或结构支持的配体结合环境，而组装图谱揭示了RNA和NP-NP相互作用表面附近的背景依赖性暴露，从而识别出优先用于配体特异性研究的动态NP结合位点区域，并区分稳定口袋与可塑区域，后者的组织和可及性取决于构象和组装背景。

papers.title: Which Metrics Best Capture Protein Structural Changes in Molecular Dynamics Simulations? Evaluating Score Combinations and Force-Field Effects.
papers.authors: Pfaendner, Christian; Paul, Thilo; Unger, Benjamin; Pluhackova, Kristyna
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文基于268个蛋白质的MD模拟，系统评估多种结构相似性评分（RMSD、TM-score、QCS等）在捕捉构象变化中的冗余性与信息量，并揭示力场选择对评分结果的影响，直接服务于蛋白质结构计算中的构象采样与MD分析。
papers.abstract: The scores RMSD, TM-score, GDT, lDDT, SphereGrinder, CAD, QCS, FlexE, and MolProbity provide an automated, comprehensive assessment of conformational changes and structural quality of proteins and thus represent a promising tool for routine use in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, particularly in high-throughput settings. However, it remains unclear to what extent these scores provide redundant information and which scores are most informative for capturing conformational changes. Based on MD simulations of 268 diverse proteins, we demonstrate that the investigated scores are highly correlated and that one global score (or QCS), one local score, and FlexE capture almost 90% of the variance across all scores. Since MD randomness partially explains FlexE's variability, we argue that a combination of one global and one local score is sufficient for most practical applications. We also investigate the influence of simulation setups and find that the choice of the force field can significantly affect scoring results. In particular, the setup using the Amber ff19sb force field yields systematically different scores than all CHARMM36m-based setups, emphasizing the importance of methodological choices when designing MD experiments and interpreting their results.
papers.abstract_zh: 分数RMSD、TM-score、GDT、lDDT、SphereGrinder、CAD、QCS、FlexE和MolProbity提供了对蛋白质构象变化和结构质量的自动化、全面评估，因此代表了在分子动力学（MD）模拟中常规使用的有前景工具，特别是在高通量设置中。然而，这些分数在多大程度上提供冗余信息，以及哪些分数对捕捉构象变化最具信息量，仍不清楚。基于对268种多样化蛋白质的MD模拟，我们证明所研究的分数高度相关，并且一个全局分数（或QCS）、一个局部分数和FlexE几乎捕捉了所有分数中约90%的方差。由于MD随机性部分解释了FlexE的变异性，我们认为一个全局分数和一个局部分数的组合足以满足大多数实际应用。我们还研究了模拟设置的影响，发现力场的选择能显著影响评分结果。特别是，使用Amber ff19sb力场的设置产生的分数与所有基于CHARMM36m的设置系统性不同，这强调了在设计MD实验和解释其结果时方法选择的重要性。

papers.title: Exploring Protein Conformational Ensembles Using Evolutionary Conditional Diffusion.
papers.authors: Cui, Xinyue; Ge, Lingyu; Yang, Xinguang; Li, Xuhui; Hou, Dongliang; Zhou, Xiaogen; Zhang, Guijun
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于进化条件扩散的DiffEnsemble框架，从静态蛋白结构学习潜在动态表征并生成构象系综，在ATLAS基准上优于现有方法，直接命中蛋白质构象采样与生成这一核心计算问题。
papers.abstract: Protein conformational ensembles encode the dynamic landscapes underlying biological function, regulation, and allostery. Accurately reconstructing such ensembles while balancing the accuracy of conformational distributions and physical plausibility remains a fundamental challenge in structural biology, particularly when dynamic data are scarce. Here, we propose DiffEnsemble, a diffusion-based framework designed for modeling protein conformational ensembles. DiffEnsemble learns latent dynamical representations from static protein structures in the Protein Data Bank and integrates the structural profile derived from the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database as conditional guidance during the diffusion process. Benchmarking on 72 protein targets from the ATLAS molecular dynamics simulation data set demonstrates that DiffEnsemble outperforms existing methods, including BioEmu and AlphaFLOW. Compared with AlphaFLOW, DiffEnsemble achieves improvements of 28.9% and 7.5% in Pearson correlation coefficients for ensemble pairwise root-mean-square deviation and root-mean-square fluctuation, respectively. The results demonstrate that latent dynamical information embedded in static structural data can effectively support the modeling of protein conformational ensembles.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白质构象系综编码了支撑生物功能、调控和别构效应的动态景观。在平衡构象分布的准确性与物理合理性的同时，精确重建此类系综仍是结构生物学中的一项基本挑战，尤其是在动态数据稀缺的情况下。在此，我们提出DiffEnsemble，一个基于扩散的框架，旨在建模蛋白质构象系综。DiffEnsemble从蛋白质数据银行（Protein Data Bank）中的静态蛋白质结构学习潜在动态表征，并将AlphaFold蛋白质结构数据库（AlphaFold Protein Structure Database）导出的结构谱作为扩散过程中的条件引导进行整合。在来自ATLAS分子动力学模拟数据集的72个蛋白质靶标上的基准测试表明，DiffEnsemble优于现有方法，包括BioEmu和AlphaFLOW。与AlphaFLOW相比，DiffEnsemble在系综成对均方根偏差和均方根涨落的皮尔逊相关系数上分别实现了28.9%和7.5%的提升。结果表明，静态结构数据中嵌入的潜在动态信息能有效支持蛋白质构象系综的建模。

papers.title: Mimotope-Guided Molecular Dynamics Enables Precise Functional Epitope Mapping.
papers.authors: Sha, Zigan; Hu, Zheyao; Du, Wenjing; Marti, Jordi; Sundell, Gustav N; Guo, Shu-Juan; Zhao, Xiaodong; Tao, Sheng-Ce
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于分子动力学模拟和结构映射的抗体表位预测流程，虽聚焦表位定位而非经典蛋白结构计算问题，但结合物理模拟与结构映射，对蛋白-抗体相互作用的结构建模有借鉴意义。
papers.abstract: Mimotopes selected by phage display have been used for antibody epitope mapping for nearly four decades, but residue-level recovery of functional epitopes has remained unreliable. This is not a problem of algorithms but of assumptions: mimotopes recapitulate native epitope recognition through compensatory interaction networks that preserve binding energetics, without conserving sequence or surface geometry. Predictors trained on sequence similarity or static interface geometry therefore miss the residues that drive recognition. We present a physics-based workflow that refines antibody-bound mimotope conformations by microsecond-scale molecular dynamics and maps the resulting structures onto the cognate antigen using Folddisco. Across four antibody-antigen systems with crystallographically defined epitopes, the workflow reaches 60 to 100% precision in epitope localization and recovers 100% of mutagenesis- or structurally validated functional hotspots, compared with at most 25% for three widely used benchmarks (EpiSearch, ClusPro, SEPPA-mAb). For the clinically relevant ChiLob 7/4 system, it further identifies a minimal tetrapeptide (PWVP) sufficient for antibody recognition, validated by Western blot and immunoprecipitation. By grounding epitope prediction in experimentally selected binding information and energy-resolved conformational refinement, the workflow connects phage display to mechanistic structural insight.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过噬菌体展示筛选的模拟表位（mimotopes）已被用于抗体表位定位近四十年，但残基水平的功能表位恢复仍不可靠。这并非算法问题，而是假设问题：模拟表位通过补偿性相互作用网络重现天然表位识别，从而保持结合能量学，而不保守序列或表面几何结构。因此，基于序列相似性或静态界面几何训练的预测器会遗漏驱动识别的残基。我们提出了一种基于物理的工作流程，通过微秒级分子动力学（molecular dynamics）精炼抗体结合的模拟表位构象，并使用Folddisco将所得结构映射到同源抗原上。在四个具有晶体学定义表位的抗体-抗原系统中，该工作流程在表位定位中达到60%至100%的精确度，并恢复100%经诱变或结构验证的功能热点，而三种广泛使用的基准方法（EpiSearch、ClusPro、SEPPA-mAb）最多仅达25%。对于临床相关的ChiLob 7/4系统，该流程进一步识别出一个足以支持抗体识别的最小四肽（PWVP），并通过Western blot和免疫沉淀验证。通过将表位预测锚定于实验选择的结合信息和能量分辨的构象精炼，该工作流程将噬菌体展示与机制性结构洞察联系起来。

papers.title: UniPoseScore: A Unified Graphormer3D-Based Framework for Protein-Ligand Binding Pose Scoring and Refinement.
papers.authors: Zhang, Jinqiao; Ren, Xinyu; Peng, Zhenling; Wei, Hong
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于Graphormer3D的UniPoseScore框架，用于蛋白-配体结合构象打分与优化，属于蛋白质结构相关的AI计算建模，方法创新且应用明确。
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of protein-ligand binding poses is essential for structure-based drug discovery. In recent years, computational approaches, particularly molecular docking, have generated large numbers of candidate ligand poses. However, existing scoring functions remain limited in their ability to distinguish near-native poses from incorrect docking decoys. In this work, we propose UniPoseScore, a Graphormer3D-based framework for ligand pose scoring and refinement. The model simultaneously predicts pose RMSD and atomic displacement vectors to guide ligand pose refinement. Across four benchmark data sets, UniPoseScore showed consistently strong performance and better generalization, with a particularly clear advantage in RMSD correlation. Visualization of the learned embeddings further suggests that the model captures structural features correlated with pose accuracy. On the CASF-2016 benchmark, UniPoseScore achieves a refinement success rate of 74.3%, highlighting the effectiveness of UniPoseScore in improving ligand binding poses and its potential applications in drug discovery. The UniPoseScore is available at https://github.com/April-Zhangjq/UniPoseScore.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白质-配体结合构象的准确预测对于基于结构的药物发现至关重要。近年来，计算方法，特别是分子对接 (molecular docking)，已生成大量候选配体构象。然而，现有评分函数在区分近天然构象与错误对接诱饵方面的能力仍然有限。在本工作中，我们提出UniPoseScore，一种基于Graphormer3D的框架，用于配体构象评分和优化。该模型同时预测构象RMSD和原子位移向量，以指导配体构象优化。在四个基准数据集上，UniPoseScore表现出持续强劲的性能和更好的泛化能力，尤其在RMSD相关性方面具有明显优势。学习嵌入的可视化进一步表明，该模型捕获了与构象准确性相关的结构特征。在CASF-2016基准上，UniPoseScore实现了74.3%的优化成功率，突显了UniPoseScore在改善配体结合构象方面的有效性及其在药物发现中的潜在应用。UniPoseScore可在https://github.com/April-Zhangjq/UniPoseScore获取。

papers.title: SA-MPNN: A Sequence-Aware ThermoMPNN for Accurate Prediction of Mutational Effects on Protein Thermodynamic Stability.
papers.authors: Zhang, Xin Yue; Zheng, Xiang; Dong, Ze Yuan; Xiao, Jing; Zhang, Hao; Wu, Min Cong; Liu, Zhao Ming; Li, Guo Hui; Li, Jiao; Wang, Wei Bu; Liang, Yu; Li, Qi Ming; Su, Ji Guo
papers.journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出SA-MPNN，将蛋白语言模型ESM2的序列表示通过自注意力机制融合进ThermoMPNN结构模型，用于预测突变对蛋白热稳定性的影响，属于蛋白质结构相关的AI计算建模，并含湿实验验证。
papers.abstract: Predicting the impact of single-point mutations on protein thermodynamic stability is crucial for protein engineering of therapeutic and industrial applications. By effectively capturing the three-dimensional structural information of proteins and the spatial physical environment of each residue, the inverse folding models (IFMs) upon fine-tuning, such as ThermoMPNN, achieved state-of-the-art performance in predicting thermostability changes in proteins caused by mutations. However, IFMs are limited in their capacity to capture protein deep evolutionary information, whereas protein language models (pLMs) excel. Here, we present SA-MPNN, a lightweight, end-to-end hybrid framework that dynamically integrates the protein sequence representations from a protein language model (ESM2) into the ThermoMPNN architecture to improve protein stability prediction by combining evolutionary representations with geometric structural embeddings. By evaluating various feature fusion strategies, we selected a self-attention-based integration mechanism to effectively combine the two modalities. Trained on the large-scale Megascale data set, SA-MPNN achieved modest but consistent gains over ThermoMPNN on various benchmark data sets, with particularly noticeable improvements in several correlation analysis and screening-oriented evaluations. Finally, wet-lab validation was performed on the top-ranking variants of Acetivibrio thermocellusbeta-glucosidase (AtBgl1A) as a case study. The experimental results demonstrated that multiple designed mutants exhibited improved thermostability, and the optimal variant, GC20, achieved a melting temperature (Tm) of 76.98  degrees C, representing a 5.97  degrees C increase over the wild-type, thereby supporting the practical applicability of SA-MPNN in protein engineering.
papers.abstract_zh: 预测单点突变对蛋白质热稳定性的影响对于治疗和工业应用的蛋白质工程至关重要。通过有效捕捉蛋白质的三维结构信息和每个残基的空间物理环境，经过微调的反向折叠模型（IFMs），如ThermoMPNN，在预测突变引起的蛋白质热稳定性变化方面达到了最先进的性能。然而，IFMs在捕捉蛋白质深层进化信息方面能力有限，而蛋白质语言模型（pLMs）则表现出色。在此，我们提出SA-MPNN，一种轻量级、端到端的混合框架，将蛋白质语言模型（ESM2）的蛋白质序列表示动态整合到ThermoMPNN架构中，通过结合进化表示与几何结构嵌入来改善蛋白质稳定性预测。通过评估多种特征融合策略，我们选择了基于自注意力的整合机制，以有效结合这两种模态。在大规模Megascale数据集上训练后，SA-MPNN在各种基准数据集上相对于ThermoMPNN取得了适度但一致的提升，在若干相关性分析和筛选导向评估中尤为显著。最后，以Acetivibrio thermocellusβ-葡萄糖苷酶（AtBgl1A）的排名靠前变体作为案例研究进行了湿实验验证。实验结果表明，多个设计的突变体表现出改善的热稳定性，最优变体GC20的熔解温度（Tm）达到76.98摄氏度，比野生型提高了5.97摄氏度，从而支持了SA-MPNN在蛋白质工程中的实际应用性。

papers.title: A structural antibody benchmark for leakage-aware deep-learning evaluation
papers.authors: Cohen T; Bhattacharya H; Ozery-Flato M; Schneidman D
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文构建了防泄漏的抗体结构基准数据集SABLE，用于深度学习抗体结构预测与相互作用建模的标准化评估，直接服务于蛋白质结构计算研究。
papers.abstract: Deep-learning methods for antibody structure prediction, antibody-antigen interaction modelling and design are advancing rapidly. However, comparisons across studies remain difficult because training and test sets are often constructed independently, and a temporal cutoff alone does not prevent train-test leakage. We present SABLE (Structural Antibody Benchmark for deep-Learning Evaluation), a versioned structural antibody resource that couples a fixed training collection with a leakage-controlled held-out test set for reproducible machine-learning development and evaluation. SABLE combines 16,511 experimental training entries with 327 manually reviewed test entries and 3,274 high-confidence, patent-derived AlphaFold3 models spanning 476 antigens. Candidate test structures were selected after the AlphaFold3 temporal cutoff and filtered against the training set using antibody and antigen sequence similarity filters. Each test entry records its nearest training set neighbour, allowing users to quantify remaining relatedness and stratify performance by similarity. Versioned releases provide metadata, processed structures, CDR annotations, redundancy labels and model-confidence fields. A Python/PyTorch API and standardised benchmark metrics provide reproducible database access and evaluation code without requiring additional antibody-structure processing.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于深度学习的抗体结构预测、抗体-抗原相互作用建模与设计方法正在快速发展。然而，由于训练集和测试集通常独立构建，且仅凭时间截断无法防止训练-测试泄漏，跨研究比较仍具挑战性。我们提出SABLE（Structural Antibody Benchmark for deep-Learning Evaluation），一个版本化的结构抗体资源，将固定训练集与泄漏控制的留出测试集相结合，用于可复现的机器学习开发和评估。SABLE整合了16,511个实验训练条目、327个经人工审核的测试条目，以及3,274个高置信度、源自专利的AlphaFold3模型，覆盖476种抗原。候选测试结构在AlphaFold3时间截断之后选定，并通过抗体和抗原序列相似性过滤器与训练集进行筛选。每个测试条目记录其最近训练集邻居，使用户能够量化剩余相关性并按相似性分层评估性能。版本化发布提供元数据、处理后的结构、CDR注释、冗余标签和模型置信度字段。Python/PyTorch API和标准化基准指标提供可复现的数据库访问和评估代码，无需额外处理抗体结构。

papers.title: Agentic-AI-ready genome-wide poxvirus–host interaction screen refined by a protein language model
papers.authors: Jacob Marcel Anter; Jason Mercer; Artur Yakimovich
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用蛋白语言模型整合蛋白互作信息优化痘病毒-宿主全基因组筛选，虽涉及蛋白语言模型但核心是功能筛选而非蛋白质结构计算建模，算法可部分借鉴。
papers.abstract: Recent mpox outbreaks highlight the necessity to understand the interactions between poxviruses and the human host. These can be discovered systematically through screening for host genes involved in infection at the single-cell level using RNA interference. However, off-target effects and assay noise obscure true gene-phenotype relationships, hampering the discovery of therapeutically relevant targets. Here, we show that integrating protein-protein interaction information derived from a protein language model boosts the discovery of vaccinia virus-host interactions. We propose ICARus – a positive-unlabelled read-out refinement framework to achieve this. Our approach enhances the identification of human genes with potential antiviral function. We provide the raw and refined read-outs of a genome-wide screen for vaccinia virus host factors as an agentic-AI-enabled community resource. Our findings provide a generalisable strategy for robust hit prioritisation in functional screens, accelerating discovery across complex biological systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期猴痘疫情暴发凸显了理解痘病毒与人类宿主之间相互作用的必要性。这些相互作用可通过在单细胞水平上利用RNA干扰筛选参与感染的宿主基因来系统性地发现。然而，脱靶效应和检测噪声掩盖了真实的基因-表型关系，阻碍了治疗相关靶点的发现。在此，我们表明整合源自蛋白质语言模型的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用信息可增强牛痘病毒-宿主相互作用的发现。我们提出ICARus——一种正-未标记读出精炼框架以实现这一目标。我们的方法增强了对具有潜在抗病毒功能的人类基因的识别。我们提供了全基因组牛痘病毒宿主因子筛选的原始及精炼读出数据，作为代理式AI赋能的社区资源。我们的发现为功能筛选中稳健命中优先排序提供了一种通用策略，加速了复杂生物系统中的发现进程。

papers.title: PANDA: Protein All-atom Nested-tree Denoising Architecture for End-to-End Generation
papers.authors: Bai J; Jiang H
papers.one_liner_zh: PANDA提出了一种全原子嵌套树去噪生成架构，实现端到端的蛋白质序列与结构联合设计，并在功能基序支架设计上显著优于现有方法，直接契合蛋白质结构生成与设计课题。
papers.abstract: Deep generative models have expanded the scope of computational protein design, yet most approaches still separate backbone generation from sequence assignment or rely on latent and torsional representations that do not operate directly on all atoms in Cartesian space. We present PANDA, an end-to-end generative architecture that performs denoising in a unified all-atom representation, recovering sequence identity directly from atomic occupancy patterns. By coupling global and local coordinate tracks and introducing a sampling strategy that preserves side-chain geometry, PANDA achieves the highest self-consistency design success across protein lengths among evaluated all-atom methods. For functional design it conditions on pairwise distances between motif atoms rather than fixing their coordinates, allowing the functional atoms to be positioned jointly with the scaffold. On the Atomic Motif Enzyme benchmark, PANDA preserves motif geometry and delivers substantially higher scaffolding success than previous approaches, particularly for larger motifs. PANDA thus provides an efficient route to high-quality all-atom generative design with flexible atomic-level control.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度生成模型扩展了计算蛋白质设计的范围，但大多数方法仍将骨架生成与序列分配分离，或依赖潜在和扭转表示，这些表示不直接在笛卡尔空间中的所有原子上操作。我们提出PANDA，一种端到端的生成架构，在统一的全原子表示中进行去噪，直接从原子占据模式中恢复序列身份。通过耦合全局和局部坐标轨迹，并引入一种保持侧链几何形状的采样策略，PANDA在评估的全原子方法中，跨蛋白质长度实现了最高的自洽设计成功率。对于功能设计，它基于基序原子间的成对距离进行条件化，而非固定其坐标，从而允许功能原子与支架共同定位。在原子基序酶基准测试中，PANDA保持了基序几何形状，并在支架构建成功率上显著高于先前方法，尤其对于较大基序。因此，PANDA为高质量全原子生成设计提供了一条高效路径，并具备灵活的原子级控制能力。

papers.title: UFold-X: an enhanced Dual & Dynamic U-Mamba model for long-range RNA secondary structure prediction.
papers.authors: Fu, Laiyi; Li, Jiachun; Wang, Ruiqi; Sun, Hequan; Wu, Danyang
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出UFold-X，一种结合卷积与Mamba的深度学习模型用于长链RNA二级结构预测，虽对象为RNA而非蛋白质，但其长程依赖建模和结构预测方法可迁移至蛋白质结构计算，具有借鉴价值。
papers.abstract: RNA secondary structure is essential for understanding the functions of non-coding RNAs, ribosomal RNAs, and viral genomes. However, accurate prediction of long RNA structures remains challenging due to complex long-range interactions and the limited availability of long-RNA training data. We present UFold-X, a dual-branch deep learning framework that combines a convolutional encoder for local structure modeling with a Mamba-based Visual State Space Module for capturing long-range dependencies. A dynamic gating mechanism adaptively integrates the two branches according to sequence length. UFold-X was evaluated on multiple benchmark datasets containing RNAs up to 5000 nucleotides. To rigorously assess generalization, we introduced a cross-clan benchmark for long RNAs. Under this stringent setting, UFold-X achieved performance comparable to state-of-the-art classical approaches while achieving the best performance among deep learning-based methods. Additional cross-family and within-family evaluations further demonstrated robust transferability and competitive predictive performance. UFold-X also maintained excellent computational efficiency, requiring only 0.08 s per sequence on average. To assess biological consistency, we developed a SHAPE-based reactivity prediction variant (UFold-X-R) and an integrated metric, the Hybrid Reactivity-Pairing Score (HRPS). UFold-X-R showed strong agreement with experimental icSHAPE data and achieved the highest HRPS among all evaluated methods. A user-friendly web server is available at https://ufold-x.ai4bread.com.
papers.abstract_zh: RNA二级结构对于理解非编码RNA、核糖体RNA和病毒基因组的功能至关重要。然而，由于复杂的长程相互作用以及长RNA训练数据的有限性，准确预测长RNA结构仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了UFold-X，一种双分支深度学习框架，结合了用于局部结构建模的卷积编码器和基于Mamba的视觉状态空间模块，以捕捉长程依赖性。动态门控机制根据序列长度自适应地整合两个分支。UFold-X在包含长达5000个核苷酸的RNA的多个基准数据集上进行了评估。为了严格评估泛化能力，我们引入了针对长RNA的跨家族基准。在这种严格设置下，UFold-X达到了与最先进的经典方法相当的性能，同时在基于深度学习的方法中取得了最佳表现。额外的跨家族和家族内评估进一步证明了其稳健的可迁移性和竞争性的预测性能。UFold-X还保持了出色的计算效率，平均每条序列仅需0.08秒。为了评估生物学一致性，我们开发了基于SHAPE的反应性预测变体（UFold-X-R）以及一个综合指标，即混合反应性配对评分（HRPS）。UFold-X-R与实验icSHAPE数据表现出强烈的一致性，并在所有评估方法中取得了最高的HRPS。用户友好的网络服务器可在https://ufold-x.ai4bread.com访问。

papers.title: Evaluating transformer-based models for structural characterization of orphan proteins.
papers.authors: Seckin, Ercan; Colinet, Dominique; Danchin, Etienne G J; Sarti, Edoardo
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文系统评估了AlphaFold2、ESMFold等Transformer模型在孤儿蛋白结构预测上的泛化能力，聚焦蛋白质结构预测问题，方法为AI模型评估，虽无新算法但针对结构计算核心问题，具有重要参考价值。
papers.abstract: MOTIVATION: Transformer-based models (TBMs) are state-of-the-art deep learning architectures that predict protein structural features with high accuracy. Despite methodological differences, they all rely on large datasets structured in families of homologous sequences. However, 5%-30% of eukaryotic proteomes consist of orphan proteins, which are sequences without detectable similarity to known families. Although they may share structural traits with characterized proteins, their lack of homology makes them an ideal dataset for evaluating TBM generalization beyond familiar sequence space. RESULTS: We compared predictions from several widely used TBM architectures on an expert-curated set of orphan proteins from the Meloidogyne genus, comprising some of the most destructive plant-parasitic nematodes. Multiple sequence alignment-based approaches such as AlphaFold2 performed poorly on orphan proteins, as did single-sequence or embedding-based language models ESMFold, OmegaFold, and ProtT5. This limited performance cannot be fully attributed to intrinsic disorder, as confirmed by independent non-TBM disorder predictors. While accurate tertiary structure prediction remains out of reach, secondary structure is more reliably captured: predictors share about 70% of secondary structure elements, regardless of global fold similarity, and these elements are consistently identified by dedicated secondary structure tools. AVAILABILITY: All data and analysis scripts are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18788931.
papers.abstract_zh: 动机：基于Transformer的模型（TBMs）是当前最先进的深度学习架构，能够高精度预测蛋白质结构特征。尽管方法上存在差异，它们都依赖于按同源序列家族组织的大型数据集。然而，真核生物蛋白质组中有5%-30%由孤儿蛋白组成，这些序列与已知家族无可检测的相似性。尽管它们可能与已表征蛋白质共享结构特征，但缺乏同源性使它们成为评估TBM在熟悉序列空间之外泛化能力的理想数据集。结果：我们比较了几种广泛使用的TBM架构在专家精选的根结线虫属（Meloidogyne）孤儿蛋白集上的预测，该属包含一些最具破坏性的植物寄生线虫。基于多序列比对的方法如AlphaFold2在孤儿蛋白上表现不佳，单序列或基于嵌入的语言模型ESMFold、OmegaFold和ProtT5同样如此。这种有限性能不能完全归因于内在无序性，独立非TBM无序预测器证实了这一点。虽然准确的三级结构预测仍难以实现，但二级结构更可靠地被捕获：预测器共享约70%的二级结构元素，无论整体折叠相似性如何，这些元素都能被专门的二级结构工具一致识别。可用性：所有数据和分析脚本可在https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18788931获取。

papers.title: Insights into the structural dynamics and free energy landscapes of Danio rerio RAB1A and RAB1B: a comparative molecular dynamics simulation approach.
papers.authors: Mutafoglu, Bengu Sema; Danis, Ozkan; Mutlu, Ozal
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过同源建模和微秒级分子动力学模拟比较斑马鱼RAB1A/RAB1B的GDP/GTP结合态结构动态与自由能景观，属于蛋白质结构计算研究，但方法为常规MD应用，创新性有限。
papers.abstract: CONTEXT: RAB1A and RAB1B are highly conserved small GTPases that regulate endoplasmic reticulum-to-Golgi vesicle trafficking and are implicated in neurodegenerative diseases and cancer. Despite the increasing use of Danio rerio as a vertebrate model organism, the structural dynamics of zebrafish Rab1 isoforms remain uncharacterized. In this study, we performed the first comparative computational investigation of zebrafish RAB1A and RAB1B in their GDP- and GTP-bound conformational states. Sequence and structural analyses demonstrated a high degree of conservation between the two isoforms while revealing a characteristic Tyr-to-Phe substitution within the RAB1B Switch I region. Long-timescale molecular dynamics simulations showed that GDP-bound complexes exhibited greater structural stability, reduced residue fluctuations, and more compact conformations than the corresponding GTP-bound systems. These findings provide molecular insights into the functional dynamics of zebrafish Rab1 isoforms and support the use of Danio rerio as a translational model for Rab1-related biological processes and disease mechanisms. METHODS: The amino acid sequences of zebrafish RAB1A and RAB1B were analyzed using MUSCLE, PRATT, the Conserved Domain Database, and ExPASy ProtParam. Three-dimensional structures were generated by homology modeling with SWISS-MODEL using experimentally determined human Rab1 structures as templates and were validated using PROCHECK, ERRAT, Verify3D, ProSA-web, and QMEANDisCo. All-atom molecular dynamics simulations were performed in duplicate for 1 micros using GROMACS 2024.1 with the CHARMM36m force field and TIP3P explicit water model under periodic boundary conditions. Trajectory analyses included backbone root-mean-square deviation, root-mean-square fluctuation, radius of gyration, principal component analysis, dynamic cross-correlation matrix analysis, and free energy landscape calculations. Structural visualization and analyses were performed using PyMOL, Visual Molecular Dynamics (VMD), and the Bio3D package in R.
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：RAB1A和RAB1B是高度保守的小GTP酶，调控内质网至高尔基体的囊泡运输，并与神经退行性疾病和癌症相关。尽管斑马鱼（Danio rerio）作为脊椎动物模型生物的使用日益增多，但斑马鱼Rab1亚型的结构动力学仍未得到表征。在本研究中，我们首次对斑马鱼RAB1A和RAB1B在其GDP结合和GTP结合构象状态下进行了比较计算研究。序列和结构分析显示，两种亚型之间具有高度保守性，同时揭示了RAB1B Switch I区域内一个特征性的Tyr-to-Phe替换。长时间尺度分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟表明，GDP结合复合物比相应的GTP结合系统表现出更高的结构稳定性、更低的残基波动和更紧凑的构象。这些发现为斑马鱼Rab1亚型的功能动力学提供了分子层面的见解，并支持使用斑马鱼（Danio rerio）作为Rab1相关生物学过程和疾病机制的转化模型。

方法：使用MUSCLE、PRATT、保守结构域数据库（Conserved Domain Database）和ExPASy ProtParam分析斑马鱼RAB1A和RAB1B的氨基酸序列。使用SWISS-MODEL以实验确定的人Rab1结构为模板进行同源建模生成三维结构，并使用PROCHECK、ERRAT、Verify3D、ProSA-web和QMEANDisCo进行验证。使用GROMACS 2024.1，在CHARMM36m力场和TIP3P显式水模型下，于周期性边界条件下，对1微秒的全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟进行重复两次。轨迹分析包括骨架均方根偏差、均方根波动、回转半径、主成分分析、动态交叉相关矩阵分析和自由能景观计算。使用PyMOL、视觉分子动力学 (Visual Molecular Dynamics, VMD) 和R中的Bio3D包进行结构可视化和分析。

papers.title: Homozygous variants in ZSWIM6 cause severe syndromic short stature and developmental delay.
papers.authors: Amaratunga, Shenali Anne; Bezdicka, Martin; Tayeb, Tara Hussein; Soucek, Ondrej; Lebl, Jan
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过AlphaFold结构建模预测ZSWIM6突变对蛋白构象和表面电荷的影响，但核心是临床表型和转录功能研究，结构计算仅作为辅助验证，方法贡献较弱。
papers.abstract: Introduction We investigated two siblings from a consanguineous Kurdish family presenting with a specific facial phenotype (prominent forehead, supraorbital ridges, broad nose, depressed nasal bridge), severe short stature with biochemical features of growth hormone (GH) deficiency, microcephaly, and developmental delay. Whole-exome sequencing identified a homozygous variant (c.3119G>A, p.Arg1040His) in gene ZSWIM6, a putative transcription factor. Previously, only de novo heterozygous ZSWIM6 variants were known, causing either acromelic frontonasal dysostosis (AFND) or severe intellectual disability without craniofacial or skeletal anomalies. We aimed to characterize the functional impact of these three distinct variants to understand the resulting genotype-phenotype correlations. Methods The three ZSWIM6 variants were prepared in vitro by site-directed mutagenesis. Transcriptional activity was assessed in HEK293 cells using dual-luciferase reporter assays for HECW2 and ZIC2 promoters, previously hypothesized to possess functional links to ZSWIM6. In addition, in silico 3D structural modelling was performed using AlphaFold to predict the impact of each mutation on protein conformation and surface charge. Results The siblings shared partial overlap with prior ZSWIM6-associated phenotypes but also exhibited a distinct clinical presentation. Functional assays confirmed ZSWIM6 is a transcriptional regulator of the HECW2 and ZIC2 promoters. The three variants showed different effects on transcriptional regulation: the p.Arg1040His variant reduced ZIC2 activation (loss-of-function), p.Arg1163Trp enhanced ZIC2 activation (gain-of-function), and p.Arg913Ter specifically increased HECW2 activation (derepression). The 3D structural modelling predicted that p.Arg1040His and p.Arg1163Trp alter local surface charge without disrupting the overall fold, while p.Arg913Ter truncates ZSWIM6, potentially affecting the DNA binding interactions. Conclusion We report the first-ever homozygous ZSWIM6 variant, causing a novel phenotype of severe syndromic short stature with biochemical features consistent with GH deficiency and developmental delay. Our findings demonstrate that ZSWIM6 is a key transcriptional regulator and that allele-specific disturbances drive the marked clinical heterogeneity of ZSWIM6-related disorders.
papers.abstract_zh: 引言 我们研究了一个近亲库尔德家庭中的两名同胞，他们表现出特定的面部表型（前额突出、眶上嵴、宽鼻、鼻梁凹陷）、严重身材矮小并伴有生长激素（GH）缺乏的生化特征、小头畸形和发育迟缓。全外显子组测序鉴定出ZSWIM6基因（一种推定转录因子）中的纯合变异（c.3119G>A，p.Arg1040His）。此前，仅已知ZSWIM6的de novo杂合变异，导致肢端额鼻骨发育不良（AFND）或严重智力障碍而无颅面或骨骼异常。我们旨在表征这三种不同变异的功能影响，以理解由此产生的基因型-表型相关性。方法 通过定点诱变在体外制备三种ZSWIM6变异。使用双荧光素酶报告基因检测在HEK293细胞中评估HECW2和ZIC2启动子的转录活性，这些启动子先前被假设与ZSWIM6存在功能关联。此外，使用AlphaFold进行计算机三维结构建模，以预测每个突变对蛋白质构象和表面电荷的影响。结果 这两名同胞与先前ZSWIM6相关表型存在部分重叠，但也表现出独特的临床表现。功能检测证实ZSWIM6是HECW2和ZIC2启动子的转录调控因子。三种变异对转录调控表现出不同效应：p.Arg1040His变异降低ZIC2激活（功能丧失），p.Arg1163Trp增强ZIC2激活（功能获得），p.Arg913Ter特异性增加HECW2激活（去抑制）。三维结构建模预测p.Arg1040His和p.Arg1163Trp改变局部表面电荷而不破坏整体折叠，而p.Arg913Ter截短ZSWIM6，可能影响DNA结合相互作用。结论 我们报告了首例纯合ZSWIM6变异，导致一种新表型，即严重综合征性身材矮小，伴有符合GH缺乏的生化特征和发育迟缓。我们的发现表明，ZSWIM6是关键转录调控因子，等位基因特异性干扰驱动了ZSWIM6相关疾病的显著临床异质性。

papers.title: The insect effector CSPs activate an atypical plant TNL immune receptor.
papers.authors: Rao, Weiwei; Li, Tianzhu; Yang, Jing; Zhu, Liwen; Zhao, Wei; Ma, Tingting
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究昆虫效应子CSP激活植物TNL免疫受体RCSP的结构与催化机制，使用AlphaFold3/DMFold建模和分子对接等计算手段，但核心对象是植物免疫受体而非通用蛋白质结构计算问题，方法贡献偏向应用。
papers.abstract: CSP-mediated activation of RCSP involves noncanonical structural and catalytic mechanisms-including BB-loop deletion, alpha5alpha6-loop insertion, and atypical catalytic residues within the RCSP-TIR domain. Chemosensory proteins (CSPs), a conserved effector family in phloem-feeding insects such as aphids and the brown planthopper (Nilaparvata lugens), induce dwarfism in Nicotiana benthamiana through recognition by the Toll-interleukin-1 receptor (TIR) domain-containing nucleotide-binding leucine-rich repeat receptor (TNL) RCSP. However, CSP-mediated RCSP activation and enzymatic mechanism remain unknown. Here, we show that TIR domain of RCSP (RCSP-TIR) exhibits unique features, including a 9-amino acid deletion in the loop between beta-strand B and alpha-helix B (BB-loop), an 8-amino acid insertion in the loop between alpha5 and alpha6 (alpha5alpha6-loop), and substitution of the canonical catalytic glutamate with glutamine (E87Q). Structural analysis demonstrates that BB-loop deletion disrupts the canonical NAD(+)-binding pocket and prevents standard TIR tetramerization. Strikingly, AlphaFold3/DMFold modeling reveals that RCSP compensates via alpha5alpha6-loop insertion, forming a novel interface that stabilizes an atypical tetrameric architecture. Integrated approaches combining molecular docking and site-directed mutagenesis demonstrate that RCSP may utilize a noncanonical NAD(+)-binding pocket and depend on dual catalytic residues (D86/Q87) to mediate weak cell death. Evolutionary analysis classifies RCSP-TIR homologs into four distinct clades, highlighting Solanaceae-specific adaptations. These findings elucidate a novel plant-insect interaction mechanism in which RCSP's structural diversification enables CSPs recognition and immune signaling reprogramming.
papers.abstract_zh: CSP介导的RCSP激活涉及非经典的结构和催化机制——包括BB-loop缺失、alpha5alpha6-loop插入以及RCSP-TIR结构域内的非典型催化残基。化学感受蛋白（chemosensory proteins, CSPs）是蚜虫和褐飞虱（Nilaparvata lugens）等韧皮部取食昆虫中一个保守的效应子家族，通过被含Toll-白细胞介素-1受体（TIR）结构域的核苷酸结合富亮氨酸重复受体（TNL）RCSP识别，诱导本氏烟（Nicotiana benthamiana）矮化。然而，CSP介导的RCSP激活及其酶学机制仍不清楚。在此，我们表明RCSP的TIR结构域（RCSP-TIR）展现出独特特征，包括β链B和α螺旋B之间环（BB-loop）中9个氨基酸的缺失、α5和α6之间环（alpha5alpha6-loop）中8个氨基酸的插入，以及典型催化谷氨酸被谷氨酰胺取代（E87Q）。结构分析表明，BB-loop缺失破坏了经典的NAD(+)结合口袋，并阻止了标准TIR四聚化。引人注目的是，AlphaFold3/DMFold建模揭示RCSP通过alpha5alpha6-loop插入进行补偿，形成一个新的界面，稳定了一种非典型的四聚体架构。结合分子对接和定点诱变的综合方法表明，RCSP可能利用一个非经典的NAD(+)结合口袋，并依赖双催化残基（D86/Q87）介导微弱的细胞死亡。进化分析将RCSP-TIR同源物分为四个不同的分支，突出了茄科特异性适应。这些发现阐明了一种新型的植物-昆虫互作机制，其中RCSP的结构多样化使其能够识别CSPs并重编程免疫信号。

papers.title: Systematic benchmarking of AlphaFold and SWISS-MODEL kinase structures for structure-based drug discovery.
papers.authors: Bahena-Culhuac, Erick; Bello, Martiniano
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文系统基准测试AlphaFold2与SWISS-MODEL预测的激酶结构在基于结构的药物发现中的对接性能，并评估MD精化对对接的影响，属于蛋白质结构预测与对接的工程化应用，方法创新有限但问题和方法均相关。
papers.abstract: Accurate protein structure prediction is fundamental to structure-based drug discovery. However, the practical performance of deep learning-based models such as AlphaFold compared with traditional homology modeling approaches like SWISS-MODEL remains incompletely evaluated in realistic drug-design workflows. Here, we systematically benchmark AlphaFold2 and SWISS-MODEL using a curated dataset of 20 kinase structures with co-crystallized ligands. Predicted models were evaluated under three conditions: the raw predicted structures, structures subjected to energy minimization, and structures subjected to triplicate 100-ns unbiased molecular dynamics (MD) simulations for structural refinement. Model performance was assessed using structural accuracy metrics, multi-software docking (AutoDock Vina, AutoDock, and MOE), and post-docking MD trajectory stability analysis, together with MM/GBSA binding energy estimation. As expected, experimental structures consistently showed the best docking performance. Among predicted models, SWISS-MODEL produced slightly lower RMSD values and better interaction similarity than AlphaFold, although overall docking scores were statistically comparable. MD refinement prior to docking reduced structural suitability by increasing binding-pocket deviations and was associated with misoriented ligand poses in subsequent docking calculations, while energy minimization provided little to no improvement. Notably, the reduction in docking performance was not limited to computationally predicted structures but was also observed for experimental structures solved in complex with different ligands. Thus, rigid docking alone tended to generate a substantial number of false-positive poses. However, MD simulations applied after docking effectively identified unstable ligand poses and reduced false-positive predictions by detecting ligand dissociation. Overall true-positive rates were 30% for SWISS-MODEL and 35% for AlphaFold2. These findings highlight the importance of dynamic validation in structure-based drug discovery workflows.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确的蛋白质结构预测是基于结构的药物发现的基础。然而，与传统的同源建模方法（如SWISS-MODEL）相比，基于深度学习的模型（如AlphaFold）在实际药物设计工作流程中的性能尚未得到充分评估。在此，我们使用一个包含20个与共结晶配体结合的激酶结构的精选数据集，系统性地对AlphaFold2和SWISS-MODEL进行了基准测试。预测模型在三种条件下进行评估：原始预测结构、经过能量最小化的结构，以及经过三次100纳秒无偏分子动力学（MD）模拟进行结构细化的结构。模型性能通过结构准确性指标、多软件对接（AutoDock Vina、AutoDock和MOE）以及对接后MD轨迹稳定性分析，结合MM/GBSA结合能估算来评估。如预期，实验结构始终表现出最佳的对接性能。在预测模型中，SWISS-MODEL产生的RMSD值略低，且相互作用相似性优于AlphaFold，尽管总体对接分数在统计上相当。对接前的MD细化通过增加结合口袋偏差降低了结构适用性，并与后续对接计算中配体取向错误相关，而能量最小化几乎没有提供改进。值得注意的是，对接性能的下降不仅限于计算预测结构，也出现在与不同配体共结晶的实验结构中。因此，仅刚性对接往往会产生大量假阳性姿态。然而，对接后应用的MD模拟通过检测配体解离，有效识别了不稳定的配体姿态并减少了假阳性预测。总体真阳性率分别为SWISS-MODEL的30%和AlphaFold2的35%。这些发现强调了动态验证在基于结构的药物发现工作流程中的重要性。

papers.title: Structural basis of active state coupling of metabotropic glutamate receptor 8 to beta-arrestins.
papers.authors: Marx, Dagan C; Huynh, Kevin; Gonzalez-Hernandez, Alberto J; Strauss, Alexa; Rico, Carlos; Gallo, Pamela N; Sharghi Moshtaghin, Sheida; Arefin, Anisul; Broichhagen, Johannes; Eliezer, David; Khelashvili, George; Levitz, Joshua
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜、负染EM和分子动力学模拟解析mGluR8与β-arrestin复合物的活性态结构及偶联机制，属于蛋白质结构计算研究，但核心贡献偏向实验结构解析，MD模拟为辅助验证。
papers.abstract: Metabotropic glutamate receptors (mGluRs) are prototypical, dimeric family C G protein-coupled receptors (GPCR) that perform crucial modulatory roles throughout the nervous system. While mGluR activation and signaling through G proteins has been studied extensively, how these receptors interact with and are desensitized by beta-arrestins (beta-arrs) is not well understood. Here, we use an integrative biophysical and structural approach to probe the coupling of mGluR8 and beta-arrs. Using negative stain electron microscopy (EM), we identify tail- and core-bound orientations and stoichiometries of mGluR8/beta-arr complexes. Cryo-EM structures of mGluR8 alone or bound to either G proteins or beta-arr1 reveal mGluR8 active states with transducer-specific differences. The mGluR8/beta-arr structure shows a distinct complex orientation compared to other GPCR/beta-arr structures which supports a steric mechanism of mGluR desensitization involving interactions with both subunits and the lipid bilayer. Coupling of mGluR8 to beta-arr1 in an active-like conformation is verified by live-cell and single molecule FRET analysis. Finally, molecular dynamics simulations further define the positioning and dynamics of mGluR8-bound beta-arr1 and the importance of critical mGluR8 residues for stabilizing beta-arr1 complexes. Together, our data provide a framework for agonist-driven family C GPCR/beta-arr coupling.
papers.abstract_zh: 代谢型谷氨酸受体（mGluRs）是典型的二聚体C家族G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR），在整个神经系统中发挥关键的调节作用。尽管mGluR的激活及通过G蛋白的信号传导已被广泛研究，但这些受体如何与β-arrestins（beta-arrs）相互作用并被其脱敏的机制尚不明确。在此，我们采用整合的生物物理和结构方法，探讨mGluR8与β-arrestins的偶联。通过负染色电子显微镜（EM），我们识别了mGluR8/β-arr复合物的尾部结合和核心结合取向及化学计量比。单独mGluR8或与G蛋白或β-arr1结合的冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）结构揭示了mGluR8活性状态，并显示出转导子特异性差异。mGluR8/β-arr结构展示了与其他GPCR/β-arr结构不同的复合物取向，支持一种涉及两个亚基及脂质双层的mGluR脱敏空间位阻机制。mGluR8与β-arr1在活性样构象中的偶联通过活细胞和单分子FRET分析得到验证。最后，分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟进一步定义了mGluR8结合的β-arr1的定位和动态，以及关键mGluR8残基在稳定β-arr1复合物中的重要性。综合来看，我们的数据为激动剂驱动的C家族GPCR/β-arr偶联提供了框架。

papers.title: A Novel SXXLF Motif in the FXR N-Terminal Domain Mediates Coregulator and Interdomain Interactions.
papers.authors: Villalona, Priscilla; Pulahinge, Thilini; Yu, Tracy; Wenning, Jordan; Khan, Sabab Hasan; Frisbie, Crawford Joseph; Magafas, Jill; Barbe, Addison; Okafor, C Denise
papers.journal: Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟和实验方法，鉴定FXR核受体N端结构域中一个新型SXXLF基序介导共调节因子和结构域间相互作用，涉及蛋白质构象与变构耦合，但核心对象是核受体而非通用蛋白质结构计算，方法上仅使用MD模拟，缺乏AI/深度学习等前沿计算手段。
papers.abstract: The nuclear receptor (NR) superfamily is comprised of ligand-regulated transcription factors that contain an intrinsically disordered domain at the amino-terminal end, known as the N-terminal domain (NTD). While this poorly conserved domain is known to possess ligand-independent activation function (AF-1), few NTD functions are conserved between NRs. Identified roles in other receptors include androgen receptor (AR), estrogen receptor (ER), and mineralocorticoid receptor (MR). Here, we aim to define the function of the NTD of the farnesoid X receptor (FXR), a crucial regulator of lipid and bile acid metabolism. We show that the NTD engages in interdomain contact with other FXR domains. We also observe that the NTD interacts directly with coregulator proteins. Using mutagenesis, mammalian two-hybrid assays, mammalian one-hybrid assay, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, we identify and validate a novel SXXLF motif in the NTD which mediates interactions with both coregulators and the ligand binding domain. Mutation of the motif induces large changes in conformational and allosteric coupling in FXR. Our study identifies a new nuclear receptor-interacting motif that modulates the transcriptional activity of FXR.
papers.abstract_zh: 核受体（nuclear receptor, NR）超家族由配体调控的转录因子组成，其氨基末端含有一个内在无序结构域，称为N端结构域（N-terminal domain, NTD）。尽管已知这一保守性较差的结构域具有不依赖配体的激活功能（AF-1），但NTD的少数功能在NRs之间是保守的。在其他受体中已鉴定的作用包括雄激素受体（androgen receptor, AR）、雌激素受体（estrogen receptor, ER）和盐皮质激素受体（mineralocorticoid receptor, MR）。在此，我们旨在定义法尼醇X受体（farnesoid X receptor, FXR）NTD的功能，FXR是脂质和胆汁酸代谢的关键调节因子。我们表明，NTD与其他FXR结构域发生结构域间接触。我们还观察到，NTD直接与辅调节蛋白相互作用。通过诱变、哺乳动物双杂交实验、哺乳动物单杂交实验和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，我们鉴定并验证了NTD中一个新的SXXLF基序，该基序介导与辅调节因子和配体结合结构域的相互作用。该基序的突变诱导FXR构象和变构偶联发生重大变化。我们的研究识别出一个新的核受体相互作用基序，该基序调节FXR的转录活性。

papers.title: Multi-state Structure Prediction of G Protein-Coupled Receptor Proteins via Prompting on AlphaFold.
papers.authors: Sun, Zhigang; Zhang, Tao; Zhang, Kexin; Pang, Anqi; Yu, Jiale; Zeng, Liting; Yang, Sibei; Zhao, Suwen; Zheng, Jie
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出PromptGPCR，通过向AlphaFold模型注入结构生物学知识提示，实现GPCR活性/非活性多状态结构预测，并验证其在分子对接中的实用性，属于蛋白质结构预测与AI方法的直接结合。
papers.abstract: G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs), an essential family of transmembrane proteins, widely participate in signal transduction in organisms and have long been recognized as a major class of therapeutic targets. In structure-based drug design, high-resolution structures of GPCRs in both active and inactive states are essential for designing agonists and antagonists, respectively. However, obtaining experimental GPCR structures is costly, while homology modeling and artificial-intelligence-driven approaches including AlphaFold 2 and AlphaFold 3 often show reduced accuracy for active-state conformations. To address the above limitations, we propose PromptGPCR, an AlphaFold-based inference framework aiming to predict highly accurate structures of GPCRs in both active and inactive states. We provide AlphaFold-Multimer and AlphaFold 3 with biological sequences based on knowledge of structural biology as prompts to guide the models in the multi-state prediction task. Experimental results demonstrate that PromptGPCR can accurately predict active and inactive structures compared to baselines, suggesting its ability to provide structural hypotheses where state-resolved experimental structures are unavailable. Furthermore, PromptGPCR exhibits higher success rates in molecular docking than baselines, and this indicates that the predictions of PromptGPCR may have a certain degree of usability in downstream application scenarios involving specific GPCR conformational states.
papers.abstract_zh: G蛋白偶联受体（G protein-coupled receptors, GPCRs）是一类重要的跨膜蛋白家族，广泛参与生物体内的信号转导，并长期被视为主要的治疗靶点类别。在基于结构的药物设计中，GPCRs在活性和非活性状态下的高分辨率结构分别对于设计激动剂和拮抗剂至关重要。然而，获取实验性GPCR结构成本高昂，而同源建模及包括AlphaFold 2和AlphaFold 3在内的人工智能驱动方法在预测活性状态构象时往往准确性降低。为解决上述局限性，我们提出PromptGPCR，一种基于AlphaFold的推理框架，旨在预测GPCRs在活性和非活性状态下的高精度结构。我们向AlphaFold-Multimer和AlphaFold 3提供基于结构生物学知识的生物序列作为提示，以引导模型在多状态预测任务中的表现。实验结果表明，与基线方法相比，PromptGPCR能够准确预测活性和非活性结构，表明其在缺乏状态分辨实验结构的情况下能提供结构假设的能力。此外，PromptGPCR在分子对接中表现出比基线更高的成功率，这提示PromptGPCR的预测在涉及特定GPCR构象状态的下游应用场景中可能具有一定程度的实用性。

papers.title: AI-assisted design and virtual profiling of targeted degraders for pancreatic cancer therapy via PROTAC technology.
papers.authors: Du, Bing; Wang, Kunjie; Wu, Zhu; Qiu, Shaofan; Konstantinos, Filippiadis Dimitrios; Yu, Shuo
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用AI辅助和结构引导的计算流程设计靶向BRD4的PROTAC降解剂，涉及蛋白结构评估、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，属于蛋白质结构相关的计算建模，但对象为小分子-蛋白复合物且方法偏工程化应用，创新性一般。
papers.abstract: Pancreatic cancer remains one of the most lethal malignancies because of late diagnosis, aggressive progression, therapy resistance, and limited effective treatment options. Bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD4) is an important epigenetic regulator implicated in pancreatic cancer progression through its role in transcriptional control, cell proliferation, and survival signaling. Targeted protein degradation using proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) offers a potential strategy for eliminating disease-associated proteins through ubiquitin-proteasome-mediated degradation rather than transient pharmacological inhibition. In this study, an AI-assisted and structure-guided computational workflow was used to design and virtually prioritize BRD4-targeting PROTAC candidates recruiting DCAF15 as the E3 ligase component. The workflow integrated protein-structure evaluation, pharmacophore-based ligand screening, ADMET and Lipinski filtering, binary protein-ligand docking, molecular-interaction analysis, rational linker selection, BRD4-DCAF15 protein-protein docking, PROTAC-mediated ternary-complex docking, and molecular dynamics simulation. The results identified CLTTMPBA-linker-E7820 as a computationally prioritized PROTAC architecture with favorable predicted binding behavior, residue-level interaction patterns, and simulated ternary-complex stability. Importantly, this study is entirely computational and should be interpreted as an early-stage in silico prioritization framework rather than experimental evidence of BRD4 degradation or anticancer efficacy. The proposed BRD4-DCAF15 PROTAC candidates represent lead hypotheses that require biochemical, cellular, pharmacological, and in vivo validation, including confirmation of target engagement, ternary-complex formation, proteasome-dependent BRD4 degradation, downstream transcriptional modulation, pancreatic cancer cell inhibition, selectivity, pharmacokinetics, toxicity, and antitumor efficacy.
papers.abstract_zh: 胰腺癌仍是最致命的恶性肿瘤之一，原因在于诊断延迟、进展侵袭性强、治疗耐药以及有效治疗选择有限。含溴结构域蛋白4 (BRD4) 是一种重要的表观遗传调控因子，通过其在转录控制、细胞增殖和存活信号中的作用参与胰腺癌进展。利用蛋白水解靶向嵌合体 (PROTACs) 的靶向蛋白降解提供了一种潜在策略，通过泛素-蛋白酶体介导的降解而非瞬时药理学抑制来消除疾病相关蛋白。在本研究中，采用了一种AI辅助和结构引导的计算工作流程，用于设计并虚拟优先筛选以DCAF15为E3连接酶组分的BRD4靶向PROTAC候选分子。该工作流程整合了蛋白质结构评估、基于药效团的配体筛选、ADMET和Lipinski过滤、二元蛋白-配体对接、分子相互作用分析、合理连接子选择、BRD4-DCAF15蛋白-蛋白对接、PROTAC介导的三元复合物对接以及分子动力学模拟。结果鉴定出CLTTMPBA-linker-E7820作为计算优先的PROTAC架构，具有有利的预测结合行为、残基级相互作用模式以及模拟的三元复合物稳定性。重要的是，本研究完全基于计算，应被解读为早期阶段的计算机优先排序框架，而非BRD4降解或抗癌功效的实验证据。所提出的BRD4-DCAF15 PROTAC候选分子代表先导假设，需要生化、细胞、药理学和体内验证，包括确认靶点结合、三元复合物形成、蛋白酶体依赖性BRD4降解、下游转录调控、胰腺癌细胞抑制、选择性、药代动力学、毒性和抗肿瘤功效。

papers.title: Humanizing Antibodies and Nanobodies From Scratch With HuDiff.
papers.authors: Nan, Yang; Sun, Hongshuai; Zhang, Bo; Yang, Yue; He, Jianxin; Bai, Qifeng
papers.one_liner_zh: 提出HuDiff，一种基于自回归扩散模型的从头抗体/纳米抗体人源化方法，仅需CDR序列即可生成人源化抗体，属于蛋白质序列设计问题，方法创新且直接服务于蛋白质结构相关计算。
papers.abstract: Antibody (Ab) and nanobody (Nb) humanization is essential for reducing immunogenicity in therapeutic applications. HuDiff is an adaptive autoregressive diffusion approach that generates humanized antibodies and nanobodies from scratch using only complementarity-determining region sequences as input, eliminating the need for preexisting human templates.
