papers.one_liner_zh: 提出一种SE(3)等变图神经网络BackFlip-2，直接从蛋白质平衡结构预测方向性骨架柔性和动态相关性，以极低成本替代昂贵的大规模构象集成生成模型，精准捕捉各向异性运动。
papers.abstract: Predicting protein dynamics is a long-standing problem in computational structural biology. Often, protein function critically depends on local directed motions, such as hinge movements, catalytic loop rearrangements and domain reorientations, which can be characterized by directional flexibility and correlated structural motions of the protein backbone. While Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations provide an established but often prohibitively expensive approach, recent deep generative models aim to reduce this cost by directly predicting conformational ensembles, emulating MD. However, due to their large size and the need to generate several states until the derived dynamical properties converge, these models remain expensive. In this work, we propose BackFlip-2: a fast SE(3)-equivariant graph neural network trained to directly predict dynamical descriptors, such as directional backbone flexibility and pairwise dynamic correlations, from an equilibrium structure. In a series of experiments, we show that our model matches the accuracy of substantially larger ensemble generation models while being orders of magnitude faster, and demonstrate that the proposed equivariant architecture is especially well-suited for capturing anisotropic motions in proteins. BackFlip-2 model weights, training and inference code are available at https://github.com/graeter-group/backflip.
papers.abstract_zh: 预测蛋白质动力学是计算结构生物学中长期存在的问题。通常，蛋白质功能关键依赖于局部定向运动，如铰链运动、催化环重排和结构域重定向，这些运动可通过蛋白质主链的方向性灵活性和相关结构运动来表征。虽然分子动力学 (Molecular Dynamics, MD) 模拟提供了一种成熟但通常成本过高的方法，但最近的深度生成模型旨在通过直接预测构象系综来模拟MD，从而降低这一成本。然而，由于这些模型规模庞大，且需要生成多个状态直到导出的动力学性质收敛，它们仍然成本高昂。在本工作中，我们提出BackFlip-2：一种快速的SE(3)-等变图神经网络，训练用于从平衡结构直接预测动力学描述符，如方向性主链灵活性和成对动态相关性。在一系列实验中，我们展示了我们的模型在匹配规模大得多的系综生成模型精度的同时，速度快数个数量级，并证明了所提出的等变架构特别适合捕捉蛋白质中的各向异性运动。BackFlip-2模型权重、训练和推理代码可在https://github.com/graeter-group/backflip获取。

papers.title: Difficulty-Adaptive Tree-Structured Policy Optimization for Expanding Reasoning Coverage in RLVR
papers.authors: Youngjun Yu; Sanghwan Jang; Hwanjo Yu
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究大语言模型在可验证奖励强化学习中的推理覆盖扩展，属于LLM推理优化，不涉及蛋白质结构计算或相关AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been central to the recent success of Large Reasoning Models. However, while RLVR significantly improves single-sample accuracy, it often fails to expand the model's intrinsic reasoning coverage (pass@k) due to limited exploration during training. To address this, we optimize the structural design of train-time rollouts to enhance pass@k. Our analysis identifies three key design principles: (1) difficulty-adaptive rollout can play an important role in expanding pass@k, beyond serving as an efficiency heuristic; (2) tree-based rollout outperforms parallel sampling in discovering correct answers; and (3) sentence-entropy-guided forking overcomes the localization phenomenon of token-level branching to maximize semantic diversity. Building on these insights, we propose DATPO (Difficulty-Adaptive Sentence-entropy-guided Tree-structured Policy Optimization). DATPO integrates difficulty-adaptive tree search with a sibling-diversity advantage term, explicitly promoting semantic diversity to expand reasoning coverage during training. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DATPO outperforms baselines especially in pass@k, which directly translates to superior test-time scaling performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在大推理模型近期成功中发挥了核心作用。然而，尽管RLVR显著提升了单样本准确性，但由于训练期间探索有限，它往往无法扩展模型的内在推理覆盖范围（pass@k）。为解决这一问题，我们优化了训练时rollout的结构设计以增强pass@k。我们的分析确定了三个关键设计原则：（1）难度自适应rollout在扩展pass@k方面可发挥重要作用，而不仅仅是作为效率启发式方法；（2）基于树的rollout在发现正确答案方面优于并行采样；（3）句子熵引导的分叉克服了token级分支的局部化现象，以最大化语义多样性。基于这些见解，我们提出了DATPO（难度自适应句子熵引导的树结构策略优化）。DATPO将难度自适应树搜索与兄弟多样性优势项相结合，明确促进语义多样性以在训练期间扩展推理覆盖范围。在数学推理基准上的实验表明，DATPO在pass@k方面优于基线方法，这直接转化为更优的测试时扩展性能。

papers.title: bioq: a unified, agent-native command-line interface to a fleet of AI drug-discovery methods
papers.authors: Liu Z; Wang Y
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文介绍了一个统一命令行接口bioq，用于调用多种AI药物发现工具（包括结构预测、对接等），但主要贡献在工程集成而非方法创新，对蛋白质结构计算课题有工具链参考价值。
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence methods now span the drug-discovery pipeline—structure prediction, de novo design, docking, affinity estimation, and ADMET—yet each tool ships with its own, often incompatible, GPU software stack, so chaining several into a workflow requires reproducing conflicting software environments and access to datacenter-class hardware that most labs do not have. bioq is a dependency-light command-line client backed by bioq-services (a control-plane gateway plus a growing fleet of 38+ containerized drug-discovery tools spanning 7 discovery stages and 6 molecular modalities). The bioq CLI is self-describing and consistent across the fleet of computational tools, giving researchers and coding agents uniform access to any tool from a laptop, with no local model code, CUDA setup, or cloud configuration, running on serverless GPUs billed per job. The interface–gateway–services architecture makes bioq an execution substrate for automated, agent-driven discovery. bioq and bioq-services are open source under the MIT License and available at https://github.com/wolfsonliu/bioq and https://github.com/wolfsonliu/bioq-services . bioq runs on Python ≥ 3.10 with httpx as its only runtime dependency; services run as Linux containers and are self-hostable via the provided local deployment scripts (alongside scripts for Alibaba Cloud Function Compute). Install, quickstart, test data, and self-hosting instructions are in the repository. The project is actively maintained and will continue to receive updates to both features and services.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能方法现已覆盖药物发现流程——结构预测、从头设计、对接、亲和力估算及ADMET——然而每种工具都自带各自且往往不兼容的GPU软件栈，因此将多种工具串联成工作流需要复现相互冲突的软件环境，并需访问大多数实验室不具备的数据中心级硬件。bioq是一个依赖轻量的命令行客户端，由bioq-services（一个控制平面网关，外加一个不断增长的、涵盖7个发现阶段和6种分子模态的38+容器化药物发现工具集群）提供支持。bioq CLI具有自描述性，并在整个计算工具集群中保持一致，使研究人员和编码代理能从笔记本电脑上统一访问任何工具，无需本地模型代码、CUDA设置或云配置，在按作业计费的无服务器GPU上运行。接口-网关-服务架构使bioq成为自动化、代理驱动发现的执行基底。bioq和bioq-services在MIT许可证下开源，可在https://github.com/wolfsonliu/bioq 和 https://github.com/wolfsonliu/bioq-services 获取。bioq运行于Python ≥ 3.10，仅以httpx作为其运行时依赖；服务以Linux容器形式运行，并可通过提供的本地部署脚本（以及阿里云函数计算脚本）自行托管。安装、快速入门、测试数据和自托管说明均位于仓库中。该项目正在积极维护，并将持续接收功能和服务的更新。

papers.title: A Unified Structure-based Deep Learning Framework for High-Throughput Screening of Protein-Binding RNAs
papers.authors: Yihao Zhao; Jing Han; Jike Wang; Jianfeng Chu; Yu Kang; Tingjun Hou
papers.one_liner_zh: 提出统一结构深度学习框架PRIS，结合图注意力网络与距离预测，用于蛋白质-RNA结合位点预测与虚拟筛选，核心方法可迁移至蛋白质结构计算。
papers.abstract: Protein-RNA interactions regulate diverse biological processes and are increasingly exploited in therapeutic RNA discovery, but accurate inferences of nucleotide preferences and reliable structure prediction remain challenging. Here, we present PRIS, a unified structure-based deep-learning framework that combines two complementary components: PRISeq for nucleotide probability estimation at each RNA position and PRIScore for residue-nucleotide distance prediction to discriminate native-like from incorrect poses. Both share a feature extractor that integrates an Anti-Symmetric Graph Attention Network (A-GAT) with sparse k-Maximum Inner Product (k-MPI) attention to capture long-range interactions across large graphs. PRIScore improves the selection of native-like protein-RNA predictions generated by AlphaFold3, achieving a top-1 success rate of 81.91% on a docking benchmark, compared to 79.26% for AlphaFold3. The selected structures are then fed into PRISeq, which infers position-specific binding preferences and screens RNA libraries. On a PWM benchmark, PRISeq achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.75, outperforming FoldX, Rosetta-based scoring functions, and NA-MPNN. In virtual screening against MS2 protein, PRISeq screens 129,248 RNA hairpins within 11.95 seconds, achieving the highest EF 0.5% of 14.40, approximately double the best baseline. PRIS also effectively enriches active aptamers against NELF-E and GFP while preserving sequence diversity. By integrating structure selection with binding-preference inference, PRIS provides an efficient framework for large-scale RNA library screening and aptamer design.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白质-RNA相互作用调控多种生物过程，并越来越多地被用于治疗性RNA发现，但核苷酸偏好的准确推断和可靠的结构预测仍具挑战。在此，我们提出PRIS，一个统一的基于结构的深度学习框架，它结合了两个互补组件：用于估计每个RNA位置核苷酸概率的PRISeq，以及用于预测残基-核苷酸距离以区分近天然构象与错误构象的PRIScore。两者共享一个特征提取器，该提取器将反对称图注意力网络（A-GAT）与稀疏k-最大内积（k-MPI）注意力相结合，以捕捉大图上的长程相互作用。PRIScore改进了由AlphaFold3生成的近天然蛋白质-RNA预测的选择，在对接基准测试中实现了81.91%的top-1成功率，而AlphaFold3为79.26%。所选结构随后被输入PRISeq，后者推断位置特异性结合偏好并筛选RNA文库。在PWM基准测试中，PRISeq实现了0.75的平均绝对误差（MAE），优于FoldX、基于Rosetta的评分函数和NA-MPNN。在对MS2蛋白的虚拟筛选中，PRISeq在11.95秒内筛选了129,248个RNA发夹，实现了最高的EF 0.5%为14.40，约为最佳基线的两倍。PRIS还能有效富集针对NELF-E和GFP的活性适配体，同时保持序列多样性。通过将结构选择与结合偏好推断相结合，PRIS为大规模RNA文库筛选和适配体设计提供了一个高效框架。

papers.title: EukaUTR: a foundation model unifying functional modelling and design of eukaryotic 3 ′ UTRs
papers.authors: Lang M; Fang X; Chen M; Wang Z; Cheng Z; Zhu X; Tam KY; Zhang J; Li X
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文构建了真核生物3'UTR序列的基础模型，用于功能预测和序列设计，但研究对象是RNA非编码区，不涉及蛋白质结构计算，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: Eukaryotic mRNA 3 ′ UTRs encode regulatory information that shapes post-transcriptional control, RNA fate and gene expression. However, a 3 ′ UTR-specific foundation model that spans broad eukaryotic sequence diversity while supporting both functional prediction and sequence design is lacking. Here we present EukaUTR, a 3 ′ UTR-specific foundation model trained on a large-scale eukaryotic 3 ′ UTR sequence corpus spanning diverse evolutionary lineages. Across 13 prediction tasks spanning post-transcriptional regulation, RNA fate and expression output, EukaUTR models matched or exceeded the strongest external baselines on nearly all tasks, with relative improvements of up to 27.45%. EukaUTR also generated de novo 3 ′ UTRs with natural-like sequence and regulatory properties. EukaUTR-Guide further derived stability-associated signals from small sequence sets to guide editing towards enhanced predicted stability. Together, EukaUTR provides a sequence-to-function-to-design framework for transferable 3 ′ UTR modelling and design.
papers.abstract_zh: 真核mRNA 3′UTR编码调控信息，塑造转录后调控、RNA命运和基因表达。然而，目前缺乏一个跨越广泛真核序列多样性、同时支持功能预测和序列设计的3′UTR特异性基础模型。在此，我们提出EukaUTR，一个基于大规模真核3′UTR序列语料库训练的特异性基础模型，该语料库涵盖多样进化谱系。在涵盖转录后调控、RNA命运和表达输出的13项预测任务中，EukaUTR模型在几乎所有任务上匹配或超越了最强外部基线，相对改进最高达27.45%。EukaUTR还生成了具有自然样序列和调控特性的从头3′UTR。EukaUTR-Guide进一步从少量序列集中提取稳定性相关信号，引导编辑以增强预测稳定性。综上，EukaUTR提供了一个从序列到功能再到设计的框架，用于可迁移的3′UTR建模和设计。

papers.title: Agent-driven Model Development for RNA 3D Structure Prediction
papers.authors: Majewski M; Malo L; Montero-Blay A; Marengo M; Dos Santos RN; Gkeka P; Minoux H
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用LLM智能体半自动迭代开发RNA 3D结构预测模型QuickFold，虽对象为RNA而非蛋白质，但其智能体驱动的模型开发框架可迁移至蛋白质结构预测，对课题有启发。
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promise in driving scientific discovery, but their effectiveness in complex, real-world biological problems remains underexplored. We ask whether a general-purpose LLM agent can drive semi-autonomous development of a model for a genuinely hard biological problem, RNA 3D structure prediction. We designed a development loop where, under a fixed budget and with human supervision, the agent iteratively proposed, implemented, trained, and evaluated model changes. Over 297 iterations, the model evolved from a randomly-initialised baseline to QuickFold, an 8.9 M-parameter folding trunk that matches the strongest open-source baselines (RhoFold+, NuFold) on lDDT and TM-score within noise on a held-out test set at a fraction of their inference cost. We frame this less as a new predictor than as a case study in feedback-driven, agent-led model development.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在推动科学发现方面展现出潜力，但其在复杂、真实世界生物学问题中的有效性仍待探索。我们探究通用LLM智能体能否驱动一个真正困难的生物学问题——RNA三维结构预测——的模型半自主开发。我们设计了一个开发循环：在固定预算和人类监督下，智能体迭代地提出、实现、训练并评估模型修改。经过297次迭代，模型从随机初始化的基线演变为QuickFold——一个拥有8.9M参数的折叠主干（folding trunk），在保留测试集上，其lDDT和TM-score与最强开源基线（RhoFold+、NuFold）在噪声范围内相当，而推理成本仅为它们的一小部分。我们将其定位为反馈驱动、智能体主导的模型开发案例研究，而非单纯的新预测器。

papers.title: Protein Design Viz (PDV): lightweight protein structure visualization studio with validated quantitative analytics and antibody-specific toolkit
papers.authors: Konrad Krawczyk; Pawel Dudzic; Sandeep Kumar
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文开发了一个轻量级蛋白质结构可视化工具PDV，集成了SASA计算、抗体编号等定量分析功能，虽非方法创新，但为蛋白质结构计算提供了实用的工程化工具，与本课题的蛋白质结构分析需求相关。
papers.abstract: Motivation Molecular visualization is dominated by two families of software. Desktop programs such as PyMOL, VMD and UCSF ChimeraX are powerful but heavy to install and operate. Web viewers such as Jmol, 3Dmol.js, NGL, Mol* and iCn3D are light and installation-free, but typically stop at rendering, lacking deeper functionality needed for even basic protein sequence, structural analyses and design tasks. Tools building upon these often lack comprehensive sequence/structure manipulation, surface, interface and antibody-specific analytics functionality or require an external backend. There is a need for a tool that is as frictionless as a web viewer yet carries the analytical depth normally reserved for the desktop or the command line software. Results We present Protein Design Viz (PDV), a self-contained molecular visualization studio delivered as a single offline HTML file that runs entirely in the browser. Built as an extensive modification of 3Dmol.js, PDV combines a full visualization workflow: multi-object scenes, representations, coloring palette, linked sequence track, publication-quality outline rendering and portable sessions. Additionally we re-implemented four commonly used macromolecular analyses from scratch in client-side JavaScript: a Shrake–Rupley solvent-accessible surface area (SASA) engine, an antibody numbering and germline-assignment engine, a non-covalent interaction detector, and a developability-liability scanner. Each engine is validated against its established reference. PDV’s SASA reproduces FreeSASA at Pearson r ≈ 0.997–0.998 across 2,582 structures spanning proteins, nucleic acids and ligands; its numbering reproduces RIOT for over 99.88% of 1.3 million residue positions across 16,996 sequences and four schemes; its interaction detector reproduces PLIP at macro-F1 0.82, matching Arpeggio as closely as PLIP itself does. PDV brings validated, quantitative structural analysis into a no-install, simple to use tool. Availability and implementation PDV is a single HTML file, free for noncommercial use under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0, available from pdv.naturalantibody.com. It requires only a WebGL-capable browser and runs fully offline. Contact konrad@naturalantibody.com
papers.abstract_zh: 动机 分子可视化主要由两类软件主导。桌面程序如PyMOL、VMD和UCSF ChimeraX功能强大，但安装和操作繁琐。Web查看器如Jmol、3Dmol.js、NGL、Mol*和iCn3D轻便且无需安装，但通常止步于渲染，缺乏进行基本蛋白质序列、结构分析和设计任务所需的更深层功能。基于这些工具构建的软件往往缺乏全面的序列/结构操作、表面、界面和抗体特异性分析功能，或需要外部后端。因此，需要一种既像Web查看器一样无摩擦，又具备通常仅限桌面或命令行软件的分析深度的工具。结果 我们提出了Protein Design Viz (PDV)，一个自包含的分子可视化工作室，以单个离线HTML文件形式交付，完全在浏览器中运行。作为3Dmol.js的广泛修改版，PDV结合了完整的可视化工作流程：多对象场景、表示、着色调色板、链接序列轨道、出版级轮廓渲染和便携式会话。此外，我们从零开始在客户端JavaScript中重新实现了四种常用的生物大分子分析：一个Shrake–Rupley溶剂可及表面积 (SASA) 引擎、一个抗体编号和种系分配引擎、一个非共价相互作用检测器，以及一个可开发性风险扫描器。每个引擎均针对其既定参考进行了验证。PDV的SASA在涵盖蛋白质、核酸和配体的2,582个结构中，与FreeSASA的Pearson r ≈ 0.997–0.998；其编号在16,996个序列和四种方案中，对130万个残基位置的RIOT重现率超过99.88%；其相互作用检测器在宏F1分数0.82下重现PLIP，与Arpeggio的匹配程度与PLIP本身相当。PDV将经过验证的定量结构分析带入一个无需安装、易于使用的工具中。可用性和实现 PDV是一个单个HTML文件，根据PolyForm非商业许可证1.0.0免费用于非商业用途，可从pdv.naturalantibody.com获取。它仅需支持WebGL的浏览器，并完全离线运行。联系方式 konrad@naturalantibody.com

papers.title: PARAM-DOCK: An Integrated Framework for Parallel Multi-Protein–Multi-Ligand Docking and Scoring for Scalable Structure-Based Drug Discovery
papers.authors: Samarth Kittad; Mallikarjunachari Uppuladinne; Aneesh Kotipalli; Shruti Koulgi; Vinod Jani; Uddhavesh Sonavane
papers.one_liner_zh: 提出一个集成多蛋白-多配体并行对接与评分的开源框架PARAM-DOCK，结合经验打分函数和迭代局部搜索，在蛋白质-配体对接问题上表现竞争性，但方法创新性有限，属于工程化应用。
papers.abstract: Molecular docking is a central component of structure-based drug discovery, but practical docking studies often require several independent programs for receptor and ligand preparation, binding-site definition, docking, visualisation, interaction analysis, and downstream compound assessment. This fragmentation becomes particularly limiting when multiple protein targets and multiple ligands must be evaluated in the same study. Here, we present PARAM-DOCK, an open-source molecular docking engine and integrated web workflow implemented in Python with Numba-compiled numerical kernels. PARAM-DOCK supports parallel multi-protein-multi-ligand docking and automates major pre-processing and post-processing steps within a single platform. The docking engine combines a seven-term empirical scoring function with an iterated local search strategy in which Monte Carlo perturbations are followed by bounded quasi-Newton minimisation using analytical gradients. Final pose selection can additionally incorporate binding-basin population and pocket-complementarity descriptors when they are informative. The web platform integrates molecular preparation, docking setup, pose ranking, 2D and 3D protein-ligand interaction analysis, comparative score and interaction heatmaps, molecular visualisation, and ADMET prediction. PARAM-DOCK was benchmarked against Vina using matched receptor and ligand PDBQT files, identical search boxes, symmetry-corrected RMSD evaluation, and identical hardware. On the 285-complex CASF-2016 core set, PARAM-DOCK achieved a Pearson correlation of 0.631 for scoring power and a mean within-target Spearman correlation of 0.579, compared with 0.604 and 0.528 for Vina. In de novo redocking of 255 complexes, PARAM-DOCK placed the top-ranked pose within 2.0 Å in 68.6% of cases and recovered a near-native pose among nine outputs in 84.3%, compared with 74.1% and 93.7% for Vina. Conditional on generating a near-native pose, PARAM-DOCK ranked it first in 81.4% of complexes versus 79.1% for Vina. These results indicate competitive scoring and ranking performance, while conformational sampling remains the main area for further improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 分子对接是基于结构的药物发现的核心组成部分，但实际对接研究通常需要多个独立程序用于受体和配体准备、结合位点定义、对接、可视化、相互作用分析以及下游化合物评估。当同一研究中必须评估多个蛋白质靶点和多个配体时，这种碎片化变得尤为受限。在此，我们提出PARAM-DOCK，一个开源分子对接引擎和集成网络工作流程，采用Python实现并带有Numba编译数值内核。PARAM-DOCK支持并行多蛋白-多配体对接，并在单一平台内自动化主要预处理和后处理步骤。该对接引擎将七项经验评分函数与迭代局部搜索策略相结合，其中蒙特卡洛扰动后接使用解析梯度的有界拟牛顿最小化。最终构象选择在信息丰富时还可额外纳入结合盆地群体和口袋互补性描述符。该网络平台整合了分子准备、对接设置、构象排序、2D和3D蛋白-配体相互作用分析、比较评分和相互作用热图、分子可视化以及ADMET预测。PARAM-DOCK使用匹配的受体和配体PDBQT文件、相同的搜索框、对称校正RMSD评估以及相同硬件，与Vina进行了基准测试。在包含285个复合物的CASF-2016核心集上，PARAM-DOCK的评分能力皮尔逊相关系数为0.631，靶内平均斯皮尔曼相关系数为0.579，而Vina分别为0.604和0.528。在对255个复合物进行从头重新对接时，PARAM-DOCK在68.6%的案例中将排名第一的构象置于2.0 Å以内，并在84.3%的案例中从九个输出中恢复出近天然构象，而Vina分别为74.1%和93.7%。在生成近天然构象的条件下，PARAM-DOCK在81.4%的复合物中将其排在第一，而Vina为79.1%。这些结果表明其具有竞争力的评分和排序性能，而构象采样仍是进一步改进的主要领域。

papers.title: A Biophysical Hypothesis for Compartment-Specific Conformational States of the IQSEC2 Intrinsically Disordered Protein.
papers.authors: Shokhen, Michael; Albeck, Amnon; Levy, Nina S; Levy, Andrew P
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过加速分子动力学模拟研究IQSEC2这一内在无序蛋白在不同细胞区室中的构象状态，聚焦蛋白质构象折叠与力场/水模型优化，属于蛋白质结构相关的物理模拟研究，但对象为IDP且问题偏重生物物理假设，方法创新性一般。
papers.abstract: The postsynaptic density (PSD) of neuronal synapses is a crowded, viscous membraneless compartment consisting of densely packed protein mixtures formed and maintained through liquid-liquid phase separation. A key regulator of synaptic function within the PSD is IQSEC2, an intrinsically disordered protein (IDP), which functions as a guanine nucleotide exchange factor (GEF), promoting the activation of the small GTPase ARF6 by catalyzing the exchange of ARF6 bound GDP for GTP. Experiments have shown that IQSEC2 is inactive in a folded state in the dendritic cytosol but can transiently adopt a catalytically active extended conformation in the PSD upon activation by neurotransmitter mediated calcium influx. In this study, we performed accelerated molecular dynamics (aMD) simulations of the IQSEC2 folding process in aqueous solvent and applied the Gibbs ergodic hypothesis formulated in statistical ensembles for post-processing and analysis of the results. We compared the effects of two sets of parameters on folding: a force field and a water model. The OPC water model optimized for proteins with disordered structure in the extended state in bulk aqueous solvent predicted an incorrect distorted 3D folded structure of IQSEC2. We propose that, due to fundamental biophysical differences between the dendritic cytosol and the postsynaptic density, there are two distinct classes of IDPs functioning in these different environments. These differences should be considered when optimizing force fields and parameters of water models for studying protein folding.
papers.abstract_zh: 突触后致密区（PSD）是神经元突触中一个拥挤、粘稠的无膜区室，由通过液-液相分离形成和维持的密集蛋白混合物组成。PSD内突触功能的关键调节因子是IQSEC2，一种固有无序蛋白（IDP），其作为鸟嘌呤核苷酸交换因子（GEF），通过催化ARF6结合的GDP与GTP的交换，促进小GTP酶ARF6的激活。实验表明，IQSEC2在树突细胞质中以折叠状态处于非活性状态，但在神经递质介导的钙内流激活后，可在PSD中瞬时采用催化活性的延伸构象。在本研究中，我们进行了加速分子动力学（aMD）模拟，以研究IQSEC2在水溶液中的折叠过程，并应用统计系综中表述的吉布斯遍历假说对结果进行后处理和分析。我们比较了两组参数对折叠的影响：力场和水模型。针对具有无序结构的蛋白质在扩展状态下的OPC水模型，在体相水溶液中预测了IQSEC2错误的扭曲三维折叠结构。我们提出，由于树突细胞质和突触后致密区之间的基本生物物理差异，在这些不同环境中存在两类不同的IDP。在优化用于研究蛋白质折叠的力场和水模型参数时，应考虑这些差异。

papers.title: Computational prediction of flavonoid inhibitors targeting the infectious bronchitis virus spike protein through integrated virtual screening and molecular dynamics.
papers.authors: Gul, Irfan; Bashir, Sadaf; Aman, Muttahir; Hassan, Amreena; Rather, Muzamil Ahmad; Sofi, Ubaid; Chikan, Naveed Anjum; Shabir, Nadeem
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文使用虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟预测靶向IBV刺突蛋白的黄酮类抑制剂，属于蛋白质-小分子对接与MD模拟的常规应用，方法创新性一般，但问题和方法与蛋白质结构计算相关。
papers.abstract: Infectious bronchitis virus (IBV) remains a major threat to the poultry industry owing to its high transmissibility and the continuous emergence of antigenically diverse variants that compromise vaccine efficacy. The viral spike protein, which mediates host cell attachment and membrane fusion, represents an attractive target for antiviral intervention. In this study, a structure-based computational approach was employed to identify phytochemical inhibitors targeting the IBV spike protein. A curated library (PCLibVer2) comprising 2,400 phytochemicals derived from poultry-safe botanicals was subjected to hierarchical virtual screening using Glide against two receptor-binding domain-associated binding pockets. The three top-ranked lead phytochemicals were evaluated by three independent 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations, followed by trajectory-based Prime MM-GBSA binding free energy calculations and principal component analysis. All three phytochemicals exhibited favourable docking scores and stable protein-ligand interactions throughout the simulations. Molecular dynamics analyses demonstrated stable structural behaviour, persistent hydrogen-bond interactions, and reduced conformational sampling relative to the apo protein. MM-GBSA analysis predicted favourable binding free energies for all complexes, with Rutin exhibiting the strongest binding affinity at both binding pockets (- 50.07 +/- 13.14 and - 55.14 +/- 20.22 kcal/mol). Principal component analysis further showed that Rutin consistently produced the most compact conformational ensemble, indicating reduced protein flexibility. In silico ADMET analysis identified comparable pharmacokinetic profiles for the three lead phytochemicals. Collectively, these findings highlight the potential of flavonoid-based phytochemicals as natural inhibitors of IBV spike-mediated viral entry. This study provides a computational framework for the development of phytochemical-based interventions that may complement existing vaccination strategies and support efforts to reduce antibiotic use in poultry, pending experimental validation. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s40203-026-00727-z.
papers.abstract_zh: 传染性支气管炎病毒（IBV）因其高传播性以及持续出现的抗原多样性变异株削弱疫苗效力，仍对家禽业构成重大威胁。病毒刺突蛋白介导宿主细胞附着和膜融合，是抗病毒干预的有利靶点。本研究采用基于结构的计算方法，识别靶向IBV刺突蛋白的植物化学抑制剂。将包含2,400种源自家禽安全植物来源的植物化学物质的精选库（PCLibVer2），使用Glide针对两个与受体结合域相关的结合口袋进行分层虚拟筛选。排名前三的先导植物化学物质通过三次独立的100 ns分子动力学模拟进行评估，随后进行基于轨迹的Prime MM-GBSA结合自由能计算和主成分分析。所有三种植物化学物质在模拟过程中均表现出良好的对接分数和稳定的蛋白质-配体相互作用。分子动力学分析显示，相对于脱辅基蛋白，其结构行为稳定、氢键相互作用持续，且构象采样减少。MM-GBSA分析预测所有复合物均具有有利的结合自由能，其中芦丁（Rutin）在两个结合口袋处均表现出最强的结合亲和力（-50.07 +/- 13.14 和 -55.14 +/- 20.22 kcal/mol）。主成分分析进一步表明，芦丁始终产生最紧凑的构象集合，表明蛋白质灵活性降低。计算机模拟ADMET分析确定了三种先导植物化学物质具有可比的药代动力学特征。总体而言，这些发现凸显了基于黄酮类化合物的植物化学物质作为IBV刺突介导病毒进入的天然抑制剂的潜力。本研究为开发基于植物化学物质的干预措施提供了计算框架，这些措施可能补充现有疫苗接种策略，并支持减少家禽抗生素使用的努力，有待实验验证。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可在 https://doi.org/10.1007/s40203-026-00727-z 获取。

papers.title: From Enhanced Sampling to Human-Readable Representations of Protein Dynamics.
papers.authors: Mondal, Souvik; Sauer, Michael A; Heyden, Matthias
papers.journal: Journal of chemical theory and computation
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出自动化框架，将增强采样轨迹转化为可读的蛋白质动力学表示，通过相关运动分析提取可解释的域间距离作为集体变量，并应用于KRAS等蛋白，核心贡献在蛋白质构象采样与结构计算建模。
papers.abstract: Understanding protein conformational dynamics is essential for elucidating biological function but remains challenging due to the wide range of time scales and the complexity of collective motions. Enhanced sampling methods overcome time scale limitations of conventional molecular dynamics, yet their effectiveness depends on the choice of collective variables (CVs), which are often difficult to define and may lack physical interpretability. In particular, collective variables derived from machine learning or collective vibrational modes can efficiently capture slow dynamics but are not easily mapped onto intuitive structural descriptors. Here, we present a fully automated framework that transforms enhanced sampling trajectories into human-readable representations of protein dynamics. Our approach combines enhanced sampling along CVs derived from frequency-selective anharmonic mode analysis with a post hoc analysis of biased trajectories using weighted dynamic cross-correlation matrices. From these, we identify residue pairs and domains exhibiting correlated and anticorrelated motions, yielding simple domain-domain distances that serve as physically interpretable CVs. We apply this method to five proteins, including KRAS and HIV-1 protease, and show that it consistently identifies biologically relevant domains and motions without prior system-specific knowledge. Projection onto these distances produces free energy surfaces that reproduce known conformational states with low statistical uncertainty while maximizing independent dynamical information. This workflow enables systematic recasting of complex CVs into simple geometric descriptors without loss of essential dynamics. Its generality and automation make it broadly applicable for interpreting enhanced sampling simulations and generating interpretable conformational ensembles for integration with emerging machine learning approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解蛋白质构象动力学对于阐明生物功能至关重要，但由于时间尺度范围广泛和集体运动的复杂性，这仍然具有挑战性。增强采样方法克服了传统分子动力学的时间尺度限制，但其有效性取决于集体变量（CVs）的选择，而这些变量往往难以定义，且可能缺乏物理可解释性。特别是，源自机器学习或集体振动模式的集体变量能够高效捕捉慢动力学，但不易映射到直观的结构描述符上。在此，我们提出一个全自动框架，将增强采样轨迹转化为蛋白质动力学的人类可读表示。我们的方法结合了沿频率选择性非简谐模式分析导出的CVs进行增强采样，以及使用加权动态互相关矩阵对偏置轨迹的事后分析。由此，我们识别出表现出相关和反相关运动的残基对和结构域，从而得到简单的域间距离，作为物理可解释的CVs。我们将此方法应用于五种蛋白质，包括KRAS和HIV-1蛋白酶，并表明它无需系统特定先验知识即可一致地识别生物学相关结构域和运动。投影到这些距离上产生的自由能表面，以低统计不确定性重现已知构象状态，同时最大化独立动力学信息。该工作流程能够将复杂CVs系统性地重构为简单几何描述符，而不损失基本动力学。其通用性和自动化特性使其广泛适用于解释增强采样模拟，并生成可解释的构象系综，以与新兴机器学习方法集成。

papers.title: Computational design of siRNAs targeting SIRT7 in gynaecological cancers with cell-penetrating peptide-based delivery assessment.
papers.authors: Verma, Samridhi; Choudhary, Neha
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文计算设计靶向SIRT7的siRNA并进行分子对接与模拟，但核心对象是siRNA而非蛋白质结构，问题与方法虽涉及计算但与蛋白质结构预测/构象采样/生成等核心方向关联较弱。
papers.abstract: SIRT7 is a multifunctional epigenetic regulator and is significantly overexpressed in three major gynaecological cancers i.e., ovarian, cervical, and endometrial cancers, contributing to the proliferation and progression of tumors. This study focused on computationally designing and evaluating small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) as promising therapeutic candidates targeting SIRT7. In silico expression analysis has confirmed overexpression of SIRT7 in tumor tissues as compared to normal samples. siRNAs (S1-S6) were designed using siDirect and OligoWalk, which were screened for specificity using BLASTn. GC content and secondary structure prediction were done using OligoCalc and MaxExpect which eliminated four siRNA candidates (S2-S5) due to unfavourable internal loops and hairpin structures. Candidate siRNAs and mRNA thermodynamic stability were predicted using DuplexFold webserver. Molecular docking and simulation studies revealed interactions of siRNA candidates with human Argonaute 2 (Ago2) protein, maintaining strong post-simulation hydrogen bonds and salt bridges. Both S1 and S6 showed stable interactions with key domains (MID, PAZ and PIWI) of Ago2 protein, suggesting favourable structural compatibility with RNA induced silencing complex (RISC). S1 and S6 emerge as promising siRNA candidates for targeting SIRT7. Virtual screening with cationic cell penetrating peptides (CPPs) demonstrated stable CPP-siRNA complexes, suggesting suitability of RVG-9DR and H8R15 as potential delivery agents of S1 and S6. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive computational framework for designing and evaluating siRNAs targeting SIRT7, although further experimental studies are required to validate their therapeutic potential.
papers.abstract_zh: SIRT7是一种多功能表观遗传调控因子，在三种主要妇科癌症（即卵巢癌、宫颈癌和子宫内膜癌）中显著过表达，促进肿瘤的增殖和进展。本研究聚焦于通过计算设计并评估靶向SIRT7的小干扰RNA（siRNAs）作为有前景的治疗候选分子。计算机表达分析已证实，与正常样本相比，肿瘤组织中SIRT7过表达。使用siDirect和OligoWalk设计了siRNAs（S1-S6），并通过BLASTn筛选其特异性。利用OligoCalc和MaxExpect进行GC含量和二级结构预测，由于不利的内部环和发夹结构，排除了四个siRNA候选分子（S2-S5）。使用DuplexFold网络服务器预测候选siRNA与mRNA的热力学稳定性。分子对接和模拟研究揭示了siRNA候选分子与人Argonaute 2（Ago2）蛋白的相互作用，在模拟后维持了强氢键和盐桥。S1和S6均与Ago2蛋白的关键结构域（MID、PAZ和PIWI）表现出稳定相互作用，表明与RNA诱导沉默复合体（RISC）具有良好的结构兼容性。S1和S6成为靶向SIRT7的有前景的siRNA候选分子。与阳离子细胞穿透肽（CPPs）的虚拟筛选展示了稳定的CPP-siRNA复合物，表明RVG-9DR和H8R15适合作为S1和S6的潜在递送载体。总体而言，本研究为设计和评估靶向SIRT7的siRNAs提供了一个全面的计算框架，尽管仍需进一步的实验研究来验证其治疗潜力。

papers.title: Deep learning-based structural prediction (AlphaFold 3) of shrimp IMNV RdRp and identification of seaweed-derived metabolites for antiviral intervention in aquaculture.
papers.authors: Rahman, Mostafizur; Ali, Md Ahad; Samara, Tahosin Tasneem; Saha, Monish; Kundu, Pritom; Sarker, Hriddhi; Dutta, Ankita; Kumar, Neeraj
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文使用AlphaFold 3预测虾病毒RdRp结构，并结合分子对接和MD模拟筛选海藻代谢物抑制剂，属于蛋白质结构预测与对接的工程化应用，方法创新性一般，但问题和方法与课题相关。
papers.abstract: Infectious Myonecrosis Virus (IMNV) remains a major global threat to shrimp aquaculture, causing severe economic losses due to the lack of approved antiviral therapeutics. In this study, an advanced in silico approach was employed, utilizing a deep learning-based prediction of AlphaFold 3 protein structures and large-scale virtual screening of seaweed-derived metabolites to identify potential inhibitors targeting RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp). To identify potential seaweed-derived candidate compounds against IMNV, a total of 1,077 compounds were screened against the RdRp_M01 protein. The docking results suggest the top-ranked three bioactive compounds, such as GA002 (-13.0 kcal/mol), RC003 (-10.9 kcal/mol), and BE012 (-10.8 kcal/mol), based on their highest binding energy score and molecular interactions, for further analysis. The 200 ns molecular dynamics simulations showed that the selected complexes exhibited stable behavior throughout the simulation time, with relatively low standard deviation values. Post-simulation MMGBSA analysis revealed total binding free energies (DeltaG_total) of -24.726, -26.722, and -34.850 kcal/mol for RdRp_M01_GA002, RdRp_M01_RC003, and RdRp_M01_BE012, respectively, indicating favorable binding affinity and stable protein-ligand interactions. The drug-likeness and physicochemical profiles of the selected compounds were acceptable, supporting their further investigation. Therefore, further validation through in vitro and in vivo studies is necessary to confirm their applicability in shrimp systems and to explore the potential of seaweed metabolites as candidate compounds targeting the IMNV RdRp and alternatives to synthetic drugs.
papers.abstract_zh: 传染性肌坏死病毒（Infectious Myonecrosis Virus, IMNV）仍是全球对虾养殖业的主要威胁，由于缺乏获批的抗病毒治疗药物，导致严重的经济损失。本研究采用了一种先进的计算模拟方法，利用基于深度学习的AlphaFold 3蛋白质结构预测以及海藻源代谢物的大规模虚拟筛选，来识别靶向RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶（RNA-dependent RNA polymerase, RdRp）的潜在抑制剂。为筛选针对IMNV的潜在海藻源候选化合物，共对1,077种化合物进行了针对RdRp_M01蛋白的筛选。分子对接结果表明，基于最高结合能评分和分子相互作用，排名前三的生物活性化合物为GA002（-13.0 kcal/mol）、RC003（-10.9 kcal/mol）和BE012（-10.8 kcal/mol），并对其进行进一步分析。200 ns的分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟显示，所选复合物在整个模拟时间内表现出稳定行为，且标准偏差值相对较低。模拟后的MMGBSA分析显示，RdRp_M01_GA002、RdRp_M01_RC003和RdRp_M01_BE012的总结合自由能（DeltaG_total）分别为-24.726、-26.722和-34.850 kcal/mol，表明其具有有利的结合亲和力和稳定的蛋白质-配体相互作用。所选化合物的药物相似性和理化性质可接受，支持其进一步研究。因此，有必要通过体外和体内研究进一步验证其在虾类系统中的适用性，并探索海藻代谢物作为靶向IMNV RdRp的候选化合物及合成药物替代品的潜力。

papers.title: [Genetic analysis of a male with Multiple morphological abnormalities of sperm flagella combined with sperm head abnormalities due to compound heterozygous variants of DNAH1 gene and a literature review].
papers.authors: Liu, Yingwen; Yan, Lulu; Li, Haibo; Chen, Changshui; Wang, Yongjun
papers.journal: Zhonghua yi xue yi chuan xue za zhi = Zhonghua yixue yichuanxue zazhi = Chinese journal of medical genetics
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过全外显子测序和AlphaFold结构预测分析DNAH1基因变异导致的精子鞭毛及头部形态异常，属于临床遗传学诊断，虽涉及蛋白结构预测但核心是疾病表型与基因型关联，非蛋白质结构计算建模方法创新。
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To explore the clinical phenotype and genetic etiology of a male with Multiple morphological abnormalities of sperm flagella (MMAF) combined with sperm head abnormalities due to compound heterozygous variants of DNAH1 gene, with an aim to provide guidance for assisted reproductive technology in his family. METHODS: A man with MMAF combined with sperm head abnormalities who visited Women and Children's Hospital of Ningbo University in October 2024 was selected as study subject. Clinical data of the patient's family were retrospectively collected. Peripheral blood samples were collected from the patient and his spouse, and G-banding karyotyping and whole exome sequencing (WES) were carried out. Candidate variants were validated by Sanger sequencing. Conservation of the DNAH1 protein was queried on the UCSC website. The difference between wild type and variant DNAH1 proteins were analyzed using AlphaFold v3.0.1 and PyMOL v2.5.6. The pathogenicity of variant was rated based on the guidelines from American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG). Previous literature was searched using keywords "DNAH1 gene" and "multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella" on CNKI, Wanfang Data Knowledge Service Platform, and PubMed database to identify cases of MMAF attributed to biallelic DNAH1 gene variants. The retrieval period was set from the establishment of the databases to December 31, 2025. The genotypes and clinical phenotypes of patients with biallelic DNAH1 mutations were analyzed. This study was approved by the Medical Ethics Committee of the hospital (Ethics No.: EC2023-094). RESULTS: The 30-year-old patient and his 30-year-old wife had infertility for 2 years. Semen analysis revealed no motile sperm and a 99.0% abnormal morphology rate. Typical MMAF was observed with phase-contrast microscopy. Sperm morphology analysis revealed abnormalities of the head, neck, and tail with an approximate ratio of 9:5:1. The patient's karyotype was 46,XY, and his wife's karyotype was 45,X[4]/47,XXX[1]/46,XX[84]. WES and Sanger sequencing revealed that the patient harbored compound heterozygous variants of the DNAH1 gene, namely c.1435_1444+3del and c.12204_12206del (p.Asn4069del), but their origin remained unidentified. UCSC genome browser query results showed that the amino acid residue at position 4 069 of the DNAH1 protein is highly conserved across various species. Protein structure prediction reveals that, in the wild-type DNAH1 protein, the Asparagine at position 4 069 (Asn4069) can form hydrogen bonds with the Leucine on the main chain at position 4 086 (Leu4086) and the Serine on the side chain at position 4 087 (Ser4087). The c.12204_12206del variant, resulting in deletion of Asn4069, disrupts these hydrogen bonds and does not generate any compensatory interactions. Based on the ACMG guidelines, the c.1435_1444+3del variant was predicted to be likely pathogenic (PM2_Supporting+PVS1), and the c.12204_12206del(p.Asn4069del) variant was rated as likely pathogenic (PM2_Supporting+PM4+PM3+PP4). The couple had elected for in vitro fertilization using donor sperm. During this cycle, 12 oocytes were retrieved, 10 oocytes were successfully fertilized, 1 embryo and 6 blastocysts were obtained. Following the first transfer of a frozen-thawed blastocyst, implantation of an empty gestational sac occurred, which led to a miscarriage. After the second transfer of a high-quality blastocyst, the embryo split into twins following implantation, and the spouse had selected fetal reduction. The gestational age was 33(+3) weeks on June 1, 2026. Literature review identified three studies reporting biallelic mutations of the DNAH1 gene in association with MMAF combined with sperm head abnormalities. Together with the patient from this study, a total of 20 patients were included in the analysis. The rate of sperm flagellar abnormalities in these patients was above 80.0%, while the rate of sperm head abnormalities has ranged from 12.0% to 100.0%. In four patients, the genetic basis was unknown. In the remaining 16 patients, 35 mutations were detected, with c.8626-1G>A being the most common (22.9%, 8/35). CONCLUSION: This patient showed MMAF with frequent sperm head defects. Compound heterozygous variants of the DNAH1 gene probably underlay these abnormalities, which in turn has led to his primary infertility. This study revealed the phenotypic variability of MMAF and broadened the mutational spectrum of the DNAH1 gene.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：探讨1例因DNAH1基因复合杂合变异导致精子鞭毛多发形态异常（MMAF）合并精子头部异常的男性患者的临床表型与遗传学病因，旨在为其家庭的辅助生殖技术提供指导。方法：选取2024年10月就诊于宁波大学附属妇女儿童医院的1例MMAF合并精子头部异常男性作为研究对象。回顾性收集患者家系的临床资料。采集患者及其配偶的外周血样，进行G显带核型分析和全外显子组测序（WES）。候选变异通过Sanger测序验证。在UCSC网站上查询DNAH1蛋白的保守性。使用AlphaFold v3.0.1和PyMOL v2.5.6分析野生型与变异型DNAH1蛋白的差异。根据美国医学遗传学与基因组学学会（ACMG）指南评估变异的致病性。以“DNAH1基因”和“精子鞭毛多发形态异常”为关键词，在中国知网、万方数据知识服务平台和PubMed数据库中检索既往文献，以识别由DNAH1基因双等位变异导致的MMAF病例。检索时间范围设定为数据库建立至2025年12月31日。分析DNAH1双等位突变患者的基因型和临床表型。本研究经医院医学伦理委员会批准（伦理号：EC2023-094）。结果：该30岁男性患者及其30岁配偶不孕2年。精液分析显示无活动精子，异常形态率为99.0%。相差显微镜下观察到典型MMAF。精子形态分析显示头部、颈部及尾部异常，比例约为9:5:1。患者核型为46,XY，其配偶核型为45,X[4]/47,XXX[1]/46,XX[84]。WES和Sanger测序显示，患者携带DNAH1基因复合杂合变异，即c.1435_1444+3del和c.12204_12206del（p.Asn4069del），但其来源未明确。UCSC基因组浏览器查询结果显示，DNAH1蛋白第4069位氨基酸残基在多种物种中高度保守。蛋白质结构预测显示，在野生型DNAH1蛋白中，第4069位的天冬酰胺（Asn4069）可与第4086位主链上的亮氨酸（Leu4086）及第4087位侧链上的丝氨酸（Ser4087）形成氢键。c.12204_12206del变异导致Asn4069缺失，破坏了这些氢键，且未产生任何补偿性相互作用。根据ACMG指南，c.1435_1444+3del变异被预测为可能致病（PM2_Supporting+PVS1），c.12204_12206del（p.Asn4069del）变异被评为可能致病（PM2_Supporting+PM4+PM3+PP4）。该夫妇选择使用供精进行体外受精。在该周期中，获取12个卵母细胞，成功受精10个，获得1个胚胎和6个囊胚。首次移植冷冻-解冻囊胚后，发生空孕囊着床，导致流产。第二次移植高质量囊胚后，胚胎着床后分裂为双胎，配偶选择进行减胎。截至2026年6月1日，孕龄为33(+3)周。文献回顾发现三项研究报告了DNAH1基因双等位突变与MMAF合并精子头部异常的关联。连同本研究中的患者，共纳入20例患者进行分析。这些患者的精子鞭毛异常率高于80.0%，而精子头部异常率范围为12.0%至100.0%。在4例患者中，遗传基础未知。在其余16例患者中，检测到35个突变，其中c.8626-1G>A最为常见（22.9%，8/35）。结论：该患者表现为MMAF并伴有频繁的头部缺陷。DNAH1基因的复合杂合变异可能是这些异常的基础，进而导致其原发性不育。本研究揭示了MMAF的表型变异性，并拓宽了DNAH1基因的突变谱。

papers.title: Benchmarking Universal Machine Learning Force Fields for Crystal Structure Prediction of High-Energy Molecular Systems
papers.authors: Musiha Mahfuza Mukta; Osman Goni Ridwan; Romain Perriot; Qiang Zhu
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文评估通用机器学习力场在含能分子晶体结构预测中的可靠性，虽对象为分子晶体而非蛋白质，但其力场基准测试和结构弛豫方法对蛋白质结构预测中的力场选择有借鉴意义。
papers.abstract: Recent developments of universal machine learning interatomic potentials (UMLIPs) offer a fast route for screening molecular crystals based on geometry relaxation and energy ranking, but their reliability across chemically diverse energetic materials remains elusive. In particular, it is unclear whether or not these UMLIPs are over-sensitive to break the desired molecular connectivity for relaxing the periodic crystals. Herein we tested the hypothesis that classical force-field pre-relaxation can provide a more suitable starting geometry for subsequent UMLIP relaxation on a large database of high energy molecular crystals. Three models (MACE, MACE-OFF and UMA) in conjunction with the General Amber Force Field (GAFF) were applied to test this hypothesis. Among them, direct MACE-OFF and UMA showed very high relaxation success and preserved the reference geometries most closely, but they still exhibit failures for some rare cases. Using GAFF pre-relaxation can systematically reduce the number of failed relaxations with lower computational costs. Our comparative failure and robustness analyses revealed distinct trade-offs among the evaluated models. Among them, MACE-OFF achieves a better compromise between potential energy surface smoothness, structural fidelity, and stress convergence, serving as a good choice to provide a reliable foundation for automated structural optimization.
papers.abstract_zh: 通用机器学习原子间势（UMLIPs）的最新发展为基于几何弛豫和能量排序的分子晶体筛选提供了一条快速途径，但其在化学多样性含能材料中的可靠性仍不明确。特别是，尚不清楚这些UMLIPs是否过于敏感，以致在弛豫周期性晶体时破坏所需的分子连接性。在此，我们检验了一个假设，即经典力场预弛豫可以为后续UMLIP弛豫提供更合适的起始几何结构，并在一个大型高能分子晶体数据库上进行了验证。我们结合通用琥珀力场（GAFF）测试了三种模型（MACE、MACE-OFF和UMA）以验证该假设。其中，直接使用MACE-OFF和UMA表现出非常高的弛豫成功率，并最紧密地保持了参考几何结构，但在某些罕见情况下仍出现失败。使用GAFF预弛豫可以系统性地减少失败弛豫的数量，并降低计算成本。我们的比较性失败与稳健性分析揭示了所评估模型之间的不同权衡。其中，MACE-OFF在势能面平滑性、结构保真度和应力收敛之间取得了更好的折衷，可作为自动化结构优化的可靠基础的良好选择。

papers.title: Heat Field Signatures: From Point Clouds to Smooth Geometry
papers.authors: Yuanqing Wang; Yapeng Tian; Baris Coskunuzer
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出热场签名（HFS）方法，将点云提升为多尺度光滑热场以提取几何特征，并在蛋白质折叠分类中显著提升性能，虽非直接针对蛋白质结构预测或构象采样，但其几何描述符可迁移至蛋白质结构计算任务。
papers.abstract: Bringing multiscale geometric analysis directly to irregular point clouds remains difficult: quantities such as local dimension, anisotropy, density variation, and geometric transitions are typically estimated through explicit neighborhood, manifold, or graph constructions, or left for neural networks to infer from coordinates. We introduce Heat Field Signatures (HFS), which lift a point cloud to a multiscale family of smooth ambient heat fields, providing a direct interface from discrete samples to geometric analysis. From this field, HFS computes closed-form global and local signatures directly from pairwise distances, capturing heat concentration, intrinsic dimension, anisotropy, and scale transitions. We further introduce the Heat Dimension Spectrum (HDS), a compact summary of multiscale geometric composition. HFS can be used as a closed-form descriptor, a lightweight learned representation, or a geometric feature channel for neural point-cloud models. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks spanning subcellular, neuronal, tree, and protein data, HFS outperforms strong point-cloud and multiparameter-persistence baselines while substantially reducing end-to-end cost. On SCOP protein-fold classification, HFS improves over the strongest deep baseline by nearly $24$ percentage points using coordinates alone, while standalone HFS representations are exactly rotation-invariant by construction. More broadly, HFS turns a classical heat field into a practical interface for multiscale geometric analysis in modern point-cloud learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 将多尺度几何分析直接应用于不规则点云仍然困难：诸如局部维度、各向异性、密度变化和几何转变等量通常通过显式的邻域、流形或图结构来估计，或留给神经网络从坐标中推断。我们引入了热场签名（Heat Field Signatures, HFS），它将点云提升为多尺度的光滑环境热场族，为离散样本到几何分析提供了直接接口。从该场出发，HFS直接从成对距离计算闭式全局和局部签名，捕捉热集中度、内在维度、各向异性和尺度转变。我们进一步引入了热维度谱（Heat Dimension Spectrum, HDS），作为多尺度几何组成的紧凑摘要。HFS可用作闭式描述符、轻量级学习表示，或神经点云模型的几何特征通道。在涵盖亚细胞、神经元、树木和蛋白质数据的合成及真实世界基准测试中，HFS优于强点云和多参数持久性基线，同时大幅降低端到端成本。在SCOP蛋白质折叠分类中，HFS仅使用坐标就将最强深度基线的性能提升了近24个百分点，而独立HFS表示在构造上严格旋转不变。更广泛地，HFS将经典热场转化为现代点云学习中多尺度几何分析的实用接口。

papers.title: De Novo Design and AlphaFold3 Evaluation of Protein Binders Targeting Specific Sites of MAP4K4
papers.authors: Aarnav Jain; Alexander V. Tobias
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用RFdiffusion、ProteinMPNN、AlphaFold2/3及BindCraft等AI工具从头设计靶向MAP4K4特定表位的小蛋白结合物，并通过MD模拟验证，核心贡献在蛋白质结构计算设计与评估，与本课题高度相关。
papers.abstract: MAP4K4 is a serine/threonine kinase member of the mitogen activated protein kinase family. It acts through the JNK, p38 MAPK, and ERK1/2 pathways and is implicated in cancer proliferation and invasion, TNF-α-driven insulin resistance, macrophage-mediated inflammation, and cardiomyocyte apoptosis in heart failure. No selective small-molecule inhibitor of MAP4K4 has reached clinical use, and knowledge of the specific epitopes on MAP4K4 is lacking for some existing antibodies, leaving a role for small protein binders directed at specific surface sites. We used a computational pipeline that combines RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, and AlphaFold2, as well as BindCraft, an integrated “one-shot” tool, for de novo design of small protein binders (∼50–130 residues) to specific MAP4K4 surface hotspots. We also created an automated hotspot determination algorithm that weighs geometry, chemistry, rigidity, and AlphaFold pLDDT. From thousands of candidate sequences, we evaluated 20 of the most promising binders with AlphaFold3 (AF3). The interface predicted template modeling (ipTM) scores ranged from 0.16 to 0.90, with nine candidates having ipTM ≥ 0.80, and five scoring ≥ 0.87. Two binders engage non-overlapping hotspots on opposite faces of MAP4K4, making them a candidate pair for a sandwich assay. BLASTp searches of all designed protein sequences returned only low-significance matches to half of them, indicating that they represent truly novel binding solutions and previously unexplored regions of protein sequence space rather than rediscovered natural motifs. We subjected five complexes spanning the observed AF3 confidence range to 100-ns explicit-solvent molecular dynamics simulation. Interchain contacts were retained throughout, with stability varying substantially between systems. Confidence in the binding specificity of the nine highest-confidence candidates was bolstered by juxtaposition with AF3 evaluations of their interaction with CDK2, a negative-control kinase. This comparison yielded a significant, consistent reduction in ipTM (p = 0.0039) for the control binding partner. ToxinPred2 and AlgPred 2.0 screening suggested that one candidate was a potential allergen and two were potential toxins. These results support that de novo design of small, site-specific protein probes for an underserved disease target is achievable using free, publicly available computational tools and minimal resources, pointing to a greater role for the public and amateur scientists to contribute to biotechnological advancement.
papers.abstract_zh: MAP4K4是丝裂原活化蛋白激酶家族中的一种丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶成员。它通过JNK、p38 MAPK和ERK1/2通路发挥作用，并与癌症增殖和侵袭、TNF-α驱动的胰岛素抵抗、巨噬细胞介导的炎症以及心力衰竭中的心肌细胞凋亡相关。目前尚无选择性MAP4K4小分子抑制剂进入临床应用，且现有部分抗体对MAP4K4特异性表位的认识不足，这为针对特定表面位点的小蛋白结合剂留下了作用空间。我们采用了一种结合RFdiffusion、ProteinMPNN和AlphaFold2的计算流程，以及集成式“一步法”工具BindCraft，用于从头设计针对MAP4K4特定表面热点的小蛋白结合剂（约50–130个残基）。我们还创建了一种自动热点确定算法，该算法综合考虑几何结构、化学性质、刚性和AlphaFold pLDDT。从数千个候选序列中，我们使用AlphaFold3 (AF3)评估了20个最有前景的结合剂。界面预测模板建模 (ipTM) 得分范围为0.16至0.90，其中9个候选者的ipTM ≥ 0.80，5个得分 ≥ 0.87。两个结合剂分别作用于MAP4K4相对面上的非重叠热点，使其成为夹心法检测的候选配对。对所有设计蛋白序列进行的BLASTp搜索仅对其中一半返回了低显著性匹配，表明它们代表了真正新颖的结合解决方案和先前未探索的蛋白质序列空间区域，而非重新发现的天然基序。我们将跨越观察到的AF3置信度范围的五个复合物进行了100纳秒的显式溶剂分子动力学模拟。链间接触在整个模拟过程中得以保持，但不同系统间的稳定性差异显著。通过与负对照激酶CDK2的AF3评估结果并列比较，增强了九个最高置信度候选者结合特异性的可信度。该比较显示，对照结合伴侣的ipTM显著且一致地降低（p = 0.0039）。ToxinPred2和AlgPred 2.0筛选表明，一个候选者为潜在过敏原，两个为潜在毒素。这些结果支持，使用免费、公开的计算工具和最少资源，为未得到充分治疗的疾病靶点从头设计小型、位点特异性蛋白探针是可行的，这预示着公众和业余科学家在生物技术进步中可发挥更大作用。

papers.title: AtlasFold: Protein structure prediction with metagenomic-scale language models
papers.authors: Seonghwan Seo; Hyeongwoo Kim; Seokhyun Moon; Woo Youn Kim; Team KAIST
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于宏基因组规模蛋白语言模型AtlasLM-3B的AtlasFold，实现无需MSA的高精度蛋白质单体及复合物结构预测，方法创新且直接命中蛋白质结构预测核心课题。
papers.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) trained on evolutionary sequences learn representations that encode protein structure, enabling direct structure prediction without multiple-sequence alignments (MSAs). Here we present the Atlas model family, an open and trainable system spanning protein language modeling, monomer folding, and protein-complex prediction. AtlasLM-3B is a 3B-scale language model trained with masked language modeling on approximately 1.56 billion sequences, including metagenomic data, and outperforms the similarly sized ESM2-3B in unsupervised contact prediction. Building on these representations, AtlasFold predicts all-atom protein structures and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among PLM-based folding models. Fine-tuning AtlasFold for protein-complex prediction produces AtlasFold-Multimer (AtlasFold-M), whose antibody–antigen prediction performance is comparable to that of AlphaFold3 and ESMFold2. This protein-specific folding architecture enables fast, memory-efficient inference with AtlasFold and AtlasFold-M. By releasing the training code and data, stage checkpoints, and model weights under the MIT License, we provide a foundation for advancing PLM-based protein structure prediction. 1
papers.abstract_zh: 在进化序列上训练的蛋白质语言模型（protein language models, PLMs）能够学习编码蛋白质结构的表征，从而无需多序列比对（multiple-sequence alignments, MSAs）即可直接进行结构预测。在此，我们提出Atlas模型家族，这是一个开放且可训练的系统，涵盖蛋白质语言建模、单体折叠和蛋白质复合物预测。AtlasLM-3B是一个3B规模的语言模型，通过掩码语言建模在约15.6亿条序列（包括宏基因组数据）上进行训练，并在无监督接触预测中优于同等规模的ESM2-3B。基于这些表征，AtlasFold可预测全原子蛋白质结构，并在基于PLM的折叠模型中达到最先进的精度。针对蛋白质复合物预测对AtlasFold进行微调，得到AtlasFold-Multimer（AtlasFold-M），其抗体-抗原预测性能与AlphaFold3和ESMFold2相当。这种蛋白质特异性的折叠架构使得AtlasFold和AtlasFold-M能够实现快速、内存高效的推理。通过以MIT许可证发布训练代码和数据、阶段检查点以及模型权重，我们为推进基于PLM的蛋白质结构预测提供了基础。

papers.title: Inverse FoldDir: Structure-conditioned Protein Sequence Design by Dirichlet Flow Matching
papers.authors: Alp TARTICI; Mihajlo Stojkovic; Anru Tian; Michael C Jewett; Russ B Altman; Bruce J Wittmann
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于Dirichlet流匹配的结构条件蛋白序列设计方法Inverse FoldDir，通过迭代去噪实现逆折叠，兼具结构恢复、可控性与实验验证，直接命中蛋白结构计算与序列设计核心课题。
papers.abstract: Protein engineering has important implications in the bioeconomy, enabling applications in materials, medicine, and energy. A key challenge is designing protein sequences that have a specific form and function. Protein inverse folding seeks to address this challenge by identifying amino acid sequences compatible with a desired protein backbone. This task is central to protein redesign and can provide a sequence design capability for de novo backbones produced by structure-generation methods. Ideally, inverse folding can provide diverse sequence alternatives, fixed residues or motifs, soft biochemical preferences at selected positions, and candidates that remain experimentally useful. We developed Inverse FoldDir, a controllable inverse-folding method that performs iterative denoising on the amino acid probability simplex. Given a backbone structure, the model updates all positions jointly through a learned Dirichlet flow, supporting full sequence generation, fixed-residue inpainting, and user-defined soft residue priors. On the held-out CATH 4.2 test set, Inverse FoldDir achieved a mean TM-score of 84.5 (on a 0-100 scale) and a mean C α RMSD of 1.76Å, compared with 83.3 and 1.86Å, respectively, for ESM-IF1, the strongest evaluated baseline on both metrics. Denoising trajectory analyses showed that positions commit at different rates and that some residues change identity late in generation, illustrating whole-sequence refinement rather than one-shot prediction or irreversible sequential decoding. We experimentally tested Inverse FoldDir in an anti-GFP nanobody redesign task, where two of 35 redesigned sequences retained reproducible sfGFP-binding signal across independent assay runs with approximately 43% sequence divergence from the native nanobody. Inverse FoldDir is a structure-conditioned protein redesign method that combines structural recovery, user control, experimental validation, and a natural route toward future property-guided sampling.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白质工程在生物经济中具有重要意义，可应用于材料、医学和能源领域。一个关键挑战是设计具有特定形态和功能的蛋白质序列。蛋白质逆折叠 (protein inverse folding) 旨在通过识别与目标蛋白质骨架兼容的氨基酸序列来应对这一挑战。该任务是蛋白质重设计的核心，并能为由结构生成方法产生的从头骨架提供序列设计能力。理想情况下，逆折叠可以提供多样化的序列替代方案、固定残基或基序、选定位置上的软生化偏好，以及保持实验可用性的候选序列。我们开发了Inverse FoldDir，一种可控的逆折叠方法，该方法在氨基酸概率单纯形上执行迭代去噪。给定一个骨架结构，该模型通过学习的狄利克雷流 (Dirichlet flow) 联合更新所有位置，支持完整序列生成、固定残基修复以及用户定义的软残基先验。在保留的CATH 4.2测试集上，Inverse FoldDir实现了平均TM-score为84.5（0-100标度）和平均Cα RMSD为1.76Å，而最强评估基线ESM-IF1在这两个指标上分别为83.3和1.86Å。去噪轨迹分析显示，不同位置的提交速率不同，且某些残基在生成后期改变身份，这体现了全序列精炼，而非一次性预测或不可逆的序列解码。我们在一个抗GFP纳米抗体重设计任务中对Inverse FoldDir进行了实验测试，其中35个重设计序列中有2个在独立实验批次中保留了可重复的sfGFP结合信号，且与天然纳米抗体的序列差异约为43%。Inverse FoldDir是一种结构条件化的蛋白质重设计方法，它结合了结构恢复、用户控制、实验验证以及通向未来属性引导采样的自然路径。

papers.title: OpenMRF: A Modular, Vendor-Neutral Open-Source Framework for Magnetic Resonance Fingerprinting Using Pulseq.
papers.authors: Griesler, Tom; Stebani, Jannik; Kaplan, Sydney; Angelov, Ivaylo; Albert, Petra; Wech, Tobias; Blaimer, Martin; Wang, Xiang; Chen, Qingping; Zaitsev, Maxim; Zhu, Zhibo; Liu, Qi; Martin, Peter; Nielsen, Jon-Fredrik; Hamilton, Jesse I; Nordbeck, Peter; Seiberlich, Nicole; Gram, Maximilian
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文介绍磁共振指纹成像（MRF）的开源框架，属于医学影像定量MRI方法，不涉及蛋白质结构计算、AI或物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: Widespread adoption and methodological advancement of magnetic resonance fingerprinting (MRF) are limited by the lack of unified, reproducible implementation frameworks and fragmented open-source tools. To address these barriers, we introduce OpenMRF-a comprehensive Pulseq-based solution-designed to enable standardized and transferable MRF research across vendors, sites, and field strengths. METHODS: OpenMRF integrates modular Pulseq-based sequence design, Bloch-equation-based dictionary generation directly from .seq files, and iterative low-rank subspace reconstruction. The framework was evaluated through digital phantom simulations, a multi-site ISMRM/NIST phantom study on Siemens MRI systems at 0.55, 1.5, and 3 T, as well as GE and United Imaging 3 T platforms, and representative in vivo acquisitions in the liver (0.55 T), myocardium (1.5 T), and brain (3 T). RESULTS: Simulations demonstrated high mapping accuracy in an ISMRM/NIST-like digital phantom, with low-rank reconstruction yielding deviations of 0.03% +/- 0.32% (T(1)) and 0.12% +/- 1.94% (T(2)). The multi-site phantom study yielded relaxation times consistent with reference values at all field strengths, with mean deviations of -0.1% +/- 2.9% (T(1)), -1.5% +/- 8.7% (T(2)), and -4.0% +/- 7.2% (T(1rho)). In vivo acquisitions produced high-quality parameter maps across different anatomical applications and field strengths. CONCLUSION: OpenMRF provides a robust, open-source, end-to-end Pulseq-based solution for MRF designed to enable reproducible sequence implementation, physics-accurate dictionary simulation, and advanced reconstruction across vendors and field strengths. By providing a unified platform for method development, comparison, and cross-vendor application, OpenMRF aims to accelerate reproducible and harmonized quantitative MRI research within the community.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：磁共振指纹（magnetic resonance fingerprinting, MRF）的广泛采用和方法学进展受到缺乏统一、可复现的实现框架以及碎片化开源工具的限制。为应对这些障碍，我们推出OpenMRF——一个基于Pulseq的综合解决方案，旨在实现跨厂商、站点和场强的标准化、可转移MRF研究。方法：OpenMRF整合了基于Pulseq的模块化序列设计、直接从.seq文件生成基于Bloch方程的字典，以及迭代低秩子空间重建。该框架通过数字幻影模拟、在西门子MRI系统（0.55、1.5和3 T）以及GE和联影3 T平台上进行的多站点ISMRM/NIST幻影研究，以及肝脏（0.55 T）、心肌（1.5 T）和脑（3 T）的代表性体内采集进行评估。结果：模拟在ISMRM/NIST样数字幻影中展示了高映射精度，低秩重建产生的偏差为0.03% ± 0.32%（T(1)）和0.12% ± 1.94%（T(2)）。多站点幻影研究在所有场强下产生的弛豫时间与参考值一致，平均偏差为-0.1% ± 2.9%（T(1)）、-1.5% ± 8.7%（T(2)）和-4.0% ± 7.2%（T(1rho)）。体内采集在不同解剖应用和场强下产生了高质量参数图。结论：OpenMRF为MRF提供了一个稳健、开源、端到端的基于Pulseq的解决方案，旨在实现可复现的序列实现、物理精确的字典模拟以及跨厂商和场强的先进重建。通过提供统一的方法开发、比较和跨厂商应用平台，OpenMRF旨在加速社区内可复现和协调的定量MRI研究。

papers.title: Large language models in bioinformatics: a comprehensive survey.
papers.authors: Meng, Zhigang; Yang, Zhikai; Zhu, Mingxun; Xu, Jianzhen
papers.one_liner_zh: 综述了大型语言模型在生物信息学中的应用，涵盖蛋白质结构与功能预测，但缺乏方法创新，属于宽泛综述。
papers.abstract: The emergence of foundation models with trillion-level parameters has redefined the landscape of artificial intelligence. Various fields are developing their own large-scale models, which can solve many problems within the field and improve work efficiency. Biological large-scale models are a cross-disciplinary research field that combines mathematics, computer science, and biology, aiming to simulate and understand the structure, function, and dynamic changes of biological systems through the establishment of complex computational models. This field covers multiple levels such as biological pathways, population dynamics, protein folding, etc., providing us with tools for deep exploration of the mysteries of life and applications in medicine, ecology, and other fields. This article reviews the background and research status of biological large-scale models, and discusses future directions. Large language models (LLMs) and other large-scale foundation models have rapidly advanced in recent years, enabling powerful representation learning and generation across text, sequences, and multimodal data. In bioinformatics and biomedicine, these models are increasingly used to analyze genomic sequences, infer protein properties and structures, support drug discovery, and integrate heterogeneous biomedical evidence. This survey reviews the basic principles of LLMs and summarizes representative applications in (i) gene and genome sequence analysis, (ii) protein structure and function prediction, and (iii) drug design, including virtual screening and personalized medicine. We also discuss emerging multi-model modeling approaches, as well as key challenges such as data quality and privacy, interpretability, generalization to new organisms and tasks, and responsible deployment in health-related settings. Finally, we outline future directions for developing reliable, scalable, and explainable bioinformatics foundation models.
papers.abstract_zh: 万亿级参数基础模型的出现重新定义了人工智能的格局。各个领域正在开发自己的大规模模型，这些模型能够解决领域内的许多问题并提高工作效率。生物大规模模型是一个结合数学、计算机科学和生物学的跨学科研究领域，旨在通过建立复杂的计算模型来模拟和理解生物系统的结构、功能及动态变化。该领域涵盖生物通路、种群动态、蛋白质折叠等多个层面，为我们提供了深入探索生命奥秘以及在医学、生态学等领域应用的工具。本文回顾了生物大规模模型的背景和研究现状，并讨论了未来方向。近年来，大型语言模型（LLMs）和其他大规模基础模型迅速发展，实现了跨文本、序列和多模态数据的强大表示学习和生成能力。在生物信息学和生物医学中，这些模型越来越多地被用于分析基因组序列、推断蛋白质性质和结构、支持药物发现以及整合异质性生物医学证据。本综述回顾了LLMs的基本原理，并总结了其在（i）基因和基因组序列分析、（ii）蛋白质结构和功能预测以及（iii）药物设计（包括虚拟筛选和个性化医疗）中的代表性应用。我们还讨论了新兴的多模型建模方法，以及关键挑战，如数据质量和隐私、可解释性、对新生物体和任务的泛化能力，以及在健康相关环境中的负责任部署。最后，我们概述了开发可靠、可扩展且可解释的生物信息学基础模型的未来方向。

papers.title: Comparative molecular dynamics of two cyclic peptide inhibitors bound to the Zika virus NS2B/NS3 protease.
papers.authors: Marinho, Camilla Vitoria Silva; de Oliveira, Maycon Vinicius Damasceno; Lima, Anderson H
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟比较两种环肽抑制剂与寨卡病毒NS2B/NS3蛋白酶的结合模式、构象变化和结合自由能，直接涉及蛋白质-配体相互作用的计算模拟，属于蛋白质结构计算课题。
papers.abstract: CONTEXT: The Zika virus NS2B/NS3 protease is an important antiviral target, and macrocyclic peptide inhibitors represent promising scaffolds because they combine multibasic recognition motifs with conformational restriction. Here, we investigated two structurally related cyclic peptide inhibitors, referred to as CP1 and CP2, which share a conserved macrocyclic framework but differ in the chemical nature of their linker substituents. Molecular dynamics simulations showed that both peptides display broad intramolecular distance distributions in aqueous solution, indicating that key crystallographic contacts are not intrinsically maintained in the unbound state. Upon binding to the protease, CP2 adopted a more defined conformational ensemble and preserved a short intramolecular contact compatible with its crystallographic arrangement, whereas CP1 lost its crystallographic d2 contact and sampled a broader bound-state distribution. CP2 also showed a more focused interaction network involving residues from the catalytic and substrate-recognition regions and more favorable binding free-energy estimates. METHODS: Molecular dynamics simulations were performed for each cyclic peptide in aqueous solution and bound to the Zika virus NS2B/NS3 protease using Amber 20. The protein was described with the ff14SB force field, the cyclic peptides with GAFF2, and the systems were solvated with the TIP3P water model. Three independent 500 ns simulations were performed for each system. Trajectories were analyzed using structural clustering, intramolecular distance distributions, residue-level interaction analysis, and MM/PBSA and MM/GBSA binding free-energy calculations.
papers.abstract_zh: 寨卡病毒NS2B/NS3蛋白酶是一个重要的抗病毒靶点，大环肽抑制剂因其将多碱性识别基序与构象限制相结合而成为有前景的支架。在此，我们研究了两种结构相关的环肽抑制剂，分别称为CP1和CP2，它们共享一个保守的大环框架，但连接子取代基的化学性质不同。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟显示，两种肽在水溶液中均表现出广泛的分子内距离分布，表明关键的晶体学接触在未结合状态下并非固有地维持。与蛋白酶结合后，CP2采用了更明确的构象集合，并保持了与其晶体学排列兼容的短分子内接触，而CP1则失去了其晶体学d2接触，并采样了更广泛的结合态分布。CP2还显示出涉及催化区和底物识别区残基的更集中的相互作用网络，以及更有利的结合自由能估计。方法：使用Amber 20对每个环肽在水溶液中以及与寨卡病毒NS2B/NS3蛋白酶结合的状态下进行分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟。蛋白质用ff14SB力场描述，环肽用GAFF2力场描述，系统用TIP3P水模型溶剂化。每个系统进行了三次独立的500 ns模拟。轨迹通过结构聚类、分子内距离分布、残基级相互作用分析以及MM/PBSA和MM/GBSA结合自由能计算进行分析。

papers.title: Generalist Open-World Temporal Perception
papers.authors: Cristian Sminchisescu
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出通用开放世界时间感知架构，聚焦多模态视频生成与感知，未涉及蛋白质结构计算或相关建模方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: The next generation of artificial intelligence systems will likely be natively temporal and multimodal in both inputs and outputs: able to converse, perceive, predict, reason, and synthesize through a shared world representation. Realizing this requires a temporal perceptual substrate integrating sensory streams, language, and structured outputs within a multimodal world model. We seek a generalist open-world perceptual system that represents biological forms, natural physical structures, and artifacts, and their interactions, as a coherent, temporally persistent process. The model should infer geometry, articulation, semantics, interaction structure, and uncertainty from raw multimodal streams; maintain identity through occlusion and viewpoint change; generalize across species, forms, mechanisms, and materials; and abstain or expand its ontology when encountering the unknown. The objective is a structured world state supporting understanding, prediction, counterfactual reasoning, and controllable synthesis. Recent work suggests that some cross-modal and reasoning-like capabilities can emerge from large-scale generative video pretraining, reminiscent of language-model scaling. Yet these capabilities are often accessed through language probes or expressed through photorealistic video, leaving explicit semantic, geometric, or temporal structure largely unexposed. This paper articulates an alternative and complementary paradigm: perception and synthesis as distinct conditionings within a shared Generalist Open-World Temporal Perception Architecture (GOWTPA). Recognition, structured prediction, and simulation arise as different conditionings of the same generative substrate, while reasoning and embodiment-specific policies build upon the resulting world state. This positions generalist temporal perception as a potential foundation layer for broader multimodal intelligence and physical AI.
papers.abstract_zh: 下一代人工智能系统很可能在输入和输出上都是原生时序和多模态的：能够通过共享的世界表征进行对话、感知、预测、推理和合成。实现这一点需要一个时序感知基底，将感官流、语言和结构化输出整合到多模态世界模型中。我们寻求一个通用的开放世界感知系统，将生物形态、自然物理结构和人造物及其交互表征为一个连贯、时序持久的过程。该模型应从原始多模态流中推断几何、关节、语义、交互结构和不确定性；在遮挡和视角变化下保持身份；跨物种、形态、机制和材料进行泛化；并在遇到未知时放弃或扩展其本体。目标是支持理解、预测、反事实推理和可控合成的结构化世界状态。近期研究表明，一些跨模态和类推理能力可以从大规模生成式视频预训练中涌现，这让人联想到语言模型的缩放效应。然而，这些能力通常通过语言探针访问或通过逼真视频表达，而显式的语义、几何或时序结构大多未被揭示。本文阐述了一种替代且互补的范式：将感知和合成作为共享通用开放世界时序感知架构（GOWTPA）中的不同条件化。识别、结构化预测和模拟作为同一生成基底的不同条件化出现，而推理和具身特定策略则基于由此产生的世界状态构建。这将通用时序感知定位为更广泛多模态智能和物理AI的潜在基础层。

papers.title: Structural T-Cell Receptor Analysis in the Age of Machine Learning.
papers.authors: Quast, Nele P; Raybould, Matthew I J; Deane, Charlotte M
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文综述了机器学习时代T细胞受体结构预测、特异性推断及计算设计的方法与挑战，虽聚焦TCR蛋白结构，但以综述为主，方法创新性有限。
papers.abstract: The development of highly accurate deep learning models for protein structure prediction has transformed the landscape of T-cell receptor (TCR) structure data, which can now be accessed at repertoire scale. We provide a perspective on the growing field of structural TCR immunoinformatics, summarizing core principles of TCR structural biology and highlighting existing resources and tools. We outline computational methods for TCR structure prediction, and discuss outstanding challenges faced by current tools, as well as potential avenues to address these. We expand on the research enabled by the availability of predicted TCR structures, exploring the utility of TCR structure predictions for computationally inferring TCR specificity, as well as summarizing opportunities emerging from the adjacent field of antibody research. Finally, we provide a forward-looking perspective on the advances in deep learning research which have recently enabled computational design of TCRs and TCR-like binders.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于蛋白质结构预测的高精度深度学习模型的发展，已经改变了T细胞受体（TCR）结构数据的格局，这些数据现在可以在库规模上获取。我们对结构TCR免疫信息学这一日益发展的领域提供了展望，总结了TCR结构生物学的核心原理，并强调了现有的资源和工具。我们概述了用于TCR结构预测的计算方法，并讨论了当前工具面临的突出挑战，以及解决这些挑战的潜在途径。我们进一步阐述了由预测TCR结构可用性所推动的研究，探索了TCR结构预测在计算推断TCR特异性方面的实用性，并总结了来自相邻抗体研究领域的新机遇。最后，我们对深度学习研究的进展提供了前瞻性视角，这些进展最近已使TCR及TCR样结合物的计算设计成为可能。

papers.title: Self-assembly non-covalent binding mechanism of lycopene-protein-chondroitin sulfate ternary nanoparticles: Multidimensional characterization and molecular dynamics simulation.
papers.authors: Yan, Weiyu; Cui, Qian; Qiu, Tian; Liang, Xiaofu; Xu, Mengju; Qiu, Zijian; Guo, Meijia; Zhang, Yongmin; Zhou, Jiaping; Li, Mingyuan
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究番茄红素-蛋白质-硫酸软骨素三元纳米颗粒的自组装非共价结合机制，虽涉及分子动力学模拟，但核心是食品递送系统而非蛋白质结构计算建模，与本课题的蛋白质结构计算方向关联较弱。
papers.abstract: To overcome lycopene's (LYC's) poor water solubility, oxidative instability, and low bioaccessibility, chondroitin sulfate (CS) was used as a stabilizing layer to construct LYC-Protein-CS nanoparticles (LYC-Protein-CS NPs) using different proteins. Their structures and delivery performance were compared to clarify how protein structure influences the delivery of lipophilic bioactives. Zein's layered folding and hydrophobic-hydrophilic partitioning promoted assembly with CS, forming a compact core-shell network. Consequently, LYC-Zein-CS showed superior encapsulation, dispersion stability, antioxidant activity, and gastrointestinal release behavior. Compared with free LYC, this system increased apparent bioaccessibility by 12.95-fold in the gastric phase and 14.87-fold in the intestinal phase during simulated digestion. These findings reveal how protein structural differences regulate the performance of protein-polysaccharide nanoparticles and provide theoretical and technical insights into the precise design and practical application of delivery systems for LYC and other lipophilic bioactive compounds.
papers.abstract_zh: 为克服番茄红素（LYC）水溶性差、氧化不稳定及生物可及性低的问题，以硫酸软骨素（CS）作为稳定层，利用不同蛋白质构建了LYC-蛋白质-CS纳米颗粒（LYC-Protein-CS NPs）。通过比较其结构与递送性能，阐明蛋白质结构如何影响亲脂性生物活性物质的递送。玉米醇溶蛋白（Zein）的层状折叠及疏水-亲水分配特性促进了与CS的组装，形成了致密的核壳网络。因此，LYC-Zein-CS在包封率、分散稳定性、抗氧化活性及胃肠道释放行为方面表现更优。与游离LYC相比，该体系在模拟消化过程中，胃相表观生物可及性提高了12.95倍，肠相提高了14.87倍。这些发现揭示了蛋白质结构差异如何调控蛋白质-多糖纳米颗粒的性能，并为LYC及其他亲脂性生物活性化合物递送系统的精准设计与实际应用提供了理论和技术依据。

papers.title: Application of emerging technologies in the antiviral field.
papers.authors: Zhang, Xiaoyan; Zhang, Lele; Guo, Tengda; Du, Wenjuan; Wang, Shen; Li, Yongtao
papers.one_liner_zh: 综述新兴技术在抗病毒领域的应用，涵盖AI驱动的分子设计与AlphaFold结构预测，但以宽泛综述为主，非聚焦蛋白质结构计算的方法创新。
papers.abstract: Viral diseases pose a serious threat to global public health, agriculture, and biosecurity. Conventional antiviral strategies are often limited by an incomplete understanding of disease mechanisms, poor targeting precision, and slow response times. Emerging technologies are now reshaping the landscape of antiviral research. This review examines the roles of four key frontiers, including organoid models, gene editing, AI-driven molecular design, and synthetic biology. Organoids provide physiologically relevant platforms that model virus-host interactions and disease progression. Viral infections remain a major challenge to human and animal health, agriculture, and biosecurity. Progress in antiviral research is constrained by the complexity of viral pathogenesis, the diversity and rapid evolution of viruses, and the limited translational relevance of some traditional model systems. Recent advances in organoid technology, gene editing, artificial intelligence, and synthetic biology are expanding the toolkit available for antiviral research and development. In this review, we discuss how these four technological frontiers contribute to disease modeling, target discovery, molecular design, and translational innovation. Organoids, in particular, provide physiologically relevant systems for investigating viral infection, tissue tropism, host responses, and pathogenesis. Gene editing tools, such as CRISPR, enable precise manipulation of host and viral genomes, facilitating the development of resistant organisms and next-generation vaccine platforms. AI technologies, including AlphaFold for structure prediction and platforms for de novo protein design, address long-standing bottlenecks in structural biology and offer powerful means to engineer antiviral proteins, antibodies, and vaccine antigens. Synthetic biology, guided by the Design-Build-Test-Learn cycle, integrates computational design, genetic assembly, and functional validation into a cohesive pipeline. Together, these technologies form a synergistic workflow that spans disease modeling, target discovery, molecular design, construction, testing, and iterative optimization. This integrated approach is shifting antiviral development from traditional empirical methods toward more precise, intelligent strategies. The review also highlights ongoing challenges in integration and scalability, stressing that high-quality biological datasets and stronger interdisciplinary collaboration are essential for realizing translational potential. By presenting a cohesive view of these converging methodologies, this review offers a framework to guide the intelligent evolution of antiviral strategies in both human and animal health.
papers.abstract_zh: 病毒性疾病对全球公共卫生、农业和生物安全构成严重威胁。传统抗病毒策略常因对疾病机制理解不全面、靶向精度不足及响应速度缓慢而受限。新兴技术正在重塑抗病毒研究的格局。本综述探讨了四个关键前沿领域的作用，包括类器官模型、基因编辑、人工智能驱动的分子设计及合成生物学。类器官提供了模拟病毒-宿主相互作用和疾病进展的生理相关平台。病毒感染仍是人类和动物健康、农业及生物安全面临的重大挑战。抗病毒研究的进展受限于病毒发病机制的复杂性、病毒的多样性和快速进化，以及某些传统模型系统转化相关性不足。类器官技术、基因编辑、人工智能和合成生物学的最新进展正在扩展抗病毒研究与开发的工具库。在本综述中，我们讨论了这四个技术前沿如何促进疾病建模、靶点发现、分子设计和转化创新。特别是，类器官为研究病毒感染、组织嗜性、宿主反应和发病机制提供了生理相关系统。基因编辑工具，如CRISPR，能够精确操作宿主和病毒基因组，促进抗性生物体和下一代疫苗平台的开发。人工智能技术，包括用于结构预测的AlphaFold和用于从头蛋白质设计的平台，解决了结构生物学中长期存在的瓶颈，并为工程化抗病毒蛋白质、抗体和疫苗抗原提供了强大手段。合成生物学在“设计-构建-测试-学习”循环的指导下，将计算设计、遗传组装和功能验证整合为一个连贯流程。这些技术共同形成了一个协同工作流，涵盖疾病建模、靶点发现、分子设计、构建、测试和迭代优化。这种整合方法正在将抗病毒开发从传统经验方法转向更精确、智能的策略。本综述还强调了整合和可扩展性方面的持续挑战，指出高质量生物数据集和更强的跨学科合作对于实现转化潜力至关重要。通过呈现这些汇聚方法的统一视角，本综述为引导人类和动物健康领域抗病毒策略的智能演进提供了框架。

papers.title: Biomolecular Condensates Dictate the Folding Landscape of Protein Alpha-Helices.
papers.authors: Hess, Nathaniel; Joseph, Jerelle A
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过原子模拟和贝叶斯优化研究生物分子凝聚体对蛋白α-螺旋折叠景观的调控，核心聚焦蛋白质结构计算建模，方法涉及物理模拟与AI优化，与课题高度相关。
papers.abstract: Protein structure is exquisitely sensitive to the surrounding chemical environment, and many proteins encounter complex environments within cells. Importantly, numerous proteins organize into biomolecular condensates horizontal line dense macromolecular assemblies with distinct physicochemical properties. This raises a fundamental question: how do condensates reshape protein structure and dynamics? Here, we investigate how protein folding landscapes are altered inside condensates, using the protein alpha-helix as a model folded domain. Atomistic simulations suggest the helix-coil transition within condensates differs markedly from its behavior in dilute solution or in the presence of inert crowders. We then use Bayesian optimization to develop a chemically specific, residue-resolution model for quantification of alpha-helical folding and apply it to characterize diverse helices, including alpha-helical domains from the disease-associated proteins TDP-43, Annexin A11, and Androgen Receptor, within condensates of varying physicochemical properties. Our results support a framework in which multivalent interactions drive unfolding while crowding promotes folding, and alpha-helix conformational ensembles inside condensates emerge from this balance. Additionally, we show that helix folding transitions are kinetically frustrated inside condensates because they are coupled to the time scale of contact rearrangement with co-condensate proteins. As such, alpha-helix folding landscapes within condensates are dually sequence-dependent, informed by both the sequence of the alpha-helical domain and co-condensate proteins. Together, our work has implications for understanding condensate-mediated proteinopathies, targeting aberrant condensates, and designing condensates to program protein function across scales.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白质结构对周围化学环境极为敏感，许多蛋白质在细胞内会遭遇复杂环境。重要的是，大量蛋白质会组织成生物分子凝聚体 (biomolecular condensates)——即具有独特物理化学性质的致密大分子组装体。这引出一个基本问题：凝聚体如何重塑蛋白质的结构与动力学？在此，我们以蛋白质α-螺旋 (alpha-helix) 作为折叠结构域模型，研究凝聚体内部蛋白质折叠景观的变化。原子模拟 (atomistic simulations) 表明，凝聚体中的螺旋-卷曲转变 (helix-coil transition) 与稀溶液或惰性拥挤剂存在时的行为显著不同。随后，我们利用贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian optimization) 开发了一种化学特异性、残基分辨率的模型，用于定量α-螺旋折叠，并将其应用于表征不同物理化学性质凝聚体中的多种螺旋，包括疾病相关蛋白TDP-43、Annexin A11和雄激素受体 (Androgen Receptor) 的α-螺旋结构域。我们的结果支持一个框架：多价相互作用 (multivalent interactions) 驱动去折叠，而拥挤效应 (crowding) 促进折叠，凝聚体内部的α-螺旋构象系综 (conformational ensembles) 由此平衡产生。此外，我们表明，凝聚体内部的螺旋折叠转变在动力学上受到阻碍，因为它们与共凝聚体蛋白 (co-condensate proteins) 的接触重排时间尺度相耦合。因此，凝聚体内部的α-螺旋折叠景观具有双重序列依赖性，既受α-螺旋结构域序列的影响，也受共凝聚体蛋白序列的影响。总体而言，我们的工作对理解凝聚体介导的蛋白质病 (condensate-mediated proteinopathies)、靶向异常凝聚体以及设计凝聚体以跨尺度编程蛋白质功能具有重要意义。

papers.title: Kinetic and Thermodynamic Control of Macrocyclic Peptide Conformation through Late-Stage Chemical Modification.
papers.authors: Ou, Yang Daniel; Hur, Joonseong; Baloh, Chloe; Huang, Benzhen; Kovljenic, Nenad; Dudding, Travis; Yudin, Andrei K
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过化学修饰控制大环肽构象，结合NMR和分子动力学模拟研究构象变化，涉及蛋白质结构计算（MD模拟），但核心是化学方法而非AI/深度学习，对象为肽类，问题为构象控制，方法有MD模拟，综合评7分。
papers.abstract: We describe the use of lactone ring-opening as a chemical tool for producing differentiated conformations of macrocyclic peptides. Under kinetic control, the lactone opening is highly atroposelective across macrocyclic precursors tested. Under thermodynamic control, reversible lactone opening equilibrates the atropisomers. A combined NMR/molecular dynamics study reveals that the atropisomers arising from lactone opening can adopt markedly different conformations, ranging from a 310-helix to various noncanonical conformations. In the RGD-containing macrocycle, the kinetic atropisomer recapitulates the 3D geometry involved in integrin binding, whereas the thermodynamic atropisomer adopts a distinct conformation that was not previously described. Together, these results establish a new strategy to control the conformational states of macrocyclic peptides.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们描述了利用内酯开环作为一种化学工具，用于产生大环肽的差异化构象。在动力学控制下，内酯开环在所测试的大环前体中表现出高度的对映选择性。在热力学控制下，可逆的内酯开环使阻转异构体达到平衡。结合核磁共振/分子动力学研究揭示，由内酯开环产生的阻转异构体可以呈现显著不同的构象，范围从310-螺旋到各种非经典构象。在含有RGD的大环中，动力学阻转异构体重现了参与整合素结合的三维几何结构，而热力学阻转异构体则采用了一种先前未被描述的不同构象。综合这些结果，确立了一种控制大环肽构象状态的新策略。

papers.title: Tuning the ZIKV NS3 Helicase Motor Activity through Magnesium Coordination and RNA-Driven Allostery.
papers.authors: Garcia-Martinez, Adrian; Ruiz-Pernia, J Javier; Tunon, Inaki
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文结合AI结构建模（AlphaFold）、分子动力学模拟和QM/MM计算，研究Zika病毒NS3解旋酶的ATP水解机制，揭示了RNA驱动的别构调控，核心聚焦蛋白质结构计算问题。
papers.abstract: Viral NS3 helicases convert the chemical energy of ATP hydrolysis into directional motion along nucleic acids, but the molecular basis of this coupling remains unclear. Here, we combine AI-based structural modeling, molecular dynamics simulations, and hybrid QM/MM free energy calculations to investigate ATP hydrolysis in the Zika virus NS3 helicase (ZIKV NS3h). We first address the structural limitations of the available ternary crystallographic structure, which displays a noncanonical ATP-Mg2+ coordination mode and an RNA-binding arrangement inconsistent with the expected ATP-bound state. Our simulations show that alternative ATP-Mg2+ coordination modes can form stable but less favorable local minima, potentially associated with the secondary pyrophosphatase activity reported for this enzyme. Instead, the AlphaFold-predicted ternary complex provides a catalytically competent model with canonical coordination and the expected two-nucleotide separation between conserved "pincer" residues. We then use this model to explain the origin of RNA-stimulated ATPase activity. In the absence of ssRNA, the ATPase active site samples a broad conformational ensemble dominated by open, catalytically impaired states. Binding of ssRNA restricts this landscape and stabilizes a closed conformation in which the catalytic motifs are properly aligned. QM/MM free energy profiles show that the open state is effectively inactive, whereas the closed state lowers the activation barrier for ATP hydrolysis by optimizing active-site interactions with ATP and the nucleophilic water molecule. These results rationalize RNA-stimulated ATPase activity as an allosteric conformational selection mechanism that links RNA binding to optimal organization of the ATPase active site.
papers.abstract_zh: 病毒NS3解旋酶将ATP水解的化学能转化为沿核酸定向运动的机械能，但这种耦合的分子基础仍不清楚。本研究结合基于AI的结构建模、分子动力学模拟和混合QM/MM自由能计算，探究寨卡病毒NS3解旋酶（ZIKV NS3h）中的ATP水解机制。我们首先解决了现有三元晶体结构的结构局限性——该结构呈现非经典ATP-Mg2+配位模式，且RNA结合排列方式与预期的ATP结合状态不符。模拟表明，替代性ATP-Mg2+配位模式可形成稳定但能量较优的局部极小值，可能与该酶报道的二级焦磷酸酶活性相关。而AlphaFold预测的三元复合物则提供了具有催化活性的模型，包含经典配位模式及保守"钳状"残基间预期的两个核苷酸间隔。我们进而利用该模型解释RNA刺激ATP酶活性的起源。在无ssRNA时，ATP酶活性位点采样以开放、催化受损状态为主的广泛构象集合。ssRNA的结合限制了这一构象空间，并稳定了催化基序正确排列的闭合构象。QM/MM自由能谱显示，开放状态实际上无催化活性，而闭合状态通过优化与ATP及亲核水分子的活性位点相互作用，降低了ATP水解的活化能垒。这些结果将RNA刺激的ATP酶活性归因于变构构象选择机制——该机制将RNA结合与ATP酶活性位点的优化组织相偶联。

papers.title: Enhanced Sampling and Ligandability Assessment to Expand the Repertoire of Potentially Druggable Cryptic Pockets.
papers.authors: Vithani, Neha; Zhang, She; Gunther, Judith; Purkey, Hans; Lawson, J David; Nicholls, Anthony; Skillman, A Geoffrey; LeBard, David N
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文使用加权系综分子动力学模拟结合正常模式分析，从apo结构出发预测蛋白质隐秘口袋，并评估其配体可药性，直接服务于蛋白质结构计算中的构象采样和药物设计问题。
papers.abstract: Certain proteins known to be involved in life-threatening diseases have remained challenging therapeutic targets for decades, simply because a suitable binding pocket for a potent molecular inhibitor could not be identified in their ground-state apo structures. In the past decade, the discovery of cryptic pockets in challenging targets like KRAS and Werner helicase has proven to be a major turning point for therapeutic development. However, the alternate protein conformations required for these cryptic pockets to exist were only revealed by experiments conducted in the presence of ligands that can bind to them. Time-consuming and expensive experiments currently used to uncover these biologically rare events could be usefully complemented by a computational method capable of reliably identifying cryptic pockets.
