We have previously shown that aqueous and mixed-solvent Weighted Ensemble molecular dynamics (WEMD) simulations, driven by normal modes representing the direction of the most collective motion of a protein, can predict known cryptic pockets in the KRAS oncoprotein. Here, we evaluate this cryptic pocket detection technique on a data set of diverse proteins and show that it successfully samples cryptic pockets within 2 A of the known holo conformation 57% of the time, starting with just the apo structure. The predicted pockets in the most holo-like conformations show at least 20%, 50%, and 80% volume overlap with the bound ligand in the holo structure, with success rates of 92%, 84%, and 46%, respectively. We also show that we can successfully rank candidate pockets from WEMD using our pocket ligandability prediction model, Target X.
papers.abstract_zh: 某些已知与危及生命的疾病相关的蛋白质，数十年来一直是难以攻克的治疗靶点，原因很简单：在其基态无配体（apo）结构中，无法为强效分子抑制剂识别出合适的结合口袋。在过去十年中，在KRAS和Werner解旋酶等棘手靶点中发现隐蔽口袋（cryptic pockets），已被证明是治疗开发的一个重大转折点。然而，这些隐蔽口袋存在所需的替代蛋白质构象，仅通过在与能结合它们的配体存在下进行的实验才得以揭示。目前用于揭示这些生物学罕见事件的方法耗时且昂贵，而一种能够可靠识别隐蔽口袋的计算方法，可对其进行有益的补充。我们此前已表明，由代表蛋白质最集体运动方向的简正模式（normal modes）驱动的水溶液和混合溶剂加权系综分子动力学（WEMD）模拟，能够预测KRAS癌蛋白中已知的隐蔽口袋。在此，我们在一个多样化的蛋白质数据集上评估了这种隐蔽口袋检测技术，并表明仅从apo结构出发，它能在57%的情况下成功采样到与已知全配体（holo）构象相差2 Å以内的隐蔽口袋。在最接近holo构象的预测口袋中，与holo结构中结合配体的体积重叠至少达到20%、50%和80%，成功率分别为92%、84%和46%。我们还表明，利用我们的口袋配体可及性预测模型Target X，能够成功对WEMD产生的候选口袋进行排序。

papers.title: Discovery of Emodin as a novel competitive KPC-2 inhibitor through virtual screening: Synergistic efficacy with Meropenem against Carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae infection.
papers.authors: Wang, Yan; Geng, Jiamin; Li, Bingyan; Deng, Xuming; Wang, Jiaxi; Guo, Na
papers.one_liner_zh: 通过虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟发现天然化合物大黄素作为KPC-2蛋白竞争性抑制剂，并验证其与美罗培南的协同抗菌效果，涉及蛋白质结构对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物发现而非蛋白质结构计算方法创新。
papers.abstract: Carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae produces the carbapenemase KPC-2, which rapidly confers resistance and poses a significant threat to public health worldwide. Natural compounds have broad application potential, novel structures, and are not easily recognized by existing bacterial resistance mechanisms. Therefore, through virtual screening based on the KPC-2 protein structure and in vitro antimicrobial assessment, the natural anthraquinone compound emodin was identified as a KPC-2 inhibitor (IC(50) = 24.4 muM) and a synergist of meropenem. Molecular dynamics simulation and interaction analyses indicated that emodin competitively occupied the active site of KPC-2 at Trp105 and Thr237, resulting in reduced alpha-helices and increased beta-sheets, thereby inhibiting KPC-2 activity. The combination of emodin and MEM exhibited a synergistic effect. Furthermore, emodin modulates succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) activity and its transcriptional expression, resulting in metabolic perturbation that renders bacteria susceptible to meropenem, thereby potentiating the synergistic antibacterial activity of the combination. This disrupted the metabolic homeostasis of the bacteria, thereby compromising the integrity of bacterial cells and biofilms. No resistance development was observed over 30 generations of passage. In a mouse model of pneumonia, the combination therapy significantly reduced MEM usage, decreased the pulmonary bacterial load by 1.43 log CFU/g of model group, attenuated lung inflammation, and restored normal lung histology. These findings suggest that emodin acts as a promising candidate of KPC-2 inhibitor, which is capable of reinstating carbapenem efficacy against carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative pathogens in vitro and in vivo.
papers.abstract_zh: 耐碳青霉烯肺炎克雷伯菌（Carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae）产生碳青霉烯酶KPC-2，该酶可快速赋予耐药性，对全球公共卫生构成重大威胁。天然化合物具有广泛的应用潜力、新颖的结构，且不易被现有细菌耐药机制识别。因此，通过基于KPC-2蛋白结构的虚拟筛选（virtual screening）及体外抗菌评估，天然蒽醌化合物大黄素（emodin）被鉴定为KPC-2抑制剂（IC(50) = 24.4 μM）及美罗培南（meropenem）的增效剂。分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulation）及相互作用分析表明，大黄素竞争性占据KPC-2活性位点Trp105和Thr237，导致α-螺旋减少、β-折叠增加，从而抑制KPC-2活性。大黄素与MEM联用表现出协同效应。此外，大黄素调节琥珀酸脱氢酶（succinate dehydrogenase, SDH）活性及其转录表达，引起代谢紊乱，使细菌对美罗培南敏感，从而增强联合用药的协同抗菌活性。这破坏了细菌的代谢稳态，进而损害细菌细胞及生物被膜的完整性。在30代传代过程中未观察到耐药性产生。在肺炎小鼠模型中，联合治疗显著减少MEM用量，使模型组肺部细菌载量降低1.43 log CFU/g，减轻肺部炎症，并恢复肺组织正常组织学结构。这些发现表明，大黄素作为KPC-2抑制剂的有前景候选物，能够在体外和体内恢复碳青霉烯类药物对耐碳青霉烯革兰阴性病原菌的疗效。

papers.title: Agentic BAIM-LLM Evaluation (ABLE): Benchmarking LLM Use of Protein Design Tools
papers.authors: Bryce Cai; Geetha Jeyapragasan; Samira Nedungadi; Jake Yukich; Seth Donoughe
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文构建了评估LLM智能体使用ProteinMPNN、AlphaFold3等蛋白设计工具能力的基准，虽非直接提出新结构计算方法，但聚焦蛋白结构设计工具调用与流程评估，对AI辅助蛋白设计研究有参考价值。
papers.abstract: We introduce ABLE, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' ability to use biological AI models (BAIMs), such as ProteinMPNN and AlphaFold3, in dual-use protein design workflows. ABLE assesses agent performance through a set of tasks spanning structure retrieval, sequence generation, and design validation. We evaluate 15 frontier models and find that seven refuse all tasks, while the remaining models exhibit substantial performance differences. Claude Sonnet 4 and Gemini 3 Pro achieve the highest scores across information retrieval, tool selection, and tool use. We further compare model performance on a subset of tasks against an expert human baseline. Our results suggest that current LLMs can substantially lower barriers to protein design, but remain inconsistent in planning, strategy generation, and integrating biological knowledge with tool use.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了ABLE，这是一个用于评估LLM代理在双重用途蛋白质设计工作流中运用生物AI模型（BAIMs），如ProteinMPNN和AlphaFold3，能力的基准测试。ABLE通过一系列涵盖结构检索、序列生成和设计验证的任务来评估代理性能。我们评估了15个前沿模型，发现其中七个拒绝执行所有任务，而其余模型表现出显著的性能差异。Claude Sonnet 4和Gemini 3 Pro在信息检索、工具选择和工具使用方面取得了最高分。我们进一步将模型在部分任务上的表现与专家人类基线进行了比较。我们的结果表明，当前LLM能显著降低蛋白质设计的门槛，但在规划、策略生成以及将生物学知识与工具使用相结合方面仍存在不一致性。

papers.title: A Time-Dependent Diffusion MRI Framework for Clinical Characterisation of Human Brain Cellular Architecture
papers.authors: Leibovici A; Soler EE; Mesika D; Tsarfaty G; Livny A; De Santis S; Eggl MF
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文开发基于扩散MRI的脑组织微结构成像框架，不涉及蛋白质结构计算，与课题无关。
papers.abstract:
ABSTRACT

Diffusion-weighted MRI, beyond the commonly used diffusion tensor framework, offers a unique window into tissue microstructure in vivo , yet its clinical adoption has remained limited. Major barriers include the complexity of diffusion MRI sequence design, lengthy acquisition protocols, and the challenges associated with robust estimation of high-dimensional microstructural model parameters. Here, we address these limitations by combining optimised diffusion encoding with state-of-the-art simulation-based inference, establishing a clinically feasible framework for multi-compartment diffusion modelling. We validate the approach through i) in-depth in silico experiments and ii) in vivo studies made up of both human and rodent data. The resulting microstructural metrics are robust, reproducible across healthy individuals and show significant spatial associations with brain-wide expression patterns of cell-specific genes. Requiring less than 10 minutes of acquisition time, this framework substantially lowers the barriers to advanced microstructural imaging, a prerequisite step toward its eventual evaluation for the diagnosis, stratification, and monitoring of brain disorders.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要

扩散加权MRI（diffusion-weighted MRI），超越了常用的扩散张量框架（diffusion tensor framework），为体内组织微结构（tissue microstructure in vivo）提供了独特的窗口，但其临床采用仍然有限。主要障碍包括扩散MRI序列设计的复杂性、冗长的采集协议，以及高维微结构模型参数稳健估计所面临的挑战。在此，我们通过将优化的扩散编码（optimised diffusion encoding）与最先进的基于模拟的推断（simulation-based inference）相结合，建立了一个临床可行的多室扩散建模（multi-compartment diffusion modelling）框架，从而解决了这些限制。我们通过i) 深入的在硅实验（in silico experiments）和ii) 包含人类和啮齿动物数据的在体研究（in vivo studies）来验证该方法。所得的微结构指标（microstructural metrics）稳健、在健康个体间可重复，并与细胞特异性基因（cell-specific genes）的全脑表达模式显示出显著的空间关联。该框架所需采集时间少于10分钟，显著降低了先进微结构成像的障碍，这是其最终评估用于脑部疾病诊断、分层和监测的先决步骤。

papers.title: Developing plant-based meat analogues using red yeast rice powder: color stability, structural reinforcement, and antioxidant enhancement.
papers.authors: Gao, Chaofan; Yang, Jiafei; Dai, Huihui; Lai, Rui; Guo, Yiting; Zhu, Xueqing; An, Hongzhou
papers.journal: Journal of the science of food and agriculture
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究红曲米粉对植物基肉制品颜色、结构和抗氧化性的影响，属于食品加工领域，不涉及蛋白质结构计算建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Plant-based meat is limited by the absence of heme, which hinders the simulation of animal meat color. This study evaluated the effects of red yeast rice powder (RYRP), added as a natural colorant at 0%, 1%, 3%, 5%, and 7%, on the color, structure, and antioxidant properties of high-moisture textured vegetable protein (HMTVP). RESULTS: Red yeast rice powder significantly improved the meat-like color of HMTVP, with 5% addition exhibiting color characteristics closer to those of fresh beef tenderloin, particularly in terms of redness (a*). The color remained relatively stable during heating at 60  degrees C and under dark frozen storage. Structural analysis showed that low addition levels (1%) led to a looser protein structure and reduced the degree of texturization. Conversely, higher addition levels (3%) promoted the transformation of the fibrous structure from disordered to compact and ordered by enhancing intermolecular interactions, and also affected water distribution. Red yeast rice powder also increased the in vitro antioxidant activity of HMTVP in a dose-dependent manner. CONCLUSION: Red yeast rice powder can effectively improve the color, structural properties, and in vitro antioxidant activity of HMTVP. These findings indicate the potential of this natural colorant for improving the color and overall quality attributes of plant-based meat products. (c) 2026 Society of Chemical Industry.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：植物基肉因缺乏血红素而受限，这阻碍了对动物肉颜色的模拟。本研究评估了以0%、1%、3%、5%和7%比例添加的红曲米粉（RYRP）作为天然着色剂，对高水分组织化植物蛋白（HMTVP）颜色、结构和抗氧化性能的影响。结果：红曲米粉显著改善了HMTVP的类肉颜色，其中5%添加量表现出更接近新鲜牛里脊肉的颜色特征，尤其在红度（a*）方面。在60°C加热和暗冷冻储存条件下，颜色保持相对稳定。结构分析表明，低添加水平（1%）导致蛋白质结构更松散，并降低了组织化程度。相反，较高添加水平（3%）通过增强分子间相互作用，促进了纤维结构从无序向紧凑有序的转变，并影响了水分分布。红曲米粉还以剂量依赖方式提高了HMTVP的体外抗氧化活性。结论：红曲米粉能有效改善HMTVP的颜色、结构特性和体外抗氧化活性。这些发现表明，这种天然着色剂在改善植物基肉制品颜色和整体质量属性方面具有潜力。(c) 2026 化学工业学会。

papers.title: Antimicrobial peptides as computational candidates for SARS-CoV-2 papain-like protease inhibition.
papers.authors: Dos Santos Moreira, Erenilson; Siqueira, Sergio; Barbosa, Fabricio Santos; da Silva Sousa, Jailan; Mercado, Hugo Mauricio Pena; Melo, Tarcisio Silva; Jaiswal, Arun Kumar; Azevedo, Vasco; Goes-Neto, Aristoteles; Andrade, Bruno Silva
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用蛋白-肽对接、MD模拟和MM/PBSA计算筛选靶向SARS-CoV-2 PLpro的抗菌肽抑制剂，属于蛋白质-配体相互作用的结构计算研究，但对象为肽而非蛋白质结构本身，方法偏工程化应用，缺乏方法创新。
papers.abstract: SARS-CoV-2 papain-like protease (PLpro) remains an attractive antiviral target because of its dual role in viral polyprotein processing and host immune modulation. In this study, we employed an exploratory structure-based computational workflow to identify antimicrobial peptide scaffolds with predicted PLpro-binding potential. A total of 6,615 peptides compiled from public databases were screened using protein-peptide docking, followed by molecular dynamics simulations and end-state binding energy analysis for selected complexes. Among the prioritized candidates, peptides 33,035 and 17,047 showed favorable predicted occupation of the catalytic region and persistent interactions with residues in the active-site environment. Molecular dynamics analyses suggested sustained peptide engagement within the PLpro binding region, although distinct degrees of conformational adaptation were observed across systems. MM/PBSA calculations provided additional energetic support for peptide-PLpro association in the selected complexes. In silico toxicity prediction further indicated that peptide 33,035 may require sequence optimization before translational consideration. Overall, our results identify peptide scaffolds worthy of future biochemical and antiviral validation, while reinforcing the need for experimental confirmation and further optimization before any therapeutic inference can be made.
papers.abstract_zh: SARS-CoV-2 木瓜蛋白酶样蛋白酶 (papain-like protease, PLpro) 因其在病毒多聚蛋白加工和宿主免疫调节中的双重作用，仍是一个有吸引力的抗病毒靶点。在本研究中，我们采用了一种基于结构的探索性计算工作流程，以识别具有预测PLpro结合潜力的抗菌肽支架。利用蛋白质-肽段对接 (protein-peptide docking) 对从公共数据库汇编的共计6,615个肽段进行了筛选，随后对选定的复合物进行了分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和终态结合能分析。在优先候选物中，肽段33,035和17,047显示出对催化区域的有利预测占据，以及与活性位点环境中残基的持续相互作用。分子动力学分析表明，肽段在PLpro结合区域内持续结合，尽管在不同系统中观察到了不同程度的构象适应。MM/PBSA计算为选定复合物中的肽段-PLpro结合提供了额外的能量支持。计算机毒性预测进一步表明，肽段33,035在转化应用前可能需要序列优化。总体而言，我们的结果识别出值得未来生化和抗病毒验证的肽段支架，同时强调在得出任何治疗性推论之前，需要实验确认和进一步优化。

papers.title: Structure prediction and drug screening targeting monkeypox virus polymerase and surface proteins.
papers.authors: Tao, Tao; Jia, Linchuan; Cheng, Yuhang; Zou, Yawen; Wen, Yanqin; Chen, Yi; Chen, Haowen; Wei, Hao; Yang, Qiangzhen; Shi, Yongyong
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold2预测猴痘病毒蛋白结构，结合分子对接、MD模拟和SPR实验筛选潜在药物，属于蛋白质结构预测与对接的工程化应用，方法创新有限但对象、问题、方法三者齐备。
papers.abstract: The global outbreak and ongoing spread of the monkeypox virus (MPXV) have highlighted the urgent need for effective antiviral therapeutics. Here, we integrated artificial intelligence-based protein structure prediction, large-scale virtual screening, and experimental validation to identify preliminary hit compounds targeting MPXV. Using AlphaFold2, we predicted high-accuracy structures for seven essential MPXV proteins, including three polymerase-related and four surface proteins. Molecular docking of these targets against 6405 drugs from the ZINC15 world-approved subset generated a docking score dataset of 44,835 drug-protein pairs, from which numerous high-scoring compounds were identified. Focusing on A35R, we selected 26 compounds for experimental validation using surface plasmon resonance (SPR). Three compounds, including cepharanthine, eltrombopag, and simeprevir, exhibited measurable A35R‑associated binding signals with equilibrium dissociation constants (KD) in the micromolar range. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and molecular mechanics generalized Born surface area were employed for stability analysis and relative energetic assessment. Notably, all three have been previously reported to target other MPXV proteins, reinforcing their potential for repurposing. This work establishes AI‑driven structure prediction as a useful tool for identifying preliminary binding compounds. However, no antiviral activity has been demonstrated for these compounds; therefore, the three hit compounds warrant further optimization and biological evaluation. Our integrated approach provides a framework for rapid drug screening against emerging viral threats.
papers.abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒（MPXV）的全球暴发和持续传播凸显了对有效抗病毒治疗药物的迫切需求。在此，我们整合了基于人工智能的蛋白质结构预测、大规模虚拟筛选和实验验证，以识别靶向MPXV的初步命中化合物。利用AlphaFold2，我们预测了七种关键MPXV蛋白的高精度结构，包括三种聚合酶相关蛋白和四种表面蛋白。将这些靶点与来自ZINC15世界批准子集的6405种药物进行分子对接，生成了一个包含44,835个药物-蛋白对的对接评分数据集，从中识别出多个高评分化合物。聚焦于A35R，我们选择了26种化合物，使用表面等离子体共振（SPR）进行实验验证。包括cepharanthine、eltrombopag和simeprevir在内的三种化合物表现出可测量的A35R相关结合信号，其平衡解离常数（KD）在微摩尔范围内。采用分子动力学（MD）模拟和分子力学广义Born表面积法进行稳定性分析和相对能量评估。值得注意的是，这三种化合物此前均被报道靶向其他MPXV蛋白，这进一步增强了它们被重新利用的潜力。本工作确立了AI驱动的结构预测作为识别初步结合化合物的有用工具。然而，这些化合物尚未被证明具有抗病毒活性；因此，这三种命中化合物需要进一步优化和生物学评估。我们的整合方法为针对新兴病毒威胁的快速药物筛选提供了一个框架。
